news_mentions.headline: NFL QB rankings, Week 4: Brock Purdy climbs to No. 1; Kirk Cousins enters top 10
news_mentions.description: Who unseats Josh Allen at the top of Nick Shook's QB rankings? How high does Kirk Cousins rise? Check out the updated pecking order, 1-32, heading into Week 4 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: notes up down arrows illustrate movement from the week 3 qb index stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl tier 1 brock purdy is building a strong early case for mvp through three weeks lighting up defenses with ease and looking completely comfortable directing kyle shanahan s offense i m fascinated to see if he can keep it up against denver s defense this weekend patrick mahomes took care of business against a scrappy dolphins defense in week 3 he shook off a big hit that drew a roughing the passer penalty and left him clutching his lower back to help the chiefs leave miami with a two score victory dak prescott continues to power a cowboys offense that can throw it against anyone and will be required to do so as long as their defense continues to lag behind it was especially nice to see him connect with both ceedee lamb and george pickens against the ravens josh allen was a bit of a mess against the chargers turning the ball over three times his second half fumble should have cost the bills much more than it did he s good for one of these games per year so i m not too concerned about what it means going forward after crumbling against the broncos trevor lawrence got back on the horse and torched the patriots he produced a wildly entertaining sequence in which he threw two absurd touchdown passes to parker washington the first was nullified by penalty but i still wish he wouldn t have taken a knee when he was six inches from a rushing score and there were still nine minutes left in the game if you re not watching him throw the football you need to catch up before week 4 it s among the prettiest displays in the nfl next gen stats insight via nfl pro purdy threw for 297 yards and four touchdowns in the 49ers week 3 win over the cardinals purdy was most efficient in the quick passing game finishing 8 of 10 for 180 yards and two touchdowns his 18 yards per attempt on quick passes is the highest mark in a game in the ngs era among qbs with at least 10 quick attempts purdy targeted george kittle on five of his 10 quick throws with kittle catching four of those passes for 50 yards and a td tier 2 jared goff has been excellent in 2026 powering a passing attack that isn t afraid to rely heavily on jahmyr gibbs to open up opportunities elsewhere it s similar to what we ve seen from goff in recent years although they re weathering offensive line challenges better than they did last season lamar jackson wasn t quite stellar against the cowboys in rio but he delivered in key spots and benefitted greatly from the return of zay flowers joe burrow is making big plays and leaning heavily on ja marr chase when he s in need of a completion but the steelers strip sack of burrow cost the bengals a chance to secure a thrilling win matthew stafford s second half struggles against the broncos pressure dampened the fun i ve had watching him connect with davante adams it s pretty clear stafford misses puka nacua kirk cousins is off to a fantastic start throwing three touchdown passes in each of his first three contests that ties his longest career streak of games with at least three td passes and gives him the nfl s longest active such streak that s a sentence i know you didn t expect to read in 2026 next gen stats insight via nfl pro the broncos generated pressure on 59 3 of dropbacks in the second half against the rams after doing so on only 23 5 of dropbacks in the first half against pressure stafford completed just 6 of 20 passes for 81 yards taking four sacks and throwing a pick six from a clean pocket stafford finished 24 of 35 for 309 yards two touchdowns and an interception tier 3 this is admittedly a strange week for the qb index two backups case keenum and marcus mariota excelled in different ways in their first starts of 2026 both led their teams to thrilling home wins and aaron rodgers played perhaps his best game since he was a packer anyone who thinks the jets have lost two in a row due to quarterback play is very much mistaken geno smith has been very sharp and heroically threw new york back into a game at detroit that came down to the wire before he fumbled to end the jets chances we probably won t have another week like this for quite some time so fans of graybeards should soak it up while we re here sam darnold s return from injury was fraught with turnovers but between the back breaking mistakes he made some fantastic throws primarily to jaxon smith njigba and piled up 379 passing yards next gen stats insight via nfl pro rodgers completed 6 of 11 pass attempts under pressure for 121 yards and a touchdown in the steelers week 3 win rodgers tied for his most passing yards under pressure in a game since week 10 of 2020 he entered week 3 with a 43 5 completion percentage and 92 passing yards under pressure this season rodgers threw two deep 20 air yards td passes in the first quarter after he had failed to complete a single deep pass on nine attempts through the first two weeks tier 4 jacoby brissett let it fire 52 times out of necessity against the 49ers and is finding consistent success by leaning on trey mcbride unfortunately it doesn t look like he can carry the cardinals to victory against nfc west competition by most standards brissett is embodying the dalton line which is what the cardinals likely hoped to get from him in 2026 tyler shough slips in the rankings after a disastrous fourth quarter against the raiders he accounted for three turnovers in the final 13 minutes reversing course on a reputation that was being built on clutch performances bo nix rises after taking what the rams defense gave him in the second half he did just enough to help the broncos mount a wild comeback although he s still not reliable enough for me to move him any higher c j stroud is largely playing it safe until he absolutely must find a route to the end zone the texans are going to need more from him to dig out of their 0 3 hole justin herbert is making a habit of following up remarkable passes with brain melting mistakes or as tom brady called it during the chargers bills broadcast serving up a meatball sub to the defense bryce young s hot start came to a screeching halt against a feisty browns defense and jalen coker s injury related departure didn t help matters daniel jones accounted for three turnovers and nearly gave the game against the texans away with a fumble before helping the colts move into range for the game winning field goal michael penix started slowly but found a nice rhythm in his first start of 2026 he can thank the football gods for putting him on the same team as bijan robinson deshaun watson hasn t been close to consistent over four quarters but he has made the plays the browns needed late in the last two games he continues to build a promising rapport with rookie receiver denzel boston giving browns fans hope heading into week 4 next gen stats insight via nfl pro herbert finished 20 of 34 for 226 yards one touchdown and one interception in week 3 against the bills on deep throws 20 air yards herbert was 1 of 7 for 29 yards and an interception herbert has now thrown more interceptions on deep balls this season 3 than he did in each of the previous two seasons 2 in 2024 2 in 2025 tier 5 this tier pains me to assemble because i know two of these three quarterbacks hurts and love are much better than their current rankings indicate that might be why they ve dropped so precipitously as their struggles have been especially frustrating to watch jalen hurts began the season by pushing the eagles to two wins with largely positive play while sprinkling in a few errors but his showing in chicago on monday night was downright abysmal it wasn t just the interception hurts reverted to the indecisive quarterback who was unwilling to play aggressively enough to lift the eagles out of the hole they d dug for themselves his coach s crunch time decisions didn t help much either jordan love is in a similarly tough spot his offense lacks a running game his offensive line is banged up and the entire operation is stuck in first gear love will rip a few beautiful throws every week but all it does is tease us because the rest of the experience is filled with nothing but disappointment malik willis is operating in an offense that lost de 39 von achane torn acl and is leaning on a collection of pass catchers that is undoubtedly the worst in the nfl he and the dolphins offense can move the ball but they still have a hard time finishing drives i appreciate the effort he s made but the results remain underwhelming next gen stats insight via nfl pro hurts completed 16 of 25 pass attempts but averaged just 6 1 yards per attempt monday night throwing only six passes 24 10 air yards downfield on those throws he completed two 33 3 for 49 yards all season lows the eagles went three and out on three straight drives to start the third quarter with hurts completing three of five attempts for six yards none of those attempts traveled more than 10 air yards tier 6 i m calling this the searching for answers tier because it s filled with quarterbacks who don t seem to have many right now kyler murray looked unsettled at best in his first game back and justin jefferson s departure due to injury didn t help matters baker mayfield spent another sunday appearing uncomfortable in zac robinson s offense while trying his best to play hero before suffering a thumb injury that will cost him multiple weeks cam ward was the latest to fall victim to a downpour at metlife stadium although he also had a collection of pass catchers drop on target passes before he threw away the titans last chance to win by tossing an interception in the end zone drake maye is the most lost of all accounting for three giveaways an unforced fumble and two ghastly interceptions that tanked the patriots chances of competing in jacksonville seriously throwing their season into uncertain waters of all of these quarterbacks i m most concerned about maye who looks nothing like the nfl mvp finalist he was in 2025 and seems completely adrift and sapped of his confidence jameis winston meanwhile is who he is a cart ride down a mine shaft with no guarantee it leads to daylight but will include a few exciting twists and turns next gen stats insight via nfl pro against pressure maye went 6 of 11 for 81 yards and an interception in week 3 without pressure he went 8 of 14 for 118 yards and an interception maye averaged a 3 42 second time to throw the second longest of his career with 25 of his attempts coming outside the pocket the fourth highest rate of his career outside the pocket maye went 3 of 7 for 57 yards and an interception totaling eight scramble dropbacks

news_mentions.body_text: it took three weeks but the nfl finally delivered on sunday what a week it was twelve of 16 games finished in a one score difference and while the opening and closing prime time windows produced lopsided outcomes sunday s witching hour chaos made up for it by a wide margin the reigning champions are undefeated no more the entire afc north is 2 1 while the entire nfc south is under 500 five teams remain perfect at 3 0 including the raiders yes those raiders all of this calls for a grand reshuffling of the league hierarchy let s sort out where everyone stands after three weeks of football note up down arrows below reflect movement from the week 3 edition of the power rankings

news_mentions.headline: Raiders TE Brock Bowers, Falcons RB Bijan Robinson highlight Players of the Week
news_mentions.description: Atlanta running back Bijan Robinson and Las Vegas tight end Brock Bowers were recognized for their outstanding Week 3 performances.
news_mentions.body_text: who were the nfl s top stars in week 3 each wednesday the league unveils its weekly honor roll see who the players of the week are below afc offensive player of the week bowers return to action was an emphatic one reminding everyone why he s among the best if not the best tight ends in the game helping the raiders to a 35 27 win over the new orleans saints on sunday and a 3 0 start bowers showed zero ill effects from a knee procedure that kept him absent from the first two games of the season bowers tallied a game high 10 receptions on a team high 13 targets for 116 yards also a game best and a 4 yard game winning touchdown catch in the fourth quarter just beginning his third nfl season this is stunningly bowers first player of the week accolade more impressive bowers is the first tight end awarded afc offensive player of the week since the kansas city chiefs travis kelce in week 11 2022 nfc offensive player of the week prime time bijan shined once more on thursday night robinson had a stupendous showing in the falcons surprising 35 14 victory over the green bay packers robinson ran circles around the packers with 194 rushing yards and two touchdowns on 29 carries he added a pair of catches for 19 yards putting him over 200 scrimmage yards for the game with that performance robinson is now averaging 145 4 scrimmage yards per prime time game the most in nfl history with a minimum of five games robinson has now won nfc offensive player of the week three times and each of them has come with him playing on a prime time stage afc defensive player of the week down by 16 points at halftime on sunday night the broncos pulled off a stunning 30 26 comeback win over the los angeles rams the rally wouldn t have been possible if not for the heroics of hufanga hufanga had a massive day statistically with five tackles three passes defensed one for loss one qb hit a huge sack of matthew stafford and two interceptions on his first pick hufanga ran it back the other way for a 66 yard touchdown his second int came in the end zone ending the game and sealing the victory a one time pro bowler with the san francisco 49ers who s now in his sixth nfl season hufanga has finally earned his first player of the week accolade nfc defensive player of the week the no 7 overall pick of the 2026 nfl draft stuffed the box score and was a pivotal force in the commanders upsetting the seattle seahawks 33 31 on sunday styles had five tackles a qb hit two pass breakups a forced fumble and an interception the forced fumble and int were the first of his career so far and were crucial in fending off the super bowl champions afc special teams player of the week in front of a jubilant brazilian crowd and a massive worldwide audience loop sent the ravens home as winners over the dallas cowboys 34 31 with a walk off 56 yard game winning field goal the final play culminated quite a day for loop who had 10 total points converting each of his four extra points and two field goals nfc special teams player of the week defense and special teams guided the vikings to a 23 16 win over the tampa bay buccaneers on sunday and nobody made a bigger play in either of those phases than price the wide receiver propelled minnesota to a 10 0 lead when he returned a bucs punt 86 yards for a touchdown in the first quarter glorious as the highlight was it was part of a massive day for price he averaged 26 5 yards on his four punt returns and added five kick returns for 132 yards 26 4 yards per return

news_mentions.headline: AFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Colts, Jaguars, Texans, Titans
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Kevin Patra breaks down the top AFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Houston Texans, Indianapolis Colts, Jacksonville Jaguars and Tennessee Titans.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars and tennessee titans catch up on each afc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below houston texans indianapolis colts jacksonville jaguars tennessee titans three key storylines 1 another o line overhaul the most glaring weakness of the 2025 texans will take center stage during training camp as houston once again undergoes an offensive line revamp demeco ryans crew re upped right guard ed ingram and left tackle aireontae ersery showed glimpses of promise during his up and down rookie campaign the texans drafted center guard keylan rutledge in the first round they inked guard wyatt teller and right tackle braden smith both solid veterans when healthy in free agency veteran trent brown and 2024 second rounder blake fisher will battle for reps and or the swing tackle gig and evan brown and fourth round rookie febechi nwaiwu provide depth inside on paper it s a significantly improved group from the one that got bowled over a year ago however we ve said that before paper can get shredded just like last year s o line in houston how the crew shakes out will be the key to camp and how the texans season unfolds 2 can stroud offense get back on track tied to the first point is the play of c j stroud who has seen his production dip the past two seasons after a sensational rookie campaign in 2023 stroud s collapse reached a low with his ghastly performance see four interceptions 42 6 completion rate in the playoff loss to the new england patriots stroud has been scattershot behind a woeful offensive line at times last year he trusted his blocking so little that even when he had time he d rush decisions and make panicked throws the qb s play has been so incongruous to the poise and calm he displayed as a rookie that it s maddening for the offense to get back in gear and stop wasting a championship worthy defense stroud must be more consistent in the pocket an improved offensive line will certainly help but the qb must raise all boats even when the situation isn t perfect getting better run production with the import of david montgomery should improve the offensive efficiency monty rarely gets stuffed for negative gains solving a problem we saw far too often from houston s ground game a year ago he should keep the offense in better down and distances one other key player to track during camp is receiver tank dell who has been out since late in the 2024 season due to a severe knee injury the difference in stroud s production with and without dell in the lineup is stark what sort of shape will the receiver be in after so much time away and can he stay healthy 3 rich defense gets richer can the most ferocious defense in the league actually be better in 2026 edge monsters will anderson and danielle hunter are still in their primes derek stingley kamari lassiter jalen pitre and calen bullock form a lockdown backend and azeez al shaair still patrols the middle the texans upgraded a safety spot with veteran reed blankenship after shuffling through others at the position second round pick kayden mcdonald could play a significant role out of the gate alongside sheldon rankins and tommy togiai in the middle of the d line if mcdonald turns out to be a steal this defense will have zero weaknesses back to top three key storylines 1 how will jones look in return from injury daniel jones progress is the no 1 topic in indianapolis entering camp the colts predictably held the starter out of team drills during offseason workouts but expect him to be full go sometime during camp the focus will be on how many reps he can take and how he looks indy was a wonder early last season when jones was on his game making plays and looking at home in shane steichen s offense it fell apart when the qb got hurt the colts put all their eggs in the basket of jones returning healthy this offseason achilles injuries however can be a slog to return from yes jones is younger than kirk cousins but we saw how long it took for the latter to return to anything close to what he was before such an injury and cousins never relied on his mobility like jones does if jones is stuck in the pocket or struggles to push off the injured leg leading to limp passes will the colts offense wither how he looks early in camp won t say everything but it will give a strong indication of what to expect for the first quarter of the season in concert the colts will conduct a backup qb competition between anthony richardson and riley leonard barring richardson s trade request being granted of course given jones injury history the winner could see reps this season 2 overall roster health health is the main storyline throughout the colts roster from jones to alec pierce on offense to key defenders like deforest buckner and sauce gardner on defense buckner is one to track on d the colts have no replacement for the star dt who underwent neck surgery last winter he could be ready for week 1 but at this point it remains an unknown he was noncommittal when asked this offseason given how much of the summer months are filled with players dismissing injury and assuming they ll be ready it s a red flag when a veteran is evasive if buckner misses the start of the season or sees his play dip it could be devastating for indy s defense how much he participates in camp if at all will be closely tracked there isn t the same concern with gardner who missed significant time last season with a lingering calf injury but the star s status is worth keeping an eye on we also aren t sure what charvarius ward will look like after deciding against retiring following last year s concussion issues outside of injury questions what will the pass rush look like is laiatu latu ready to make a leap how much does arden key still have left is jt tuimoloau ready for a bigger role do the colts need to bring in another veteran edge 3 taylor s future in indy outside of health concerns hovering over colts camp the future of jonathan taylor is an interesting question the 27 year old running back is in the final year of his contract the situation is far less contentious than the last time he sought a new pact which saw him conduct a hold in until he got paid when asked about his contract this summer taylor was cordial about the state of affairs but made it known he d like to continue getting paid in indy could the situation turn sour again will the rb decide to ratchet things up if no extension comes before camp perhaps he s waiting for bijan robinson and jahmyr gibbs to reset the market again before making his next play we saw the offense s struggles when jones was out as defenses could sell out to stop jt it wasn t pretty if taylor is going to be asked to keep carrying a hefty load with little aid he might want commensurate compensation into the future back to top three key storylines 1 backfield shakeup when travis etienne signed in new orleans it opened up a swath of carries bhayshul tuten who has impressed this offseason is expected to have a hefty role but it s still unclear how big that part might be as free agent addition chris rodriguez was unable to participate in offseason workouts following a surgical procedure on his left foot the veteran is expected to be good to go for training camp which will give us a better idea of how liam coen might divvy up his rb reps last year etienne took the overwhelming majority of carries 260 to tuten s 83 will coen slice up the pie more or ride tuten at least to start the season a lot might have to do with rodriguez s health 2 what will hunter s role be when it was reported that the jags planned for the former no 2 overall pick to be a primary corner and part time receiver travis hunter didn t seem to take too kindly to that plan we won t know the truth until hunter is on the field for a significant amount of time how much he participates early in camp and where that participation takes place will indicate the club s intentions if the second year dual threat player is the lockdown corner most believe he s capable of being and continues to make plays at receiver the jags could have trouble taking him off the gridiron the rest of the offensive playmakers could have some say in how much time hunter sees at wr after a disappointing second season brian thomas has received glowing reviews this offseason parker washington soared to close last season and jakobi meyers remains a consistent professional if btj gets back on track there could be less of a reason to use hunter in a ton of offensive sets 3 lloyd s replacement the jags saw devin lloyd leave in free agency and didn t replace his production in anthony campanile s defense via free agency or early in the draft the decision puts 2023 fourth rounder ventrell miller in line to take over the role next to foye oluokun miller showed spunk this offseason but won t be handed the starting gig 2025 undrafted lb branson combs and 2026 seventh rounder parker hughes could have a shot to push miller for the starting gig if no one comes to the forefront the jags d could be in a rough spot lloyd shined last year under campanile who unleashed the linebacker s athleticism in a second team all pro campaign lacking playmaking in the middle would highlight some of the questions up front where there wasn t always consistent pressure from the front four back to top three key storylines 1 cam ward cam ward cam ward when discussing critical elements for the 2026 tennessee titans point nos 1 through 50 could all be about cam ward that s how vital his development is to any success in nashville robert saleh brings a professional coach to the head chair and did well to import brian daboll to nurture the young quarterback perhaps daboll wasn t meant for the head coaching gig in new york but he s proven he can help grow a qb josh allen daniel jones and jaxson dart all improved under daboll ward offers enticing upside while his accuracy came and went last year when he was in a groove the titans qb showcased a laser arm and the ability to find the range deep he needs to calibrate his short to mid area throws at times but the alluring positives pop off the page he doesn t need to live in the acrobatic athletic plays but they can add an indefensible element to tennessee s offense improving his mental processing particularly against man coverage where he struggled is one of the early steps ward has to make this season the titans must see significant strides forward from their qb in year 2 after the club improved his surroundings 2 better receiving corps in attempting to make life easier for ward tennessee upgraded the wr room first they inked wan 39 dale robinson from new york the slot maven excelled in daboll s offense and can help teach a young wideout room the ropes robinson is coming off a 1 014 yard season and generated a career high 11 yards per catch in 2025 the veteran will be particularly helpful to ward on third downs when he can win from the slot and make himself available to the quarterback then the titans used the no 4 overall pick on ohio state wr carnell tate who provides a vertical threat and heady playmaking tate s ability to make catches in close knit areas will be a boon for his new qb second year wrs elic ayomanor and chimere dike both showed glimmers of promise during their rookie campaigns if they take a step forward this could be an enticing group the lingering question is what role calvin ridley will play the veteran struggled on the field and missed the bulk of the season due to injury in seven tilts he had just 303 yards on 17 catches with zero tds his 11 1 drop rate last season was fifth worst in the nfl minimum 25 targets per next gen stats the titans eschewed cutting ridley believing he can still aid ward and the offense what that role is will be determined during camp 3 will improved d on paper translate to field the titans sported a woeful defense last season with saleh taking over the club the unit was completely revamped on paper it s much improved but how will all the new pieces mesh i love adding a penetrating john franklin myers next to all world dt jeffery simmons however is there enough on the edges jermaine johnson had his best years under saleh but hasn t been a consistent force first round rookie keldric faulk boasts talent but will he be a day 1 difference maker will second round rookie linebacker anthony hill immediately step into the middle of the defense next to the underrated cedric gray the secondary was horrendous last season tennessee responded by signing cordale flott alontae taylor and joshua williams all have had moments in their careers when they ve been stellar but there is also a reason each was available namely inconsistency i trust saleh to know how he wants his d to run and to get the most out of his players there is no question this crew is significantly improved on paper but questions remain particularly with all the free agent veteran additions back to top

news_mentions.headline: Steelers vs. Browns: Three must-know storylines for Thursday's Week 4 prime-time game
news_mentions.description: Who will rise to the occasion with first place in the AFC North on the line? In advance of Thursday's game between the Steelers and Browns, Dan Parr provides three storylines you need to know.
news_mentions.body_text: we begin october with a prime time matchup steeped in higher stakes than anyone expected when the schedule was first announced thanks to the browns surprising 2 1 start the vibes are trending upward in cleveland and pittsburgh with both squads pulling off week 3 upsets but they re about to get even better for one team thursday night s winner will officially lead the afc north entering week 5 regardless of other results will the steelers begin exorcising some nearly decade old demons in aaron rodgers final nfl season can the browns above 500 for the first time since 2023 shock the world by rising to the top of the only division in which every team has a winning record entering week 4 three must know storylines 1 can pittsburgh shake the ghosts of cleveland trips past just in time for spooky season the steelers are about to enter what s become their house of horrors pittsburgh has won only one of its last eight games in cleveland dating back to 2018 with three of those losses coming in thursday night games the steelers scored a season low six points when they visited huntington bank field on a rainy sunday late last season perhaps mike mccarthy has the mojo to break the franchise s tnf curse in his first year on the job mccarthy has won seven straight thursday games as a head coach with the cowboys and he s apparently leaving no stone unturned as he looks for an edge in his first prime time game as coach of his hometown team including consideration of a day of game bus trip before ruling it out 2 will the steelers offense wither under the browns pressure pittsburgh erupted for 30 points in this past sunday s win over the bengals but was it just a mirage after all since 2025 the steelers have scored 31 7 points per game against the bengals and 20 9 points per game against all other opponents the triumph over cincinnati was one of rodgers best games since joining the steelers prior to last season the four time mvp tied for his most passing yards under pressure in a game since week 10 of 2020 and he threw two deep 20 air yards touchdown passes in the first quarter after he had failed to complete a deep throw on nine attempts in the first two weeks cleveland s defense might be starting to cook again though as it learns to live without myles garrett the browns have the second highest qb pressure rate in the league 42 2 and dt mason graham the fifth overall pick in the 2025 draft appears to have arrived posting four sacks in the first three games tied for second most in the league steady heat from the interior or any direction really would spell doom for the 42 year old rodgers but one way to wear down the browns front would be to pound the ball on the ground with rico dowdle sidelined by a toe injury against cincy jaylen warren posted a career high 176 scrimmage yards on 20 touches forcing 10 missed tackles he could find the sledding tougher this week 3 does the browns offense have another gear cleveland ranks among the bottom five offenses in total yards per game pass yards per game rush yards per game third down conversion rate and red zone touchdown percentage so while deshaun watson just became only the fourth browns qb in the last 35 seasons to throw multiple td passes and no interceptions in consecutive wins there s obviously still a long way to go for todd monken s offense there are budding browns playmakers who could pose problems for patrick graham s defense rookie receivers denzel boston and kc concepcion are promising talents but they each were held to two catches in week 3 s win over carolina harold fannin is one of the best young tight ends in the league cleveland could use a jolt from the quinshon judkins led running game but it won t help matters if starting center elgton jenkins concussion protocol is unable to play against the steelers editor s update jenkins has been ruled out of thursday s game pittsburgh still can throw t j watt alex highsmith nick herbig and cameron heyward at a cleveland offensive line that probably won t be operating at full strength and keep an eye on steelers second year dt derrick harmon who sealed the win over the bengals with a strip sack of joe burrow it s worth watching jalen ramsey s status too the eight time pro bowl db revealed on tuesday that he has a broken wrist but didn t rule out playing through it watson had his best performance of the season as a runner last week 11 rushes for 45 yards and his ability to create with his legs will be essential for the browns to counter the steelers pressure

news_mentions.headline: NFL QB rankings, Week 4: Brock Purdy climbs to No. 1; Kirk Cousins enters top 10
news_mentions.description: Who unseats Josh Allen at the top of Nick Shook's QB rankings? How high does Kirk Cousins rise? Check out the updated pecking order, 1-32, heading into Week 4 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: notes up down arrows illustrate movement from the week 3 qb index stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl tier 1 brock purdy is building a strong early case for mvp through three weeks lighting up defenses with ease and looking completely comfortable directing kyle shanahan s offense i m fascinated to see if he can keep it up against denver s defense this weekend patrick mahomes took care of business against a scrappy dolphins defense in week 3 he shook off a big hit that drew a roughing the passer penalty and left him clutching his lower back to help the chiefs leave miami with a two score victory dak prescott continues to power a cowboys offense that can throw it against anyone and will be required to do so as long as their defense continues to lag behind it was especially nice to see him connect with both ceedee lamb and george pickens against the ravens josh allen was a bit of a mess against the chargers turning the ball over three times his second half fumble should have cost the bills much more than it did he s good for one of these games per year so i m not too concerned about what it means going forward after crumbling against the broncos trevor lawrence got back on the horse and torched the patriots he produced a wildly entertaining sequence in which he threw two absurd touchdown passes to parker washington the first was nullified by penalty but i still wish he wouldn t have taken a knee when he was six inches from a rushing score and there were still nine minutes left in the game if you re not watching him throw the football you need to catch up before week 4 it s among the prettiest displays in the nfl next gen stats insight via nfl pro purdy threw for 297 yards and four touchdowns in the 49ers week 3 win over the cardinals purdy was most efficient in the quick passing game finishing 8 of 10 for 180 yards and two touchdowns his 18 yards per attempt on quick passes is the highest mark in a game in the ngs era among qbs with at least 10 quick attempts purdy targeted george kittle on five of his 10 quick throws with kittle catching four of those passes for 50 yards and a td tier 2 jared goff has been excellent in 2026 powering a passing attack that isn t afraid to rely heavily on jahmyr gibbs to open up opportunities elsewhere it s similar to what we ve seen from goff in recent years although they re weathering offensive line challenges better than they did last season lamar jackson wasn t quite stellar against the cowboys in rio but he delivered in key spots and benefitted greatly from the return of zay flowers joe burrow is making big plays and leaning heavily on ja marr chase when he s in need of a completion but the steelers strip sack of burrow cost the bengals a chance to secure a thrilling win matthew stafford s second half struggles against the broncos pressure dampened the fun i ve had watching him connect with davante adams it s pretty clear stafford misses puka nacua kirk cousins is off to a fantastic start throwing three touchdown passes in each of his first three contests that ties his longest career streak of games with at least three td passes and gives him the nfl s longest active such streak that s a sentence i know you didn t expect to read in 2026 next gen stats insight via nfl pro the broncos generated pressure on 59 3 of dropbacks in the second half against the rams after doing so on only 23 5 of dropbacks in the first half against pressure stafford completed just 6 of 20 passes for 81 yards taking four sacks and throwing a pick six from a clean pocket stafford finished 24 of 35 for 309 yards two touchdowns and an interception tier 3 this is admittedly a strange week for the qb index two backups case keenum and marcus mariota excelled in different ways in their first starts of 2026 both led their teams to thrilling home wins and aaron rodgers played perhaps his best game since he was a packer anyone who thinks the jets have lost two in a row due to quarterback play is very much mistaken geno smith has been very sharp and heroically threw new york back into a game at detroit that came down to the wire before he fumbled to end the jets chances we probably won t have another week like this for quite some time so fans of graybeards should soak it up while we re here sam darnold s return from injury was fraught with turnovers but between the back breaking mistakes he made some fantastic throws primarily to jaxon smith njigba and piled up 379 passing yards next gen stats insight via nfl pro rodgers completed 6 of 11 pass attempts under pressure for 121 yards and a touchdown in the steelers week 3 win rodgers tied for his most passing yards under pressure in a game since week 10 of 2020 he entered week 3 with a 43 5 completion percentage and 92 passing yards under pressure this season rodgers threw two deep 20 air yards td passes in the first quarter after he had failed to complete a single deep pass on nine attempts through the first two weeks tier 4 jacoby brissett let it fire 52 times out of necessity against the 49ers and is finding consistent success by leaning on trey mcbride unfortunately it doesn t look like he can carry the cardinals to victory against nfc west competition by most standards brissett is embodying the dalton line which is what the cardinals likely hoped to get from him in 2026 tyler shough slips in the rankings after a disastrous fourth quarter against the raiders he accounted for three turnovers in the final 13 minutes reversing course on a reputation that was being built on clutch performances bo nix rises after taking what the rams defense gave him in the second half he did just enough to help the broncos mount a wild comeback although he s still not reliable enough for me to move him any higher c j stroud is largely playing it safe until he absolutely must find a route to the end zone the texans are going to need more from him to dig out of their 0 3 hole justin herbert is making a habit of following up remarkable passes with brain melting mistakes or as tom brady called it during the chargers bills broadcast serving up a meatball sub to the defense bryce young s hot start came to a screeching halt against a feisty browns defense and jalen coker s injury related departure didn t help matters daniel jones accounted for three turnovers and nearly gave the game against the texans away with a fumble before helping the colts move into range for the game winning field goal michael penix started slowly but found a nice rhythm in his first start of 2026 he can thank the football gods for putting him on the same team as bijan robinson deshaun watson hasn t been close to consistent over four quarters but he has made the plays the browns needed late in the last two games he continues to build a promising rapport with rookie receiver denzel boston giving browns fans hope heading into week 4 next gen stats insight via nfl pro herbert finished 20 of 34 for 226 yards one touchdown and one interception in week 3 against the bills on deep throws 20 air yards herbert was 1 of 7 for 29 yards and an interception herbert has now thrown more interceptions on deep balls this season 3 than he did in each of the previous two seasons 2 in 2024 2 in 2025 tier 5 this tier pains me to assemble because i know two of these three quarterbacks hurts and love are much better than their current rankings indicate that might be why they ve dropped so precipitously as their struggles have been especially frustrating to watch jalen hurts began the season by pushing the eagles to two wins with largely positive play while sprinkling in a few errors but his showing in chicago on monday night was downright abysmal it wasn t just the interception hurts reverted to the indecisive quarterback who was unwilling to play aggressively enough to lift the eagles out of the hole they d dug for themselves his coach s crunch time decisions didn t help much either jordan love is in a similarly tough spot his offense lacks a running game his offensive line is banged up and the entire operation is stuck in first gear love will rip a few beautiful throws every week but all it does is tease us because the rest of the experience is filled with nothing but disappointment malik willis is operating in an offense that lost de 39 von achane torn acl and is leaning on a collection of pass catchers that is undoubtedly the worst in the nfl he and the dolphins offense can move the ball but they still have a hard time finishing drives i appreciate the effort he s made but the results remain underwhelming next gen stats insight via nfl pro hurts completed 16 of 25 pass attempts but averaged just 6 1 yards per attempt monday night throwing only six passes 24 10 air yards downfield on those throws he completed two 33 3 for 49 yards all season lows the eagles went three and out on three straight drives to start the third quarter with hurts completing three of five attempts for six yards none of those attempts traveled more than 10 air yards tier 6 i m calling this the searching for answers tier because it s filled with quarterbacks who don t seem to have many right now kyler murray looked unsettled at best in his first game back and justin jefferson s departure due to injury didn t help matters baker mayfield spent another sunday appearing uncomfortable in zac robinson s offense while trying his best to play hero before suffering a thumb injury that will cost him multiple weeks cam ward was the latest to fall victim to a downpour at metlife stadium although he also had a collection of pass catchers drop on target passes before he threw away the titans last chance to win by tossing an interception in the end zone drake maye is the most lost of all accounting for three giveaways an unforced fumble and two ghastly interceptions that tanked the patriots chances of competing in jacksonville seriously throwing their season into uncertain waters of all of these quarterbacks i m most concerned about maye who looks nothing like the nfl mvp finalist he was in 2025 and seems completely adrift and sapped of his confidence jameis winston meanwhile is who he is a cart ride down a mine shaft with no guarantee it leads to daylight but will include a few exciting twists and turns next gen stats insight via nfl pro against pressure maye went 6 of 11 for 81 yards and an interception in week 3 without pressure he went 8 of 14 for 118 yards and an interception maye averaged a 3 42 second time to throw the second longest of his career with 25 of his attempts coming outside the pocket the fourth highest rate of his career outside the pocket maye went 3 of 7 for 57 yards and an interception totaling eight scramble dropbacks

news_mentions.headline: John Harbaugh on why Giants cut Odell Beckham Jr.: 'We weren't getting enough'
news_mentions.body_text: the new york giants released wide receiver odell beckham on tuesday beckham drafted by new york in 2014 rejoined the giants this offseason in a much celebrated reunion however the 33 year old 39 s second act in new york did not go the way he or the team hoped beckham made little impact in the giants 39 first three games this season fielding just one target and failing to record a catch he played just 20 snaps this year according to pro football reference 34 we just weren 39 t getting enough 34 coach john harbaugh said wednesday 34 it just wasn 39 t working for us like i told him i wanted to be able to give more i wanted him to be able to do more i wanted to get him on the field more for whatever reason we weren 39 t able to do it put it on us we weren 39 t able to get it done 133 roster spot wise we need more out of that spot 133 it 39 s nothing about odell nothing that he could do 133 i was hoping we could make it work and we didn 39 t 34 34 i hope he lands somewhere he 39 s a great friend i love the guy 34 beckham 39 s lone target this season came this past sunday in the win over the tennessee titans at one point during that game a group of fans began chanting 34 obj obj 34 when the offense was on the field seemingly hoping to spur the team into getting the ball to their beloved star but like his second stint with the franchise it didn 39 t go the way they hoped 34 it 39 s what was best for the team and if you think it was anything else then you don 39 t know me 34 harbaugh said when pressed about why beckham was released 34 it 39 s nothing more than that it 39 s not doing enough for our offense it 39 s not doing enough for our team so we need to make a change 133 there 39 s no deep conversation there 39 s no conspiracy theory we 39 re trying to win games 34 while beckham 39 s release isn 39 t what the team or fans wanted it was always within the range of possibilities for beckham who at this stage of his career isn 39 t the same caliber of receiver who created so many highlight reel plays for the giants during his first few years in new york that was the player who harbaugh hoped he and giants fans would see three days after the beckham signing became official harbaugh talked about what he told beckham before the team signed him 34 we talked about this he would tell you this 39 you can 39 t be just ok you 39 re odell beckham you 39 ve got to come out here and you have to be performing at a high level in workouts you 39 ve got to be performing at a high level in practice you 39 ve got to be a guy capable that we can see would have a chance to make a difference in nfl games you have to be that kind of player 39 34 he understood that so get to work we 39 re going to find out over the course of the next week and training camp if that 39 s going to be something he 39 s going to be able to do for the team if he can great if he can 39 t then that 39 s ok too but he 39 ll have taken his shot 34 as harbaugh said beckham understood that he 39 d have to earn a spot on the roster and late into camp it looked like he might miss the cut he rarely impressed during camp and made mistakes including a dropped touchdown pass during the preseason that a player fighting for a roster spot couldn 39 t afford to make however when veteran receiver calvin austin tore his acl in late august it opened the door for beckham to make the roster and to his credit beckham responded to the opportunity by delivering his strongest week of camp beckham got emotional when he was told after the giants 39 final preseason game that he had made the cut 34 just my family being here seeing my son at the game 133 i had those tears when i got back to the hotel after figuring out i 39 m going to be here 34 beckham said at the time 34 and i have an opportunity to rewrite some of the last bit of the chapter 133 i just know i 39 m going to give my all but definitely had that moment where it was like you could let out some of the pain that i went through it was a very healing very emotional something i was very happy about 34 after releasing beckham the giants signed wide receiver kick returner braxton berrios to their active 53 man roster the team had exhausted his practice squad elevation eligibility the first three weeks berrios is one of four receivers on the 53 man roster joining malik nabers rookie malachi fields and darnell mooney the giants do not plan to bring beckham back to the practice squad this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Jayden Daniels returns to practice, but status vs. Colts remains uncertain
news_mentions.body_text: hertfordshire england the apparatus extends from the biceps down to the forearm with four large straps and a hinge that rests on the outside of the elbow and restricts its motion for jayden daniels this brace is now as much a part of his uniform as his jersey and helmet it 39 s a necessity and a reason the commanders 39 quarterback was back on the field just two weeks after dislocating his left elbow for the second time daniels traveled with the commanders to london on tuesday night and took part in their non padded workout held outside the team 39 s hotel wednesday afternoon it was daniels 39 first on field work in front of reporters since reinjuring his elbow and a significant step in his return to playing daniels was formally listed as a limited participant in the team 39 s lighter workout but coach dan quinn wouldn 39 t make any declaration about daniels 39 status for sunday when the commanders host the colts at tottenham hotspur stadium 34 as we get into thursday and friday we 39 ll see what that load looks like and then by friday we 39 ll have a definite determination of where we 39 re at 34 quinn said 34 but until then we 39 ll work and start the process but it 39 d be too early to call it 34 so there 39 s a chance daniels could play sunday but how big or small of a chance quinn wouldn 39 t say if daniels doesn 39 t play this weekend against the colts then it 39 s plausible he returns for a week 5 game against the new york giants at northwest stadium 34 the pain tolerance for him he already has a high one 34 quinn said 34 so it 39 s more with this specific injury the functionality the strength 133 certainly having the brace is going to be a big part for him he 39 ll wear that the entire season but i would say there 39 s a known entity of when you 39 re ready so without going through all the steps you just don 39 t know yet 34 for better or worse daniels has been here before he first dislocated the elbow in a week 9 loss to the seattle seahawks last season and missed three games four weeks with the bye before returning but he aggravated the elbow in his first game back so the commanders shut him down for the rest of the season daniels had seemingly no lingering issues with his elbow when he returned for the offseason program and then training camp earlier this year but multiple studies suggest one elbow dislocation can make each subsequent one more likely and one fluke play in dallas seemed to validate the research daniels dislocated his elbow again when he tried to brace his fall after stumbling off the line of scrimmage daniels 39 left guard chris paul stepped on his foot just as he fielded the snap and turned to roll out causing him to stumble and fall daniels 39 arm bent in at the elbow and he immediately grabbed it in obvious discomfort daniels was carted off the field and ruled out for the remainder of the game as well as the team 39 s home opener against the seahawks the following week as marcus mariota prepared to start in his place daniels crossed the country to visit orthopedic specialists in new york and los angeles to determine the best course of action for his elbow 34 he 39 s always a person in good spirits but you could tell that this being the second time around he 39 s comfortable with where he 39 s at 34 mariota said on wednesday 34 he 39 s comfortable with this process and however long it 39 s going to take 34 because daniels did not suffer a fracture or extensive ligament damage in his elbow and because the injury is to his non throwing arm he was able to resume throwing in a relatively short time the commanders did not place him on injured reserve and general manager adam peters said surgery was not an immediate consideration but peters never ruled out the possibility of daniels needing surgery to stabilize his elbow at some point after the season for now however his focus is on getting back to playing 34 at the end of the day i think if he 39 s healthy and he can play he should play 34 mariota said 34 this is his team and the more that we can help support that and give him all the tools that he needs to be successful that 39 s what our roles are 34 daniels 39 brace can keep his elbow stable while he plays but ensuring he 39 s comfortable with it and has the mobility to do what he needs will be key 34 we 39 re not going to put him out there before he 39 s ready so that 39 s why it 39 s important for us to trust the process as we 39 re going 34 quinn said 34 but him being back on the field is like man that 39 s a good step for us and then we 39 ll take it from there 34 this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Next Woman Up: Jill Costanza, Lions Assistant Strength & Conditioning/Director of Sports Science
news_mentions.description: In this installment of the Next Woman Up series, Jill Costanza details her role as the Detroit Lions' assistant strength & conditioning coach/director of sports science, her non-linear path to the NFL and the most rewarding part of her job.
news_mentions.body_text: women are rising up the ranks throughout professional football earning positions of power in a space that for too long was ruled almost exclusively by men we re seeing more and more women breaking barriers in the sport but what are the stories beyond the headlines who are the women shaping and influencing the nfl today answering those questions is the aim of the next woman up series while the conversational q as are edited and condensed for clarity this is a forum for impactful women to share experiences in their own words without further ado we introduce jill costanza detroit lions position assistant strength conditioning director of sports science let s start from the beginning how did you get your start in a career in football my dad spent years trying to talk me into coaching he told me i d be a fantastic basketball coach because that was my sport but i wanted no part of it i wanted the glitz and glam of professional sports in a sports marketing sense i thought that was my passion i didn t find a job in marketing but i did find a passion for working with athletes and coaching and that s where i was introduced to strength and conditioning the girls on the team kept getting acl injuries so i turned to todd wright who was the head strength coach at the university of texas at the time and whom i saw speak at a high school basketball conference i saw what he was doing with the players and how he wasn t using a traditional weight room model it was like this light bulb moment of this is what i want to do i went back to school to get my master s degree in strength and conditioning from the university of miami because it had a program specific to sport performance instead of general exercise physiology i went back to the university of texas to do an internship and as life takes you on different paths i ended up in the military aspect the military was really making a push toward human performance hiring contractors to set up models similar to what you see in college athletics and professional sports i took that opportunity and spent three years with army and two years with air force special forces which is where i met mike clark who was dan campbell s head strength coach at texas a m many years ago during campbell s college playing days that s how i got into football when coach campbell got the head coaching job in detroit he made a call to coach clark to be the human performance director and i was the first person he asked to come with him so what does your role entail sports science was a fairly new profession in the u s when i was at texas but if you really wanted to write your ticket you learned that side of things to pair with strength and conditioning it s about understanding what you re tracking with different technology why you re tracking it and better yet how to communicate those findings with coaches which i learned from my mentor sandy abney that aspect allows you to assess the effectiveness of your training program any interventions that are needed and return to play plans so i jumped in and learned as much as i could thankfully what i did with the air force special forces was more on the sports science side less strength and conditioning so i was able to enhance my skills coach clark liked that i could be in a dual role but i would say my role is more strength and conditioning i m on the floor coaching more often than i am working on the sports science side because players need to warm up then we re on the practice field in the weight room helping with recovery all of that that makes sense what does a week look like for you during the regular season on monday we immediately start looking at game data and the gps metrics to understand the demands of the game and which players took a high load the players do a recovery lift that day as well players are off tuesdays so that s our time to catch up on injury reports with the head of strength and conditioning josh schuler and start thinking about return to play protocols for players coming back from injury wednesdays and thursdays are heavy hitters we have a lift in the morning then the players practice we also have a lift session after practice for whoever didn t lift in the morning i ll spend the rest of the afternoon looking at practice data to get a report ready for coach campbell telling him where certain players are at and what would you say is the most challenging part of your job we try to individualize training as much as possible so it s a lot of piecing together the puzzle players have previous injuries which sometimes make them more susceptible to additional injuries it s a lot of figuring out where the weak link is with certain players and constantly thinking outside of the box to help them i would also say the mental energy that s required day after day to get the players what they need is also a challenge oh that s interesting why do you think you ve had so much success in your career my authenticity i have never chased an opportunity they have always been presented to me i really try to wear blinders focus on me and my growth not getting so caught up in what everyone else is doing i have a strong sense of self and trust that the right people will present the right opportunities that s a great answer when was the last time you had a pinch me moment the nfc championship game in san francisco that was pretty amazing the history of this team and making it there it was like wow the game didn t go as planned but reaching that game was a highlight what goals do you have moving forward i do have an innate sense of leadership and that is where i foresee my career going i would love to step into a director s role i don t want to just check a box because i and so many other women deserve to be here we re making a huge impact and that s just what i foresee myself continuing to do now let s turn to mentorship do you have any mentors and what advice have you received from them two main mentors come to mind sandy abney whom i mentioned earlier and shaun mcpherson former strength and conditioning coach at the university of texas i learned so much from him and i m probably most grateful that he threw me into the fire there would be days when he d turn to me and say jill you re running the team warmup today or you re running their workout today you never want to look like you don t know what you re doing so he really challenged me in that sense he taught me so much about coaching building relationships trusting yourself and being ready for when an opportunity presents itself then coach clark who brought me here and josh schuler he has been such a proponent for me and given me a support system i m so very grateful for those four thank you for sharing that now flipping it forward what advice do you have for other women looking to get into a career in a similar space it has not been a linear path and patience is definitely needed getting the job you want may not happen immediately but that doesn t mean it s not going to happen there are so many phenomenal experiences that you can have outside of football that help you grow as a person not just knowledge but people skills emotional intelligence empathy being able to relate to different cultures different people and different experiences it just really helps you gain wisdom which cannot be taught except through experience so if it doesn t happen right away just be grateful for any experience that you have because it helps you maintain that strong connection to self trust your path it doesn t matter at what age you achieve your goal this didn t happen for me until i was 41 i m hopeful i am an example for women of all ages there s a divine spark within all of us and life sometimes makes that flame go down a little bit but you just pour some kerosene on it and light it back up it s never too late that s great advice finally what are you most proud of in your career when an athlete comes back and thanks me for helping them or tells me this is the best they have ever felt my training methodologies sometimes are a little outside of traditional strength and conditioning practices but when i hear that from the guys i think ok you re doing something right to be able to help athletes that i work with not just play their sport better but to feel better and give them some hope is everything

news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 3 Sunday aftermath: Tyler Loop's heroics, Drake Maye concerns, Brock Purdy's MVP form
news_mentions.description: Kevin Patra breaks down the key NFL storylines you need to know after Sunday's 14 games, including Tyler Loop's heroics in Rio de Janeiro, Drake Maye's increasingly concerning play and Brock Purdy's MVP form.
news_mentions.body_text: week 3 was all about the nail biter of sunday s 14 games 12 ended within one score and most came down to the final play including matthew stafford s last second interception to cement the rams second half collapse at denver in the nightcap let s run through key storylines in the aftermath of a sunday that provided a plethora of heart palpitations including the patriots have a drake maye problem an examination of the 3 0 raiders staying power how brock purdy s mvp form is helping the 49ers overcome is there any hope for the league s 0 3 squads a player who continues to prove why he got paid but first we head to brazil which hosted an early contender for game of the season on sunday tyler loop nails game winning field goal in rio football s ability to inspire never ceases ravens kicker tyler loop rode a rocky path during his rookie campaign culminating in a season ending miss in the team s week 18 loss to the rival steelers with the afc north title and the accompanying playoff berth on the line that pushed 44 yard kick attempt set in motion an offseason of change in baltimore loop fended off questions about his future keeping his job despite the immense fallout a blocked attempt in week 2 s disappointing loss to the saints revived questions about the 2025 draft pick then on sunday in rio de janeiro loop got his shot to brush away the haze of the past after the ravens defense bowed up and kept dallas out of the end zone late in the fourth quarter seven seconds remained in 31 31 game lamar jackson rocketed a missile that zay flowers leaped to snag for a 27 yard gain with the receiver immediately getting down as jackson called a timeout with 1 second remaining and the ball now at dallas 38 yard line loop lined up the 56 yard attempt and calmly banged it through with cbs sports jim nantz eloquently calling the game winning boot a trio in rio ravens players celebrated with their sometimes maligned kicker as they pulled off a last second victory despite stumbles along the way loop s kick on sunday didn t erase the previous big miss or guarantee anything about his future however it provided oxygen to a flickering flame that one kick could have revived a career i was saying on the sideline your legacy starting now because i feel like he has been facing adversity jackson said of loop i said what a way to start your legacy in brazil and he finished the rest he did it shout out to special teams shout out to loop jackson s part shouldn t be understated either his ability to deliver that late laser over the middle without taking too much time was pivotal as was flowers snag and haste to get down the ravens moved the ball well on sunday but they also were stuffed in short yardage situations several times in a young season in jesse minter s first campaign the 34 31 win showed fortitude from the defense keeping the cowboys out of the end zone on their final drive to jackson making a play to loop nailing the winner it s the type of victory that could propel a team the ravens needed the win in a hotly contested division the steelers offense showed life in a 30 27 victory over the bengals with aaron rodgers finally hitting on some deep strikes after two weeks of them falling incomplete if the pittsburgh offense can keep splashing plays and rodgers isn t broken in half the steelers will be a tough out cincinnati s defense came back to the pack a bit after an excellent start to the season that s not too much of a surprise that s not why cincy lost however special teams issues were the real killer as the punt crew gave the steelers extra chances joe burrow still had a shot late but a final drive fumble sealed it it s a stinging loss to a division rival but not one that should worry bengals fans the browns defense was locked in again to improve cleveland to 2 1 stymying bryce young and a panthers offense that had moved the ball well in the first two weeks deshaun watson showed that when he avoids the big mistake he can be a net positive for cleveland and make game winning plays that s new patriots have a drake maye problem the patriots were pegged to regress in 2026 partly because of their tougher schedule after winning the afc east that might be one element of new england s 1 2 start but it s far from the story the biggest issue isn t that the pats are facing teams that make them pay for mistakes it s that drake maye has regressed to the point that he s making rookie level blunders in year 3 week 1 s calamitous turnover fest in seattle has snowballed maye has seven giveaways through the first three games of the season the most by any player in the nfl his seven turnovers are the most by a patriots player in the team s first three games of a season over the last 30 years per nfl research perhaps he can explain away the embarrassing fumble in sunday s blowout loss to jacksonville saying there was blood on the ball from the center but there was no excuse for his second quarter interception in the end zone it was a ball that should never have been thrown that s maye s biggest issue right now he s not seeing things clearly defenses studied his weaknesses all offseason and he hasn t adjusted until maye does more upchucks like sunday s performance will ensue i think quarterbacks want to make plays vrabel said monday morning on the greg hill show via espn s mike reiss i think they want to throw touchdowns i think sometimes when greg and i go golfing we really want to make a good score right sometimes we re so focused on it we try to choke the life out of the golf club and we re squeezing it so damn tight that the ball has no choice but to go sideways we need to stop trying to choke the life out of every single play we need to relax we need to settle in and go play football and not try to force things that aren t there are 3 0 raiders for real i already noted last week that the way las vegas has been winning is different under klint kubiak it feels repeatable the defense has been opportunistic taking advantage of turnovers las vegas had four takeaways in the fourth quarter of its week 3 win at new orleans the raiders had only three fourth quarter takeaways in the entire 2025 season according to nfl research it s also the first time a team has forced at least four fourth quarter takeaways in a game since the cowboys in week 13 of 2022 vs the colts yes the raiders benefited from a controversial fumble call on tyler shough it also takes players creating such opportunities to benefit from them tight end brock bowers return was pivotal vegas doesn t win in nola without his 10 catch 116 yard one td performance kubiak deployed bowers all over the formation in line and detached making him a matchup nightmare despite bowers missing the first two games after undergoing a knee procedure a magical season for the te appears quite viable with kirk cousins force feeding his top target this offense needs one more outside option to be complete the raiders are the darlings of the league right now and rightfully so kubiak has quickly shown he can win in the big chair his coordinators have been excellent cousins has been steady playmakers are making plays but i should point out that the raiders opponents are a combined 1 8 through three weeks the real test comes in next sunday when kansas city visits las vegas it s a great f ing win raiders star defender maxx crosby said postgame in the locker room but we ve got a great f ing team coming into town we already know what it is it s the f ing kansas city chiefs enjoy this s tonight take care of your bodies and we re f ing on a warpath to get what we want men 49ers dominating but injuries continue to pile up san francisco 49ers fans should thank their stars for brock purdy and christian mccaffrey and pray they don t succumb to the injury bug that continues to plague the club purdy is on an mvp tear through three games the qb has been laser accurate always finding the right target and rarely making unforced errors he threw for 297 yards and four touchdowns with zero turnovers in sunday s win over the cardinals it marked his 14th career game with a 130 passer rating the most by any player before turning 27 in league history surpassing lamar jackson per nfl research purdy is now tied with hall of famer joe montana for the second most games with a 130 passer rating in 49ers history trailing only hall of famer steve young 22 purdy s ability to hit his targets in stride sets up extra yards his td pass to mike evans was the latest how on earth did he drop that into the tiniest window throw from the 49ers qb this season precision purdy the niners have needed purdy and mccaffrey to max out as the rest of the club continues to deal with injuries on sunday evans exited with a rib injury and offensive tackle trent williams suffered a stinger while linebacker dre greenlaw left with a quad issue with nick bosa calf expected to miss multiple weeks the injuries on defense have begun to take their toll as they did last year and the cardinals were able to scrap their way back into the contest on sunday making the score look closer than the contest felt with better defenses on the horizon denver in week 4 and seattle in week 5 we ll see if purdy s mvp level play continues assessing playoff hopes for 0 3 squads according to nfl research only seven teams in nfl history have started the season 0 3 and gone on to make the playoffs the houston texans teams of 2025 and 2018 are the only teams to do so since 2000 currently five teams sit at 0 3 the texans chargers dolphins buccaneers and titans let s take a quick look at each team week 3 sunday spotlight
