news_mentions.headline: NFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Commanders, Cowboys, Eagles, Giants
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Dallas Cowboys, New York Giants, Philadelphia Eagles and Washington Commanders.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles and washington commanders catch up on each nfc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles washington commanders three key storylines 1 summer bliss with pickens and no drama in oxnard aside from some contract squabbles with george pickens and brandon aubrey that were tame by cowboys standards this has been a drama free offseason for dallas will that change during training camp in oxnard california it s been a breath of fresh air that s even drawn applause from one of the greatest cowboys ever nfl all time leading rusher emmitt smith with dallas locked in on snapping a two year playoff drought the on field focus bodes well avoiding major storylines might well be the biggest development of the summer for the boys july 28 looms large for the team as it s when players are set to report to camp and owner jerry jones traditionally addresses the media in a lengthy news conference the cowboys have been transparent about not negotiating an extension with pickens who has signed his franchise tag and stated he doesn t intend to hold out we ll see just how copacetic everything remains when camp kicks off 2 downs arrives with plenty of hype ohio state safety caleb downs was viewed as a top line talent in this year s draft the cowboys getting him at no 11 overall was a major boon since joining the team downs has garnered rave reviews the highest defensive selection for the franchise since morris claiborne at no 6 in 2012 downs fills a massive db need for dallas and could prove to be a steal how he looks when the pads are on will be must see viewing for the fans at camp and a pivotal point in the cowboys defensive reconstruction downs isn t the cowboys only 2026 first round selection though picked 23rd overall malachi lawrence is a pass rusher who some felt went earlier than he should ve he has plenty of upside though and the cowboys have plenty of pass rushing needs to fill after mustering just 35 sacks in 2025 tied for 22nd in the league 3 a whole new world on defense dallas defense was a sieve in 2025 finishing dead last in points allowed and 30th in total d perhaps it wasn t too surprising considering the cowboys traded away micah parsons just before the season arrived nonetheless the disastrous results led to matt eberflus ousting young whippersnapper christian parker has taken over as defensive coordinator and garnered plenty of positive buzz he ll helm a defense that has undergone a colossal facelift in the offseason in addition to a pair of first rounders added to the mix dallas has signed safeties jalen thompson and p j locke along with cornerback cobie durant whilst trading for pass rusher rashan gary and linebacker dee winters dallas also has a full season ahead with pro bowler quinnen williams after he too was acquired via trade last season 2025 third round corner shavon revel played just seven games as a rookie rallying from an acl tear in college with downs likely to start from the get go lawrence and a host of other defensive draft picks have replenished the depth the turnover on this side of the ball is staggering but a fresh coat was needed after such a trying 2025 how the finished product ultimately looks will begin to take shape at camp for as ballyhooed as the dak prescott led offense has been the cowboys 2021 23 run of playoff appearances came with an offense and a defense ranked in the top seven in scoring back to top three key storylines 1 can giants get healthy stay healthy in camp harbaugh john harbaugh after 18 years with the ravens has arrived in gotham with plenty of fanfare but his team has already dealt with an alarming amount of injury exits rookie cornerback thaddeus dixon wide receiver special teamer gunner olszewski and defensive lineman roy robertson harris each stunningly suffered a torn achilles during organized team activities robertson harris injury is especially problematic considering the team traded away standout defensive tackle dexter lawrence abdul carter sprained his ankle in june while top receivers malik nabers knee and darius slayton core muscle surgery and second year running back cam skattebo ankle are on the mend as well monitoring the availability of nabers and skattebo for week 1 will carry on through the summer even though the latter has deemed himself a sure bet for the opener with harbaugh reputed to run tough practices the giants healing up and emerging unscathed is paramount 2 this is dart s team now at the start of last season jaxson dart waited his turn behind russell wilson after eventually getting handed the starting reins the first round pick weathered a debut campaign that saw him deal with injuries scrutiny for his devil may care scrambling and the firing of head coach brian daboll daboll and interim head coach mike kafka took turns navigating dart s first season now it s up to matt nagy to shepherd dart s growth the floor for dart is staying healthy the ceiling is what the big blue faithful are most excited about dart s development as a franchise signal caller is arguably the most important factor for the 2026 giants hype and hope have early expiration dates in the nfl so dart s second season is already a pivotal one after the qb showed plenty of potential 24 total touchdowns in his career opening campaign 3 big blue youth movement taking shape over the past two drafts the giants have stockpiled four first round picks carter dart lb arvell reese and ol francis mauigoa rookie wr malachi fields and first year cb colton hood a pair of day 2 picks in april figure to be big contributors though there is sterling veteran talent such as lt andrew thomas and olb brian burns the giants are a young squad looking to lay a winning foundation in the first year under harbaugh high draft spots and hype can provide anticipation but seeing the youngsters round into form this summer will be crucial for 2026 and beyond back to top three key storylines 1 hurts newest offensive scheme sean mannion is the latest offensive coordinator for the eagles and jalen hurts who truly found offensive bliss in 2022 his second and final season with shane steichen since then hurts has had a different offensive coordinator in each season even with kellen moore during a super bowl winning 2024 campaign philadelphia s passing game ebbed and flowed while running back saquon barkley largely fueled the offense drama was more prevalent last season than offensive chemistry as the passing game ranked 23rd in yards and the sputtering running attack diminished from the previous season s dominance hurts had a career best 25 touchdown passes but snapped a four season streak of double digit rushing scores finishing with eight last year s offense was far too predictable and stagnated on a seemingly weekly basis held to 20 points or less in 10 games including a dismal 23 19 playoff loss to the 49ers with o line guru jeff stoutland no longer coaching a group that was really the heartbeat of both of the eagles super bowl squads under nick sirianni the offense is undergoing more change than the annual alterations everyone s accustomed to a j brown is gone traded to the patriots in an offseason storyline that lingered for months all eyes are on hurts whose past accomplishments don t seem to hold too much weight with a feisty fanbase that believes its strong roster should be vying for lombardi trophies every year 2 new look wide receivers after four seasons two super bowl appearances and one lombardi trophy a j brown has departed philadelphia while brown s disharmony commanded the headlines he topped 1 000 yards receiving in each of his four years with the team devonta smith is now the unquestioned top target but gm howie roseman restocked the wr room with a trade for dontayvion wicks the signing of veteran speedster marquise brown and in the most exciting move the first round selection of makai lemon don t sleep on second round tight end eli stowers either the john mackey award winner from vanderbilt could line up all over the field as a 6 foot 4 matchup nightmare dallas goedert is back likely for one final season and smith one of the more underrated wideouts around adds to the familiarity overall though there is a freshness to the group that will need to come together in the summer but could liven up an all too often static offense from a season ago 3 what becomes of carter jalen carter seems to be on the brink of becoming perhaps the league s elite defensive tackle hence he s seeking a seismic extension which has led to trade speculation how it all plays out is sure to be headline fodder and it wouldn t feel right to be without some melodrama in philly furthermore defensive coordinator vic fangio is back and losing carter would be a magnificent blow a potential boon will be the additions of cornerback tariq woolen and pass rusher jonathan greenard no matter the pedigree not all players fit into fangio s scheme see bryce huff jalen ramsey jevon holland etc woolen is a physically gifted cover man who made his share of questionable plays with the seahawks it will be interesting seeing how the newbies fit into fangio s scheme but the prevailing matter at hand for the defense is carter s future back to top three key storylines 1 plenty on daniels plate there s a lot to accomplish for jayden daniels this summer following a disastrous 2025 season the commanders sputtered and the 2024 ap offensive rookie of the year missed 10 games due to injuries going just 2 5 in the games he played how daniels looks and feels after sustaining a sprained knee strained hamstring and dislocated left elbow is tops on the agenda he also needs to get acclimated to david blough s offense which will see daniels taking snaps under center far more now that his former assistant qb coach is his offensive coordinator after two seasons with kliff kingsbury in that role daniels is also in the latest season of netflix s quarterback series all eyes and a heap of responsibility will be on daniels how he bounces back and how well he adapts to a new offense could be the story of the commanders season 2 how does overhauled defense look when you fall from being everyone s nfc championship game darling to a 5 12 struggle bus you can run out of fingers to point the commanders put a massive under construction sign in front of a defense that finished dead last in yards allowed they used the no 7 overall pick on ohio state linebacker sonny styles an athletic marvel who will draw plenty of hype as a preseason defensive rookie of the year candidate general manager adam peters opened the check book before turning in the card to get styles too washington broke the bank to sign pass rusher odafe oweh while adding plenty more veteran starters elsewhere nickel amik robertson safety nick cross pass rusher k 39 lavon chaisson linebacker leo chenal and defensive tackle tim settle the commanders added veteran depth as well binging on free agents isn t always a winning formula of course how quickly new defensive coordinator daronte jones and washington s cast of fresh faces get on the same page will be crucial in camp 3 all set at skill spots daniels injuries were a giant issue in 2025 but not surrounding the blossoming franchise qb with enough talent at the skill spots also loomed large looking at the offensive roster on paper it s difficult to feel the commanders have remedied those ills terry mclaurin who dealt with a contract kerfuffle last year as well as ankle quad and pelvic injuries will hopefully be back to his pro bowl self with a full camp and good health however the team s wr corps hasn t added much to get overjoyed about dyami brown and van jefferson were signed in free agency while treylon burks and luke mccaffrey are both back none of those four reached 30 receptions or 400 yards in 2025 rookie third rounder antonio williams figures to jump right into the mix and will likely need to be a big contributor quickly elsewhere jacory croskey merritt should be the lead back after an 805 yard rookie campaign but he was hardly a consistent producer in year 1 the most notable additions are former titans tight end chigoziem okonkwo who should be a breakout candidate after three straight 50 catch seasons with tennessee and ex buccaneers running back rachaad white with blough s promotion to oc familiarity remains but this offensive roster is certainly a candidate for a veteran add or two in the weeks before the regular season commences back to top

news_mentions.headline: Steelers vs. Browns: Three must-know storylines for Thursday's Week 4 prime-time game
news_mentions.description: Who will rise to the occasion with first place in the AFC North on the line? In advance of Thursday's game between the Steelers and Browns, Dan Parr provides three storylines you need to know.
news_mentions.body_text: we begin october with a prime time matchup steeped in higher stakes than anyone expected when the schedule was first announced thanks to the browns surprising 2 1 start the vibes are trending upward in cleveland and pittsburgh with both squads pulling off week 3 upsets but they re about to get even better for one team thursday night s winner will officially lead the afc north entering week 5 regardless of other results will the steelers begin exorcising some nearly decade old demons in aaron rodgers final nfl season can the browns above 500 for the first time since 2023 shock the world by rising to the top of the only division in which every team has a winning record entering week 4 three must know storylines 1 can pittsburgh shake the ghosts of cleveland trips past just in time for spooky season the steelers are about to enter what s become their house of horrors pittsburgh has won only one of its last eight games in cleveland dating back to 2018 with three of those losses coming in thursday night games the steelers scored a season low six points when they visited huntington bank field on a rainy sunday late last season perhaps mike mccarthy has the mojo to break the franchise s tnf curse in his first year on the job mccarthy has won seven straight thursday games as a head coach with the cowboys and he s apparently leaving no stone unturned as he looks for an edge in his first prime time game as coach of his hometown team including consideration of a day of game bus trip before ruling it out 2 will the steelers offense wither under the browns pressure pittsburgh erupted for 30 points in this past sunday s win over the bengals but was it just a mirage after all since 2025 the steelers have scored 31 7 points per game against the bengals and 20 9 points per game against all other opponents the triumph over cincinnati was one of rodgers best games since joining the steelers prior to last season the four time mvp tied for his most passing yards under pressure in a game since week 10 of 2020 and he threw two deep 20 air yards touchdown passes in the first quarter after he had failed to complete a deep throw on nine attempts in the first two weeks cleveland s defense might be starting to cook again though as it learns to live without myles garrett the browns have the second highest qb pressure rate in the league 42 2 and dt mason graham the fifth overall pick in the 2025 draft appears to have arrived posting four sacks in the first three games tied for second most in the league steady heat from the interior or any direction really would spell doom for the 42 year old rodgers but one way to wear down the browns front would be to pound the ball on the ground with rico dowdle sidelined by a toe injury against cincy jaylen warren posted a career high 176 scrimmage yards on 20 touches forcing 10 missed tackles he could find the sledding tougher this week 3 does the browns offense have another gear cleveland ranks among the bottom five offenses in total yards per game pass yards per game rush yards per game third down conversion rate and red zone touchdown percentage so while deshaun watson just became only the fourth browns qb in the last 35 seasons to throw multiple td passes and no interceptions in consecutive wins there s obviously still a long way to go for todd monken s offense there are budding browns playmakers who could pose problems for patrick graham s defense rookie receivers denzel boston and kc concepcion are promising talents but they each were held to two catches in week 3 s win over carolina harold fannin is one of the best young tight ends in the league cleveland could use a jolt from the quinshon judkins led running game but it won t help matters if starting center elgton jenkins concussion protocol is unable to play against the steelers editor s update jenkins has been ruled out of thursday s game pittsburgh still can throw t j watt alex highsmith nick herbig and cameron heyward at a cleveland offensive line that probably won t be operating at full strength and keep an eye on steelers second year dt derrick harmon who sealed the win over the bengals with a strip sack of joe burrow it s worth watching jalen ramsey s status too the eight time pro bowl db revealed on tuesday that he has a broken wrist but didn t rule out playing through it watson had his best performance of the season as a runner last week 11 rushes for 45 yards and his ability to create with his legs will be essential for the browns to counter the steelers pressure

news_mentions.headline: Steelers trading CB Joey Porter Jr. to Cowboys in exchange for second-, sixth-round picks
news_mentions.description: The Pittsburgh Steelers are trading cornerback Joey Porter Jr. to the Dallas Cowboys in exchange for a 2027 sixth-round pick and a 2028 second-round pick, NFL Network's Jane Slater reported Wednesday evening.
news_mentions.body_text: the steel city impasse is over the pittsburgh steelers are trading cornerback joey porter to the dallas cowboys in exchange for a 2027 sixth round pick and a 2028 second round pick nfl network s jane slater reported wednesday evening netflix s tom pelissero first reported the trade the cowboys announced the transaction porter entering the final season of his 2023 rookie contract was seeking an extension but he and pittsburgh were unable to come to terms the 26 year old porter had missed each of the steelers first three games this season he was listed as having a back injury throughout training camp but as of late had appeared on the steelers practice report as being a full or limited participant due to conditioning earlier thursday porter had been ruled out for the team s thursday night game against the cleveland browns with the designation officially for not injury related conditioning back now the consternation in pittsburgh has concluded and porter whose father was a four time pro bowler and super bowl champion with the steelers from 1999 2011 will move on to helping the cowboys shore up a defense that was supposed to be much improved but has continued to be a disappointment steelers and former cowboys head coach mike mcmarthy was upfront in declaring pittsburgh and porter at an impasse this offseason before general manager omar khan declared that there would be no negotiations during the season meanwhile porter hadn t been practicing instead stationed on the physically unable to perform list throughout training camp with the aforementioned back injury he was removed from the pup list on sunday aug 31 to be included on the team s initial 53 man roster days later porter indicated there was a chance he would not play this year without a new deal as it turns out he would never play for the steelers again porter s desire for a lucrative second career contract came as pittsburgh had been shoring up its 2023 draft class having locked up 23 third rounder darnell washington and 23 fourth rounder nick herbig before signing porter s fellow second rounder keeanu bentonto an extension another steelers 2023 pick they did not re sign was first round pick broderick jones who was also traded to the cowboys jones has played in all three games for dallas but just one of his 17 snaps have come on offense porter was taken 32nd overall to begin the second round the 2023 draft had only 31 first round selections after the miami dolphins were penalized and lost theirs and was a mainstay in the steelers starting lineup over the past three years the 6 foot 2 193 pounder has been solid in coverage but has struggled in the run game at times nonetheless he d been a key cog for pittsburgh with 41 starts in three seasons 165 tackles three interceptions and 31 pass breakups he ll join first year cowboys defensive coordinator christian parker whose unit is 30th in total defense the cowboys 1 2 who haven t logged an interception this season have one cornerback spot locked down by daron bland while shavon revel and cobie durant have also earned starts both missed practice on wednesday dallas travels to play the houston texans 0 3 on sunday

news_mentions.headline: NFL QB rankings, Week 4: Brock Purdy climbs to No. 1; Kirk Cousins enters top 10
news_mentions.description: Who unseats Josh Allen at the top of Nick Shook's QB rankings? How high does Kirk Cousins rise? Check out the updated pecking order, 1-32, heading into Week 4 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: notes up down arrows illustrate movement from the week 3 qb index stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl tier 1 brock purdy is building a strong early case for mvp through three weeks lighting up defenses with ease and looking completely comfortable directing kyle shanahan s offense i m fascinated to see if he can keep it up against denver s defense this weekend patrick mahomes took care of business against a scrappy dolphins defense in week 3 he shook off a big hit that drew a roughing the passer penalty and left him clutching his lower back to help the chiefs leave miami with a two score victory dak prescott continues to power a cowboys offense that can throw it against anyone and will be required to do so as long as their defense continues to lag behind it was especially nice to see him connect with both ceedee lamb and george pickens against the ravens josh allen was a bit of a mess against the chargers turning the ball over three times his second half fumble should have cost the bills much more than it did he s good for one of these games per year so i m not too concerned about what it means going forward after crumbling against the broncos trevor lawrence got back on the horse and torched the patriots he produced a wildly entertaining sequence in which he threw two absurd touchdown passes to parker washington the first was nullified by penalty but i still wish he wouldn t have taken a knee when he was six inches from a rushing score and there were still nine minutes left in the game if you re not watching him throw the football you need to catch up before week 4 it s among the prettiest displays in the nfl next gen stats insight via nfl pro purdy threw for 297 yards and four touchdowns in the 49ers week 3 win over the cardinals purdy was most efficient in the quick passing game finishing 8 of 10 for 180 yards and two touchdowns his 18 yards per attempt on quick passes is the highest mark in a game in the ngs era among qbs with at least 10 quick attempts purdy targeted george kittle on five of his 10 quick throws with kittle catching four of those passes for 50 yards and a td tier 2 jared goff has been excellent in 2026 powering a passing attack that isn t afraid to rely heavily on jahmyr gibbs to open up opportunities elsewhere it s similar to what we ve seen from goff in recent years although they re weathering offensive line challenges better than they did last season lamar jackson wasn t quite stellar against the cowboys in rio but he delivered in key spots and benefitted greatly from the return of zay flowers joe burrow is making big plays and leaning heavily on ja marr chase when he s in need of a completion but the steelers strip sack of burrow cost the bengals a chance to secure a thrilling win matthew stafford s second half struggles against the broncos pressure dampened the fun i ve had watching him connect with davante adams it s pretty clear stafford misses puka nacua kirk cousins is off to a fantastic start throwing three touchdown passes in each of his first three contests that ties his longest career streak of games with at least three td passes and gives him the nfl s longest active such streak that s a sentence i know you didn t expect to read in 2026 next gen stats insight via nfl pro the broncos generated pressure on 59 3 of dropbacks in the second half against the rams after doing so on only 23 5 of dropbacks in the first half against pressure stafford completed just 6 of 20 passes for 81 yards taking four sacks and throwing a pick six from a clean pocket stafford finished 24 of 35 for 309 yards two touchdowns and an interception tier 3 this is admittedly a strange week for the qb index two backups case keenum and marcus mariota excelled in different ways in their first starts of 2026 both led their teams to thrilling home wins and aaron rodgers played perhaps his best game since he was a packer anyone who thinks the jets have lost two in a row due to quarterback play is very much mistaken geno smith has been very sharp and heroically threw new york back into a game at detroit that came down to the wire before he fumbled to end the jets chances we probably won t have another week like this for quite some time so fans of graybeards should soak it up while we re here sam darnold s return from injury was fraught with turnovers but between the back breaking mistakes he made some fantastic throws primarily to jaxon smith njigba and piled up 379 passing yards next gen stats insight via nfl pro rodgers completed 6 of 11 pass attempts under pressure for 121 yards and a touchdown in the steelers week 3 win rodgers tied for his most passing yards under pressure in a game since week 10 of 2020 he entered week 3 with a 43 5 completion percentage and 92 passing yards under pressure this season rodgers threw two deep 20 air yards td passes in the first quarter after he had failed to complete a single deep pass on nine attempts through the first two weeks tier 4 jacoby brissett let it fire 52 times out of necessity against the 49ers and is finding consistent success by leaning on trey mcbride unfortunately it doesn t look like he can carry the cardinals to victory against nfc west competition by most standards brissett is embodying the dalton line which is what the cardinals likely hoped to get from him in 2026 tyler shough slips in the rankings after a disastrous fourth quarter against the raiders he accounted for three turnovers in the final 13 minutes reversing course on a reputation that was being built on clutch performances bo nix rises after taking what the rams defense gave him in the second half he did just enough to help the broncos mount a wild comeback although he s still not reliable enough for me to move him any higher c j stroud is largely playing it safe until he absolutely must find a route to the end zone the texans are going to need more from him to dig out of their 0 3 hole justin herbert is making a habit of following up remarkable passes with brain melting mistakes or as tom brady called it during the chargers bills broadcast serving up a meatball sub to the defense bryce young s hot start came to a screeching halt against a feisty browns defense and jalen coker s injury related departure didn t help matters daniel jones accounted for three turnovers and nearly gave the game against the texans away with a fumble before helping the colts move into range for the game winning field goal michael penix started slowly but found a nice rhythm in his first start of 2026 he can thank the football gods for putting him on the same team as bijan robinson deshaun watson hasn t been close to consistent over four quarters but he has made the plays the browns needed late in the last two games he continues to build a promising rapport with rookie receiver denzel boston giving browns fans hope heading into week 4 next gen stats insight via nfl pro herbert finished 20 of 34 for 226 yards one touchdown and one interception in week 3 against the bills on deep throws 20 air yards herbert was 1 of 7 for 29 yards and an interception herbert has now thrown more interceptions on deep balls this season 3 than he did in each of the previous two seasons 2 in 2024 2 in 2025 tier 5 this tier pains me to assemble because i know two of these three quarterbacks hurts and love are much better than their current rankings indicate that might be why they ve dropped so precipitously as their struggles have been especially frustrating to watch jalen hurts began the season by pushing the eagles to two wins with largely positive play while sprinkling in a few errors but his showing in chicago on monday night was downright abysmal it wasn t just the interception hurts reverted to the indecisive quarterback who was unwilling to play aggressively enough to lift the eagles out of the hole they d dug for themselves his coach s crunch time decisions didn t help much either jordan love is in a similarly tough spot his offense lacks a running game his offensive line is banged up and the entire operation is stuck in first gear love will rip a few beautiful throws every week but all it does is tease us because the rest of the experience is filled with nothing but disappointment malik willis is operating in an offense that lost de 39 von achane torn acl and is leaning on a collection of pass catchers that is undoubtedly the worst in the nfl he and the dolphins offense can move the ball but they still have a hard time finishing drives i appreciate the effort he s made but the results remain underwhelming next gen stats insight via nfl pro hurts completed 16 of 25 pass attempts but averaged just 6 1 yards per attempt monday night throwing only six passes 24 10 air yards downfield on those throws he completed two 33 3 for 49 yards all season lows the eagles went three and out on three straight drives to start the third quarter with hurts completing three of five attempts for six yards none of those attempts traveled more than 10 air yards tier 6 i m calling this the searching for answers tier because it s filled with quarterbacks who don t seem to have many right now kyler murray looked unsettled at best in his first game back and justin jefferson s departure due to injury didn t help matters baker mayfield spent another sunday appearing uncomfortable in zac robinson s offense while trying his best to play hero before suffering a thumb injury that will cost him multiple weeks cam ward was the latest to fall victim to a downpour at metlife stadium although he also had a collection of pass catchers drop on target passes before he threw away the titans last chance to win by tossing an interception in the end zone drake maye is the most lost of all accounting for three giveaways an unforced fumble and two ghastly interceptions that tanked the patriots chances of competing in jacksonville seriously throwing their season into uncertain waters of all of these quarterbacks i m most concerned about maye who looks nothing like the nfl mvp finalist he was in 2025 and seems completely adrift and sapped of his confidence jameis winston meanwhile is who he is a cart ride down a mine shaft with no guarantee it leads to daylight but will include a few exciting twists and turns next gen stats insight via nfl pro against pressure maye went 6 of 11 for 81 yards and an interception in week 3 without pressure he went 8 of 14 for 118 yards and an interception maye averaged a 3 42 second time to throw the second longest of his career with 25 of his attempts coming outside the pocket the fourth highest rate of his career outside the pocket maye went 3 of 7 for 57 yards and an interception totaling eight scramble dropbacks

news_mentions.headline: Patriots' Drake Maye: Shoulder not impacting throws; no rift with HC Mike Vrabel
news_mentions.description: Patriots QB Drake Maye told reporters that his right shoulder, which appeared on Wednesday's injury report, is not impacting how he's throwing the ball.
news_mentions.body_text: trouble in paradise now includes a health concern for drake maye the quarterback landed on new england s wednesday injury report with a right shoulder injury but was a full participant in the day s practice maye was asked on wednesday if his shoulder is impacting how he s throwing the football no it hasn t maye said i don t think it impacts my decision making and that s what makes and breaks play for quarterbacks maye instead redirected the attention toward the team s turnover issues which he admitted are holding them back that s this position there are reps in the game and there are ones that cost you maye explained it happens to be that you ve got to outweigh the good with the bad by a wide margin to play well at this position and that s quarterback i m feeling good throwing and i feel like i have some throws i wish i had back as i always do and definitely some decisions but at the same time i ve got to trust my guys and trust the guys up front they re doing a nice job to keep on playing football coach mike vrabel didn t appear to be concerned with his quarterback s status when speaking with reporters prior to wednesday s practice but did have to answer questions regarding a local report from weei s greg hill that suggested there is friction between vrabel and maye he heard from who unnamed sources let me just tell you why i m here vrabel said i m here because drake was the quarterback believe it or not i had choices as to where i wanted to coach i wanted to coach here because drake was the quarterback so i don t have really much other to add to that about a comment from an unnamed source but i ll just tell you what i ve told numerous people if they want to ask me why i m here after three weeks new england is 1 2 but occupies a place that seems much more nightmarish than the team s record might suggest maye has played a major role in their difficulties creating space for the locals to sow discord maye has struggled significantly to start the 2026 season throwing three interceptions in the season s kickoff game a 13 10 loss to seattle and committing seven giveaways in three contests in new england s lopsided 35 6 defeat in jacksonville on sunday maye accounted for all three patriots turnovers including a couple of ghastly interceptions and a fumble in which the ball slipped out of his hand as he was winding to throw his numbers have fallen accordingly after throwing for 4 394 yards and posting a 31 8 td int ratio in 2025 production worthy of an nfl mvp finalist spot maye has completed 63 8 percent of his passes for 585 yards and a 1 6 td int ratio in 2026 his passer rating has dropped by 54 9 points the largest decrease from one season to the next among qualifying quarterbacks in the super bowl era per nfl research at one point during sunday s loss patriots color commentator scott zolak suggested vrabel might bench maye for backup tommy devito it eventually happened in the fourth quarter but only because the game was out of reach afterward vrabel expressed his concern level is very high for this football team an accurate assessment of the defending afc champions who have looked nothing like it through three weeks that doesn t mean vrabel is suddenly at odds with his quarterback coach vrabel s been one of the best football coaches i ve had in my life maye said on wednesday when asked of the reported rift i think coach vrabel s been one of the biggest things as to why this has been so enjoyable for me is playing for coach i think we all feel that way in the locker room he pushes us hard i ve loved playing for him and it s not going to change it hasn t changed and it won t change the way he pushes me and he coaches the quarterbacks in a way that i really respect and i m looking forward to getting going proving to coach that i can lead this football team and play good football instead of spending his days refuting reports of internal conflict vrabel is dedicating himself to helping his quarterback improve it s essential to the patriots efforts of repeating as afc east champions ahead of a big week 4 game at the 3 0 bills on sunday well the same thing i ve been doing just trying to coach the football team trying to coach him vrabel said when asked how he could help maye climb out of his slump i m not going to coach him the x s and o s i mean i can show him the defense and say hey this is what these guys may like to try to do but it s just about the urgency that we have how we operate and how we get in and out of the huddle and the command of the huddle the quarterback is a conduit to offensive coordinator josh mcdaniels and the play caller i firmly believe that the way that they tell the players that they re playing with like hey this is what we re going to do this play is going to work not because it s some great scheme it s going to work because we re going to execute it or we re going to make it work and you get them to believe that whatever he calls is going to be successful now will every one be no that s not how it goes but that s what i try to teach them each and every day maye s partnership with mcdaniels worked wonderfully in 2025 en route to a surprising super bowl trip making their struggles that much more shocking it s early though and as vrabel said if maye can eliminate his negative plays their issues will eventually dissipate just don t expect him to say much more about a rumored conflict

news_mentions.headline: Rams head coach Sean McVay: WR Puka Nacua (hip/groin) expected to return for Rams Sunday vs. Eagles
news_mentions.description: The Los Angeles Rams expect wide receiver Puka Nacua to play in Week 4 against the Philadelphia Eagles after missing the team's last two games with a hip/groin injury.
news_mentions.body_text: the rams are ready to welcome back a major piece of their offense los angeles expects receiver puka nacua to play in sunday s game against the philadelphia eagles coach sean mcvay told reporters wednesday nacua was officially a limited participant in wednesday s practice a sign that he s nearing a return defensive tackle aaron donald meanwhile did not practice to back soreness per mcvay nacua has been battling a hip and groin injury related to his psoas since training camp inspiring concern he might be headed for surgery at some point in 2026 he managed to suit up for the rams season opening loss to the san francisco 49ers in melbourne australia in week 1 catching five passes for 74 yards but he s since been sidelined missing the rams last two games without nacua quarterback matthew stafford has leaned heavily on fellow veteran davante adams connecting with the three time all pro 15 times for 332 yards and two touchdowns in the last two weeks the production has been plentiful but without nacua it s also caused the rams to become a bit more predictable especially in the second half of the rams week 3 loss to denver underscoring their need for nacua s return it sounds as if that will happen sunday against an eagles team that is reeling from a lopsided loss to the chicago bears in which 38 year old quarterback case keenum threw for 247 yards and two touchdowns if nacua can fit back into the offense quickly stafford could be in line for an even more prolific afternoon

news_mentions.headline: John Harbaugh on why Giants cut Odell Beckham Jr.: 'We weren't getting enough'
news_mentions.body_text: the new york giants released wide receiver odell beckham on tuesday beckham drafted by new york in 2014 rejoined the giants this offseason in a much celebrated reunion however the 33 year old 39 s second act in new york did not go the way he or the team hoped beckham made little impact in the giants 39 first three games this season fielding just one target and failing to record a catch he played just 20 snaps this year according to pro football reference 34 we just weren 39 t getting enough 34 coach john harbaugh said wednesday 34 it just wasn 39 t working for us like i told him i wanted to be able to give more i wanted him to be able to do more i wanted to get him on the field more for whatever reason we weren 39 t able to do it put it on us we weren 39 t able to get it done 133 roster spot wise we need more out of that spot 133 it 39 s nothing about odell nothing that he could do 133 i was hoping we could make it work and we didn 39 t 34 34 i hope he lands somewhere he 39 s a great friend i love the guy 34 beckham 39 s lone target this season came this past sunday in the win over the tennessee titans at one point during that game a group of fans began chanting 34 obj obj 34 when the offense was on the field seemingly hoping to spur the team into getting the ball to their beloved star but like his second stint with the franchise it didn 39 t go the way they hoped 34 it 39 s what was best for the team and if you think it was anything else then you don 39 t know me 34 harbaugh said when pressed about why beckham was released 34 it 39 s nothing more than that it 39 s not doing enough for our offense it 39 s not doing enough for our team so we need to make a change 133 there 39 s no deep conversation there 39 s no conspiracy theory we 39 re trying to win games 34 while beckham 39 s release isn 39 t what the team or fans wanted it was always within the range of possibilities for beckham who at this stage of his career isn 39 t the same caliber of receiver who created so many highlight reel plays for the giants during his first few years in new york that was the player who harbaugh hoped he and giants fans would see three days after the beckham signing became official harbaugh talked about what he told beckham before the team signed him 34 we talked about this he would tell you this 39 you can 39 t be just ok you 39 re odell beckham you 39 ve got to come out here and you have to be performing at a high level in workouts you 39 ve got to be performing at a high level in practice you 39 ve got to be a guy capable that we can see would have a chance to make a difference in nfl games you have to be that kind of player 39 34 he understood that so get to work we 39 re going to find out over the course of the next week and training camp if that 39 s going to be something he 39 s going to be able to do for the team if he can great if he can 39 t then that 39 s ok too but he 39 ll have taken his shot 34 as harbaugh said beckham understood that he 39 d have to earn a spot on the roster and late into camp it looked like he might miss the cut he rarely impressed during camp and made mistakes including a dropped touchdown pass during the preseason that a player fighting for a roster spot couldn 39 t afford to make however when veteran receiver calvin austin tore his acl in late august it opened the door for beckham to make the roster and to his credit beckham responded to the opportunity by delivering his strongest week of camp beckham got emotional when he was told after the giants 39 final preseason game that he had made the cut 34 just my family being here seeing my son at the game 133 i had those tears when i got back to the hotel after figuring out i 39 m going to be here 34 beckham said at the time 34 and i have an opportunity to rewrite some of the last bit of the chapter 133 i just know i 39 m going to give my all but definitely had that moment where it was like you could let out some of the pain that i went through it was a very healing very emotional something i was very happy about 34 after releasing beckham the giants signed wide receiver kick returner braxton berrios to their active 53 man roster the team had exhausted his practice squad elevation eligibility the first three weeks berrios is one of four receivers on the 53 man roster joining malik nabers rookie malachi fields and darnell mooney the giants do not plan to bring beckham back to the practice squad this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Jayden Daniels returns to practice, but status vs. Colts remains uncertain
news_mentions.body_text: hertfordshire england the apparatus extends from the biceps down to the forearm with four large straps and a hinge that rests on the outside of the elbow and restricts its motion for jayden daniels this brace is now as much a part of his uniform as his jersey and helmet it 39 s a necessity and a reason the commanders 39 quarterback was back on the field just two weeks after dislocating his left elbow for the second time daniels traveled with the commanders to london on tuesday night and took part in their non padded workout held outside the team 39 s hotel wednesday afternoon it was daniels 39 first on field work in front of reporters since reinjuring his elbow and a significant step in his return to playing daniels was formally listed as a limited participant in the team 39 s lighter workout but coach dan quinn wouldn 39 t make any declaration about daniels 39 status for sunday when the commanders host the colts at tottenham hotspur stadium 34 as we get into thursday and friday we 39 ll see what that load looks like and then by friday we 39 ll have a definite determination of where we 39 re at 34 quinn said 34 but until then we 39 ll work and start the process but it 39 d be too early to call it 34 so there 39 s a chance daniels could play sunday but how big or small of a chance quinn wouldn 39 t say if daniels doesn 39 t play this weekend against the colts then it 39 s plausible he returns for a week 5 game against the new york giants at northwest stadium 34 the pain tolerance for him he already has a high one 34 quinn said 34 so it 39 s more with this specific injury the functionality the strength 133 certainly having the brace is going to be a big part for him he 39 ll wear that the entire season but i would say there 39 s a known entity of when you 39 re ready so without going through all the steps you just don 39 t know yet 34 for better or worse daniels has been here before he first dislocated the elbow in a week 9 loss to the seattle seahawks last season and missed three games four weeks with the bye before returning but he aggravated the elbow in his first game back so the commanders shut him down for the rest of the season daniels had seemingly no lingering issues with his elbow when he returned for the offseason program and then training camp earlier this year but multiple studies suggest one elbow dislocation can make each subsequent one more likely and one fluke play in dallas seemed to validate the research daniels dislocated his elbow again when he tried to brace his fall after stumbling off the line of scrimmage daniels 39 left guard chris paul stepped on his foot just as he fielded the snap and turned to roll out causing him to stumble and fall daniels 39 arm bent in at the elbow and he immediately grabbed it in obvious discomfort daniels was carted off the field and ruled out for the remainder of the game as well as the team 39 s home opener against the seahawks the following week as marcus mariota prepared to start in his place daniels crossed the country to visit orthopedic specialists in new york and los angeles to determine the best course of action for his elbow 34 he 39 s always a person in good spirits but you could tell that this being the second time around he 39 s comfortable with where he 39 s at 34 mariota said on wednesday 34 he 39 s comfortable with this process and however long it 39 s going to take 34 because daniels did not suffer a fracture or extensive ligament damage in his elbow and because the injury is to his non throwing arm he was able to resume throwing in a relatively short time the commanders did not place him on injured reserve and general manager adam peters said surgery was not an immediate consideration but peters never ruled out the possibility of daniels needing surgery to stabilize his elbow at some point after the season for now however his focus is on getting back to playing 34 at the end of the day i think if he 39 s healthy and he can play he should play 34 mariota said 34 this is his team and the more that we can help support that and give him all the tools that he needs to be successful that 39 s what our roles are 34 daniels 39 brace can keep his elbow stable while he plays but ensuring he 39 s comfortable with it and has the mobility to do what he needs will be key 34 we 39 re not going to put him out there before he 39 s ready so that 39 s why it 39 s important for us to trust the process as we 39 re going 34 quinn said 34 but him being back on the field is like man that 39 s a good step for us and then we 39 ll take it from there 34 this article originally appeared in the athletic

news_mentions.headline: Raiders TE Brock Bowers, Falcons RB Bijan Robinson highlight Players of the Week
news_mentions.description: Atlanta running back Bijan Robinson and Las Vegas tight end Brock Bowers were recognized for their outstanding Week 3 performances.
news_mentions.body_text: who were the nfl s top stars in week 3 each wednesday the league unveils its weekly honor roll see who the players of the week are below afc offensive player of the week bowers return to action was an emphatic one reminding everyone why he s among the best if not the best tight ends in the game helping the raiders to a 35 27 win over the new orleans saints on sunday and a 3 0 start bowers showed zero ill effects from a knee procedure that kept him absent from the first two games of the season bowers tallied a game high 10 receptions on a team high 13 targets for 116 yards also a game best and a 4 yard game winning touchdown catch in the fourth quarter just beginning his third nfl season this is stunningly bowers first player of the week accolade more impressive bowers is the first tight end awarded afc offensive player of the week since the kansas city chiefs travis kelce in week 11 2022 nfc offensive player of the week prime time bijan shined once more on thursday night robinson had a stupendous showing in the falcons surprising 35 14 victory over the green bay packers robinson ran circles around the packers with 194 rushing yards and two touchdowns on 29 carries he added a pair of catches for 19 yards putting him over 200 scrimmage yards for the game with that performance robinson is now averaging 145 4 scrimmage yards per prime time game the most in nfl history with a minimum of five games robinson has now won nfc offensive player of the week three times and each of them has come with him playing on a prime time stage afc defensive player of the week down by 16 points at halftime on sunday night the broncos pulled off a stunning 30 26 comeback win over the los angeles rams the rally wouldn t have been possible if not for the heroics of hufanga hufanga had a massive day statistically with five tackles three passes defensed one for loss one qb hit a huge sack of matthew stafford and two interceptions on his first pick hufanga ran it back the other way for a 66 yard touchdown his second int came in the end zone ending the game and sealing the victory a one time pro bowler with the san francisco 49ers who s now in his sixth nfl season hufanga has finally earned his first player of the week accolade nfc defensive player of the week the no 7 overall pick of the 2026 nfl draft stuffed the box score and was a pivotal force in the commanders upsetting the seattle seahawks 33 31 on sunday styles had five tackles a qb hit two pass breakups a forced fumble and an interception the forced fumble and int were the first of his career so far and were crucial in fending off the super bowl champions afc special teams player of the week in front of a jubilant brazilian crowd and a massive worldwide audience loop sent the ravens home as winners over the dallas cowboys 34 31 with a walk off 56 yard game winning field goal the final play culminated quite a day for loop who had 10 total points converting each of his four extra points and two field goals nfc special teams player of the week defense and special teams guided the vikings to a 23 16 win over the tampa bay buccaneers on sunday and nobody made a bigger play in either of those phases than price the wide receiver propelled minnesota to a 10 0 lead when he returned a bucs punt 86 yards for a touchdown in the first quarter glorious as the highlight was it was part of a massive day for price he averaged 26 5 yards on his four punt returns and added five kick returns for 132 yards 26 4 yards per return

news_mentions.headline: Titans HC Robert Saleh: Cam Ward has 'some PTSD' from number of sacks in rookie season
news_mentions.description: The Titans offense has struggled to start the season. Head coach Robert Saleh attributed some of Robert Saleh's struggles to "some PTSD" from the number of sacks he endured during his rookie season.
news_mentions.body_text: the tennessee titans offense has lived in strugglesville through three games to start the 2026 season with second year qb cam ward leading an inefficient operation in week 3 s 12 7 loss to the new york giants tennessee began with five straight three and out drives and managed a meager 54 yards of total offense in the first half the titans got back in the game late with three lengthy drives in the third and fourth quarters but ward s forced game sealing interception in the final seconds led the club to 0 3 first year titans head coach robert saleh was asked wednesday about the qb s struggles you ve got to remember the young man was sacked however many times last year so i m sure there s some ptsd there saleh said but he s getting better he s trusting it his footwork is lasting him longer into games if that makes sense but from an accuracy standpoint decision making standpoint everything starts with your feet at the quarterback position ward took 55 sacks in 2025 tied for the league lead with geno smith of the las vegas raiders saleh noted that ward s mechanics come and go within contests you see him comfortable in the pocket he said on wednesday you see him trusting the offensive line and later in the game you kind of see him kind of revert back to some old habits but i do think he s getting better in that regard i think he s starting to really appreciate the offensive line because i think they are doing a really good job protecting him ward is a streaky passer when he s in rhythm and he reads the defense properly the titans offense moves sunday s game was an example of both the bad and good in the first half ward never found a rhythm and was off a smidge on several throws in the second half as he trusted his protection more he released some on target lasers for now this is who ward is a rollercoaster qb the game losing int was an example of a still young player trying to make a play he should have tossed it away and lived for another down that s the sort of mistake the second year qb must weed out of his game i just don t think i played my best in critical situations ward said on wednesday when i need to play my best i didn t that s something i gotta get better at that s something i need to attack this week and going into the next game with baltimore and houston on tap next saleh must hope ward makes those strides quickly i think we re going to eventually get to a point where he s not even thinking twice and none of us are even talking about this anymore saleh said he is working relentlessly i know oc brian daboll and his staff work relentlessly with him to make sure that he s being shown where he can be better and where he s been good and we ll just keep getting better at it

news_mentions.headline: Aaron Rodgers: Steelers offense still has room to grow, 'but there's some vibes'
news_mentions.description: The Pittsburgh Steelers offense woke up in Week 3, generating 30 points for the first time in 2026 in a win over the Cincinnati Bengals.
news_mentions.body_text: the pittsburgh steelers offense woke up in week 3 generating 30 points for the first time since they faced the bengals in week 11 2025 aaron rodgers finally gained some traction on the deep ball and jaylen warren gashed cincinnati after two weeks of sluggish play it finally started to look like what mike mccarthy expected when he took over you start from zero for sure but there s some vibes that start to flow a little bit if you put together a couple good performances in a row rodgers said on tuesday via the team s official website we have one decent performance so we re gonna try and stack a few their next chance to stack another good performance comes thursday night against a browns defense that has been stellar the past two weeks to open the season the steelers offense struggled to move the ball the offensive line had issues on the ground and through the air the run game was nonexistent rodgers looked old for stretches and the qb got almost zero help from his receivers who made a host of errors including drops after a week 2 dud the unit cleaned things up in week 3 the steelers scored 30 points against cincinnati after scoring just three in week 2 at new england marking the first time pittsburgh had such a two game stretch in 10 years per nfl research 3 pts in week 3 2016 43 pts in week 4 the 2016 steelers then scored 31 in a week 5 win everything seemed to click for the steelers last sunday with warren galloping for a season high 127 yards on 17 carries notably rodgers finally connected on deep shots that had eluded the offense in the first two games rodgers had zero completions of 20 air yards from weeks 1 2 he had two passing touchdowns of 20 air yards in the first quarter of week 3 alone per next gen stats he attempted 15 passes of 10 plus air yards completing six rodgers believes the offense taking a step forward on sunday signals an awakening yeah it was close rodgers said every week is different there s overreactions we re the worst offense in football after new england and now we re a formidable offense i m sure out there it s just week to week it depends on who you re playing how you play it all comes down to execution rodgers has 11 career passing tds and zero interceptions in five career games against the browns 4 1 w l if he throws at least two tds and zero ints in week 4 against cleveland rodgers will set the nfl record for most career pass tds against a single opponent without an int

news_mentions.headline: Jerry Jones leaves little doubt that coaching errors cost Cowboys victory over Ravens
news_mentions.description: Cowboys owner Jerry Jones is leaving little doubt that he believes errors in game management by his coaching staff in the final seconds of a 34-31 loss to Baltimore cost his team the victory.
news_mentions.body_text: dallas cowboys owner jerry jones is leaving little doubt that he believes errors in game management by his coaching staff in the final seconds of a 34 31 loss to the baltimore ravens cost his team the victory speaking on 105 3 the fan tuesday jones was asked what explanations there were for leaving enough seconds on the clock after a tying field goal for a defensive breakdown to put the ravens in position for the winning kick there is no explanation you re satisfied with none he said said let s be sure that we all understand that they coaches don t have one that they re satisfied with we made mistakes during that time there s no question about it so there is no explanation but there s an evaluation of how not to make the same mistakes again trailing 31 28 the cowboys had a first down at the baltimore 2 yard line with 23 seconds left when dak prescott threw incomplete into the end zone after a false start penalty against tight end luke schoonmaker prescott scrambled to the baltimore 5 and coach brian schottenheimer called his final timeout with 14 seconds remaining the coach who is also the play caller instructed prescott to either throw a quick out to receiver george pickens or throw the ball away based on the amount of time left with no ability to stop the clock prescott didn t wait long to choose the throwaway and the play lasted just four seconds schottenheimer repeatedly took accountability on tuesday for how the game s ending transpired i didn t do very good in the last 28 seconds schottenheimer said during his tuesday news conference which took place hours after jones radio show i ll take accountability for it i hurt our chance to win that game i ll be better and i m better than that i m better than i performed in the last 28 seconds schottenheimer said that he overcoached prescott on third down which then impacted the following play he and i talked on the on the plane schottenheimer said i m not going to get into too much of it because there was some schematical stuff but there was a lot going on and some of the words that i told him have meaning and it put him into a mindset where he kind of checked and felt a little push and threw it away schottenheimer added third down is where i overcoached dak and put him in a mindset that he normally doesn t play with so that s where i made the mistake like i said at the end of the day when that happens you have to move on at that point i m no longer the play caller i m the head coach the communication with special teams coordinator nick sorensen and game management coordinator ryan feeder wasn t good enough so that starts with me take responsibility for it take accountability for it those things will not happen again there were seven seconds remaining after brandon aubrey s field goal and the dallas defense left a gap at just about the exact spot of the target line for a baltimore field goal lamar jackson completed a 27 yard pass to zay flowers got the timeout called with a second to go and tyler loop made the 56 yard field goal schottenheimer is in his second season as a head coach after 25 years as an nfl assistant christian parker is a 34 year old making his debut as a defensive coordinator both will be under considerable scrutiny from fans and pundits going forward and perhaps from their own front office we will be better from this experience that we had with baltimore and what happened to us at the end of the game jones said a win would have given you another way of couching it as far as having growth and enthusiasm for having won a game like that because we did come back and we came back in an impressive way all of that makes us realize we really are just at the beginning of what i hope is an exciting year for us the cowboys 1 2 got a break in the nfc east when two time defending champion philadelphia lost to chicago and backup quarterback case keenum on monday night dallas visits houston 0 3 on sunday the new york giants who will be without quarterback jaxson dart for the rest of the regular season because of a knee injury are tied with the eagles atop the division at 2 1 we are very much in the hunt and i say that principally based upon the way i feel about our team as much or more than what s happening with the other teams jones said philadelphia has things that they want to work on just as the giants do just as we do it makes you see how health is a factor availability is a factor and we re just getting started the associated press contributed to this report

news_mentions.headline: Giants release veteran WR Odell Beckham Jr. after three games, 19 snaps
news_mentions.description: The Giants released wide receiver Odell Beckham Jr., on Tuesday.
news_mentions.body_text: odell beckham s reunion in new york was short lived the giants released beckham tuesday the decision to part ways with the former franchise icon doesn t come as a surprise beckham played just 19 snaps over three games per next gen stats saw a single target and didn t catch a pass after looking like he had a steep climb just to earn a spot this offseason the 2014 first rounder made the initial 53 man roster at the end of august however his usage or lack thereof underscored the reality that it would take injuries for him to make an impact despite a thin wr room in which malik nabers malachi fields and darnell mooney have seen all but one of the wideout targets through three games beckham s inability to even see the field spoke loudly since he didn t play special teams keeping the 33 year old around made little sense beyond sentiment with punt returner braxton berrios out of practice squad elevations new york moved on from obj the giants signed berrios to their active roster new york hoped beckham could recapture the magic he conjured to open his career when he began his career with three consecutive pro bowls however no role materialized dousing big blue fans hopes that one of their favorites might have a magical end to his career where it started the question is whether this is the end for obj or if he might find a new gig with a club that could use some wr depth
