material_news_signals.headline: Giants trade for Vikings QB J.J. McCarthy following Jaxson Dart injury
material_news_signals.description: The Giants have acquired quarterback J.J. McCarthy from the Vikings in a trade, Minnesota announced Monday.
material_news_signals.body_text: the minnesota vikings have officially moved on from j j mccarthy the vikings traded the 2024 no 10 overall pick to the new york giants in exchange for a 2027 fifth rounder the team announced on monday minnesota cashed out on mccarthy after just 10 starts in which he struggled mightily with accuracy the vikings move on from the 23 year old was telegraphed during the offseason when the club sought free agent kyler murray and re signed veteran carson wentz minnesota gave mccarthy a cursory shot to win a job during training camp but he ultimately was squeezed out mccarthy missed his entire rookie season after suffering a preseason knee injury the vikings then watched sam darnold and daniel jones walk out of the building during the 2025 offseason handing the reins to their first round pick mccarthy however struggled to stay healthy and when on the field was scattershot showing only brief glimpses of consistently moving the offense in his 10 starts last year his only appearances in a vikings jersey mccarthy completed 57 6 of his passes for 1 632 yards with 11 touchdowns and 12 interceptions during training camp and preseason the struggles continued and it became clear the vikings couldn t trust mccarthy even as the primary backup with the former first rounder relegated to an inactive emergency third qb to start the season it was only a matter of time before minnesota shipped him out of town the move clears roughly 4 5 million from the vikings books not nothing but a pittance for the qb position kevin o connell once famously said i believe that organizations fail young quarterbacks before young quarterbacks fail organizations in relation to mccarthy the giants are hoping the vikings gave up on the youngster too quickly with jaxson dart out for the regular season after suffering a week 2 knee injury the giants planned to bring in more quarterback help mccarthy s arrival gives john harbaugh s team a young passer to build on as they work through the season mccarthy s best days came at michigan under jim harbaugh perhaps his brother can coax positive play where koc failed jameis winston is currently qb1 in new york but his play has been more in line with a spot starter than a passer who can succeed over a 15 game stretch john harbaugh told reporters on monday that winston will start new york s week 4 game against the cardinals all the other conversation isn t going to help us beat the cardinals so it s irrelevant harbaugh said jameis will be the starter for as long as i can see into the future big blue now has another option if winston s play further deteriorates or he gets injured the giants previously signed jake haener one career start with new orleans from the practice squad to the active roster for sunday s win over the titans how quickly mccarthy gets up to speed in the new offense could determine when he might see the field for new york

news_mentions.headline: Rams head coach Sean McVay: WR Puka Nacua (hip/groin) expected to return for Rams Sunday vs. Eagles
news_mentions.description: The Los Angeles Rams expect wide receiver Puka Nacua to play in Week 4 against the Philadelphia Eagles after missing the team's last two games with a hip/groin injury.
news_mentions.body_text: the rams are ready to welcome back a major piece of their offense los angeles expects receiver puka nacua to play in sunday s game against the philadelphia eagles coach sean mcvay told reporters wednesday nacua was officially a limited participant in wednesday s practice a sign that he s nearing a return defensive tackle aaron donald meanwhile did not practice to back soreness per mcvay nacua has been battling a hip and groin injury related to his psoas since training camp inspiring concern he might be headed for surgery at some point in 2026 he managed to suit up for the rams season opening loss to the san francisco 49ers in melbourne australia in week 1 catching five passes for 74 yards but he s since been sidelined missing the rams last two games without nacua quarterback matthew stafford has leaned heavily on fellow veteran davante adams connecting with the three time all pro 15 times for 332 yards and two touchdowns in the last two weeks the production has been plentiful but without nacua it s also caused the rams to become a bit more predictable especially in the second half of the rams week 3 loss to denver underscoring their need for nacua s return it sounds as if that will happen sunday against an eagles team that is reeling from a lopsided loss to the chicago bears in which 38 year old quarterback case keenum threw for 247 yards and two touchdowns if nacua can fit back into the offense quickly stafford could be in line for an even more prolific afternoon

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Case Keenum expected to start for Bears vs. Eagles
news_mentions.description: Tyson Bagent cleared concussion protocol late last week, but the Chicago Bears will roll with veteran Case Keenum on Monday night versus the Philadelphia Eagles.
news_mentions.body_text: the chicago bears will roll with qb3 versus the philadelphia eagles chicago is expected to start case keenum on monday night football nfl network insider ian rapoport reported monday morning the news had been trending that way after backup tyson bagent spent most of the week in concussion protocol starter caleb williams was already ruled out due to a hamstring injury bagent was cleared from concussion protocol on sunday but took part in only one practice with his backup missing the game plan install for a good eagles defense bears coach ben johnson will roll with keenum to start week 3 the 38 year old keenum hasn t thrown a regular season pass since two starts with the houston texans in december 2023 in his 14th nfl season keenum has made 66 career starts with a 62 3 completion rate 79 touchdowns and 51 interceptions at this stage having hung around the past couple of years more for his mentorship function keenum is an unknown clearly johnson trusts him to run his complex offense ensure they re in the right play and make the proper read however we don t know how lively keenum s arm is or whether his pocket mobility is any good after two seasons out of live action

news_mentions.headline: Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield suffers dislocated right thumb in loss to Vikings
news_mentions.description: Tampa Bay Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield suffered an apparent right hand injury late in the fourth quarter of Sunday's game against the Vikings.
news_mentions.body_text: tampa bay buccaneers quarterback baker mayfield dislocated his right thumb late in the fourth quarter of sunday s 23 16 loss to the vikings head coach todd bowles said bowles told reporters mayfield will undergo an mri on monday and added that x rays did not show a fracture mayfield suffered the injury when he was hit by minnesota linebacker blake cashman on a fourth down play when the bucs were trailing 20 16 mayfield s right hand appeared to hit cashman while he attempting a pass which was intercepted by andrew van ginkel the veteran quarterback immediately fell to the turf at raymond james stadium holding his hand in clear discomfort he eventually made his way to the sideline and locker room with the tampa bay training staff mayfield agreed to a three year 165 million extension on the eve of the regular season but he struggled through the first two games of the campaign and was off again on sunday prior to exiting due to the injury mayfield was 17 of 34 for 217 yards with a touchdown and an interception when he left the game undrafted rookie jalon daniels replaced mayfield for the bucs final possession

news_mentions.headline: NFL Week 3 Sunday aftermath: Tyler Loop's heroics, Drake Maye concerns, Brock Purdy's MVP form
news_mentions.description: Kevin Patra breaks down the key NFL storylines you need to know after Sunday's 14 games, including Tyler Loop's heroics in Rio de Janeiro, Drake Maye's increasingly concerning play and Brock Purdy's MVP form.
news_mentions.body_text: week 3 was all about the nail biter of sunday s 14 games 12 ended within one score and most came down to the final play including matthew stafford s last second interception to cement the rams second half collapse at denver in the nightcap let s run through key storylines in the aftermath of a sunday that provided a plethora of heart palpitations including the patriots have a drake maye problem an examination of the 3 0 raiders staying power how brock purdy s mvp form is helping the 49ers overcome is there any hope for the league s 0 3 squads a player who continues to prove why he got paid but first we head to brazil which hosted an early contender for game of the season on sunday tyler loop nails game winning field goal in rio football s ability to inspire never ceases ravens kicker tyler loop rode a rocky path during his rookie campaign culminating in a season ending miss in the team s week 18 loss to the rival steelers with the afc north title and the accompanying playoff berth on the line that pushed 44 yard kick attempt set in motion an offseason of change in baltimore loop fended off questions about his future keeping his job despite the immense fallout a blocked attempt in week 2 s disappointing loss to the saints revived questions about the 2025 draft pick then on sunday in rio de janeiro loop got his shot to brush away the haze of the past after the ravens defense bowed up and kept dallas out of the end zone late in the fourth quarter seven seconds remained in 31 31 game lamar jackson rocketed a missile that zay flowers leaped to snag for a 27 yard gain with the receiver immediately getting down as jackson called a timeout with 1 second remaining and the ball now at dallas 38 yard line loop lined up the 56 yard attempt and calmly banged it through with cbs sports jim nantz eloquently calling the game winning boot a trio in rio ravens players celebrated with their sometimes maligned kicker as they pulled off a last second victory despite stumbles along the way loop s kick on sunday didn t erase the previous big miss or guarantee anything about his future however it provided oxygen to a flickering flame that one kick could have revived a career i was saying on the sideline your legacy starting now because i feel like he has been facing adversity jackson said of loop i said what a way to start your legacy in brazil and he finished the rest he did it shout out to special teams shout out to loop jackson s part shouldn t be understated either his ability to deliver that late laser over the middle without taking too much time was pivotal as was flowers snag and haste to get down the ravens moved the ball well on sunday but they also were stuffed in short yardage situations several times in a young season in jesse minter s first campaign the 34 31 win showed fortitude from the defense keeping the cowboys out of the end zone on their final drive to jackson making a play to loop nailing the winner it s the type of victory that could propel a team the ravens needed the win in a hotly contested division the steelers offense showed life in a 30 27 victory over the bengals with aaron rodgers finally hitting on some deep strikes after two weeks of them falling incomplete if the pittsburgh offense can keep splashing plays and rodgers isn t broken in half the steelers will be a tough out cincinnati s defense came back to the pack a bit after an excellent start to the season that s not too much of a surprise that s not why cincy lost however special teams issues were the real killer as the punt crew gave the steelers extra chances joe burrow still had a shot late but a final drive fumble sealed it it s a stinging loss to a division rival but not one that should worry bengals fans the browns defense was locked in again to improve cleveland to 2 1 stymying bryce young and a panthers offense that had moved the ball well in the first two weeks deshaun watson showed that when he avoids the big mistake he can be a net positive for cleveland and make game winning plays that s new patriots have a drake maye problem the patriots were pegged to regress in 2026 partly because of their tougher schedule after winning the afc east that might be one element of new england s 1 2 start but it s far from the story the biggest issue isn t that the pats are facing teams that make them pay for mistakes it s that drake maye has regressed to the point that he s making rookie level blunders in year 3 week 1 s calamitous turnover fest in seattle has snowballed maye has seven giveaways through the first three games of the season the most by any player in the nfl his seven turnovers are the most by a patriots player in the team s first three games of a season over the last 30 years per nfl research perhaps he can explain away the embarrassing fumble in sunday s blowout loss to jacksonville saying there was blood on the ball from the center but there was no excuse for his second quarter interception in the end zone it was a ball that should never have been thrown that s maye s biggest issue right now he s not seeing things clearly defenses studied his weaknesses all offseason and he hasn t adjusted until maye does more upchucks like sunday s performance will ensue i think quarterbacks want to make plays vrabel said monday morning on the greg hill show via espn s mike reiss i think they want to throw touchdowns i think sometimes when greg and i go golfing we really want to make a good score right sometimes we re so focused on it we try to choke the life out of the golf club and we re squeezing it so damn tight that the ball has no choice but to go sideways we need to stop trying to choke the life out of every single play we need to relax we need to settle in and go play football and not try to force things that aren t there are 3 0 raiders for real i already noted last week that the way las vegas has been winning is different under klint kubiak it feels repeatable the defense has been opportunistic taking advantage of turnovers las vegas had four takeaways in the fourth quarter of its week 3 win at new orleans the raiders had only three fourth quarter takeaways in the entire 2025 season according to nfl research it s also the first time a team has forced at least four fourth quarter takeaways in a game since the cowboys in week 13 of 2022 vs the colts yes the raiders benefited from a controversial fumble call on tyler shough it also takes players creating such opportunities to benefit from them tight end brock bowers return was pivotal vegas doesn t win in nola without his 10 catch 116 yard one td performance kubiak deployed bowers all over the formation in line and detached making him a matchup nightmare despite bowers missing the first two games after undergoing a knee procedure a magical season for the te appears quite viable with kirk cousins force feeding his top target this offense needs one more outside option to be complete the raiders are the darlings of the league right now and rightfully so kubiak has quickly shown he can win in the big chair his coordinators have been excellent cousins has been steady playmakers are making plays but i should point out that the raiders opponents are a combined 1 8 through three weeks the real test comes in next sunday when kansas city visits las vegas it s a great f ing win raiders star defender maxx crosby said postgame in the locker room but we ve got a great f ing team coming into town we already know what it is it s the f ing kansas city chiefs enjoy this s tonight take care of your bodies and we re f ing on a warpath to get what we want men 49ers dominating but injuries continue to pile up san francisco 49ers fans should thank their stars for brock purdy and christian mccaffrey and pray they don t succumb to the injury bug that continues to plague the club purdy is on an mvp tear through three games the qb has been laser accurate always finding the right target and rarely making unforced errors he threw for 297 yards and four touchdowns with zero turnovers in sunday s win over the cardinals it marked his 14th career game with a 130 passer felt with better defenses on the horizon denver in week 4 and seattle in week 5 we ll see if purdy s mvp level play continues assessing playoff hopes for 0 3 squads according to nfl research only seven teams in nfl history have started the season 0 3 and gone on to make the playoffs the houston texans teams of 2025 and 2018 are the only teams to do so since 2000 currently five teams sit at 0 3 citing the 33 year old s experience in the league but this is hardly a splendid way to kick off your head coaching career the good news is brissett threw for a career best 3 366 yards in 12 starts during a tumultuous 3 14 season in 2025 if the journeyman settles harmoniously into lafleur s offense perhaps improvement or at least a little excitement lies ahead for the cards 2 a whole lotta love right jeremiyah love could be the most anticipated 2026 rookie in the league at least on the offensive side all due respect to no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza but love s talent and eye popping ability is off the charts so much so that the cardinals used the third overall selection of the draft on him guaranteeing the 21 year old more money than any running back in nfl history there were plenty of question marks with the pick though the cardinals have holes aplenty on their roster but having signed tyler allgeier as a free agent and bringing back veteran banger james conner running back was far from the most glaring weakness in the end love was just too special a talent to pass up so how will lafleur handle his rookie love has made it clear he s a team first guy and on the franchise s current timeline immediately using love as a bell cow might not be wise even if it makes sense monetarily and to a fan base that would love to do nothing more than get behind a bona fide star we shall see 3 time for a new era over the previous two years the cardinals plucked three first round picks wide receiver marvin harrison 2024 no 4 overall and defensive linemen darius robinson 2024 no 27 and walter nolen 2025 no 16 that trio has combined to play 53 of a potential 85 games robinson 21 games in two years and nolen six games as a rookie have combined for four sacks and 12 starts harrison 103 receptions 1 493 yards and 12 touchdowns in 29 games has likely been the most disappointing seen as a can t miss selection who s floundered or at the least failed to live up to his pedigree as a top five pick after seven seasons kyler murray is gone after three years jonathan gannon is gone there s a new coach in lafleur and whether it s brissett more than likely gardner minshew or rookie carson beck there will be a new week 1 starting quarterback love looks every bit the can t miss sensation harrison seemed to be it s pivotal for the homegrown talent to blossom staying healthy is the first step meshing with lafleur is the next and that ll begin in earnest later this month back to top three key storylines 1 refacing defense around garrett the rams don t mess around when it comes to making a super bowl push having traded for then broncos pass rusher von miller before adding wide receiver odell beckham ahead of their run to super bowl lvi triumph the rams shook up this offseason by trading for myles garrett already an all time pass rushing great who s coming off a year in which he set a new single season sack record that move put an enormous cherry on top of an already rich roster but you can t crown a champion before the super bowl and just how well garrett meshes in defensive coordinator chris shula s system will be something to monitor during camp shula s already stated he s going to let garrett do what he does best while still sticking to his schematic principles byron young team high 12 sacks kobie turner seven and braden fiske three combined for 22 sacks last season with garrett s record breaking 23 ostensibly replacing jared verse s 7 5 as verse was sent to the browns nothing s easy in the nfl though this isn t copy and paste under former cleveland defensive coordinator jim schwartz garrett was a one man pass rushing gang racking up 51 sacks over the past three seasons he s arguably the finest quarterback menace of this century just how brightly he ll shine in l a will start to come into focus over the next few weeks 2 time to make the offseason count if there were offseason trophies to hand out los angeles would likely be first in line still for as loaded as this roster is it s imperative the rams stiff arm distractions and keep their heads from getting too high into the clouds puka nacua has a looming potentially top of the market extension and he needs to continue working on himself after a stint in rehab l a already caused a stir when it shocked the nfl world by drafting quarterback ty simpson with the 13th overall pick simpson who remains unsigned is battling it out with stetson bennett to back up reigning mvp matthew stafford who s coming back for his age 38 season there were also trade rumblings regarding davante adams but it seems like those are in the past meanwhile the rams added cornerbacks trent mcduffie and jaylen watson from the chiefs corners who shine in kansas city don t always star elsewhere speaking of the chiefs their head coach andy reid once helmed an eagles squad dubbed the dream team after a haul of splendid offseason adds said dream team nightmarishly missed the playoffs nothing from an nfl offseason is guaranteed this l a story is all about winning a super bowl no reason for subplots with so much potential for greatness sean mcvay needs to keep his boys eyes on the prize 3 even with the reigning mvp rams have offensive questions regardless of how long in the tooth stafford is the 2025 nfl mvp is still brilliant in the arm like few others in the league he can spin it and make the mesmerizing look normal his league leading 4 707 yards and 46 touchdown tosses last season came with a talented but shallow receiver stable nacua led the nfl with 129 receptions adams contributed 60 grabs with an nfl high 14 going for tds l a didn t have another receiver with more than 18 catches that s one of the reasons drafting simpson when wide receivers makai lemon kc concepcion and omar cooper were still available was so puzzling konata mumpfield jordan whittington and sixth round rookie cj daniels could be the main depth pieces at wr leaders of the league s 13 personnel movement the rams have a staggering herd of tight ends with the most notable being colby parkinson tyler higbee terrance ferguson and rookie max klare ferguson only caught 11 passes as a rookie but he and parkinson could offer the most upside in the receiving game the nfl s no 1 offense in 2025 is expected to run it back in precision form but some fine tuning might lay ahead back to top three key storylines 1 getting healthy staying healthy is key conspiracy theorists can place the blame on electromagnetic fields from a nearby substation but for whatever reason injury woes have plagued kyle shanahan s squads for years niners starters missed north of 50 games in 2025 at the moment the anticipated returns of defensive end nick bosa torn acl missed 14 games tight end george kittle hamstring tear ankle sprain achilles tear six games and linebacker fred warner broken and dislocated ankle 11 games are atop the queue san francisco went 12 5 last season and advanced to the divisional round with those three who are each perennially regarded as among the best at their respective positions missing significant time warner is good to go bosa expects to be ready around the start of camp and kittle is working to return for week 1 however maintaining health is the key christian mccaffrey missed 13 games in 2024 but rebounded with an nfl high and career high 413 touches keeping cmc and the rest of the 49ers all star cast healthy has to be the top priority in camp and beyond there is no shortage of talent on the team san francisco just needs to keep it on the field to stay on pace in the shark infested nfc west 2 figuring out the wr room signing away mike evans from the buccaneers was a immense boon but he s missed 12 games over the past two seasons and will celebrate his 33rd birthday in august it s imperative that the stockpile of younger wideouts improves and the veteran adds of evans and christian kirk still have tread on the tires previous mainstays jauan jennings and deebo samuel are gone the latter is a free agent after a year with washington and it wouldn t be a shocker to see a reunion in san francisco jennings signed late in the offseason with the vikings brandon aiyuk is still technically with the team but is on the reserve left squad list while continually trolling the 49ers and plenty of others in video missives as evans and kirk get acclimated to quarterback brock purdy and shanahan s offense 2024 first rounder ricky pearsall faces a crucial camp needing to overcome past injuries and calamity to truly emerge similar things can be said about recent picks jacob cowing 2024 fourth rounder and jordan watkins 25 fourth rounder de 39 zhaun stribling taken in the second round this spring as the team s top draft choice profiles as perhaps the best replacement yet for samuel it s time for the fresh faces to step up in the passing game 3 defense must improve under a nother new dc from 2021 through 23 the 49ers were a top 10 defense in points and yards allowed the first two years in that span featured demeco ryans as defensive coordinator the current texans head coach has clearly left a large void steve wilks lasted just the 2023 season despite the team s super bowl run and overall great statistics third in points eighth in yards raheem morris is the next defensive coordinator up replacing robert saleh who was hired as the titans head coach after replacing 2024 dc nick sorensen as the fifth niners defensive play caller in five seasons morris should be helped hugely by the returns of fred warner and nick bosa but developing young talent ranks right up there with staying healthy when it comes to improving on last year s no 20 ranking in total d most glaringly the 2025 49ers finished dead last in team sacks with just 20 myles garrett now a division rival had 23 sacks on his own also on the injury comeback trail 2025 first rounder mykel williams bosa and williams getting healed up is a start the acquisition of defensive tackle osa odighizuwa in a trade with the cowboys might prove to be a pivotal move while the return of linebacker dre greenlaw after a lost year in denver could also bode well rookie third rounder romello height has already garnered some positive reports and alfred collins made a great first year impression morris might well be joining the 49ers at the right time back to top three key storylines 1 darnold staying on point sam darnold authored a storybook tale last season once viewed as a mega bust darnold quarterbacked the seahawks his fourth nfl team following the jets who used the 2018 nfl draft s third overall pick on him to a super bowl title darnold seemingly exorcised the ghosts of his past but he is still only 29 and has plenty to play for he s back with the pressure of defending a championship can he provide an encore earn a lucrative extension and keep seattle atop the league new offensive coordinator brian fleury s system is similar to the departed klint kubiak s but change is change and darnold must learn the differences continuity in the receiving corps should help with jaxon smith njigba leading a group that also includes cooper kupp jake bobo and rashid shaheed the last of whom should command a bigger role in the aerial attack after re signing on a lucrative deal in march furthermore tory horton flashed as a rookie last season before suffering a shin injury the speedster s return could have a dynamic domino effect adding another bona fide threat at receiver and another big play option in the return game which could open up more possibilities for shaheed in both avenues there s also optimism for a major breakout at tight end aj barner who scored the seahawks only offensive touchdown in the super bowl became a dude in his second season 52 receptions 519 yards six tds and might well become a pro bowl caliber player in year 3 if his chemistry with darnold continues 2 what s the frequency without kenneth with kenneth walker having signed with kansas city and zach charbonnet acl most likely absent to begin the season all eyes will be on first round draft pick jadarian price the notre dame product is a smooth runner who averaged 6 yards per carry in his career with the fighting irish however he was jeremiyah love s understudy and had 15 plus touches just once in his 41 games at nd the seahawks were adamant in balancing walker and charbonnet last season before the latter was injured asking price to take on a bell cow workload would seem unlikely camp could preview what kind of roles are in store for other backs like george holani and emanuel wilson perhaps rashid shaheed could be used a bit in the run game too the wide receiver corps along with the charles cross led offensive line are the offensive strengths but seattle wants balance that starts with price and will take shape before week 1 3 can seahawks avoid noise again in case you might have forgotten and judging by the lack of offseason pomp and circumstance many have the seahawks are the reigning super bowl champions for a franchise that boasts one of the loudest home field advantages the volume for a post lombardi offseason has seemingly been turned down to negative 11 that seems to be the preference for mike macdonald s seahawks though they snuck up on some people last season and after winning the most arduous division in football trounced the patriots in the super bowl this year jaxon smith njigba s not going to catch anyone by surprise the reigning offensive player of the year had a fine 2024 hitting 100 catches and exceeding 1 100 yards but he was an absolute force last season leading the league with 1 793 receiving yards and quickly erasing any doubt as to how the passing game would fare without dk metcalf also while jsn got paid this offseason his fellow 2023 first rounder devon witherspoon has yet to posing a potential problem for the seahawks right guard anthony bradford started all 17 games last year his third season in a row of starting the majority of the seahawks games he garnered a 51 9 overall pff grade which ranked 70th among the 81 guards who took at least 300 snaps could fifth rounder beau stephens replace him and solidify a longtime sore spot for seattle s starting lineup general manager john schneider was able to keep most of the lombardi band together but losing walker outside linebacker boye mafe cornerback tariq woolen and safety coby bryant isn t nothing keeping everything quiet and copacetic is far more difficult when you re defending champs so it s paramount for macdonald and schneider to figure out any issues before they grow into problems back to top

news_mentions.headline: Los Angeles Rams training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With the start of NFL training camps just around the corner, Grant Grodon provides a refresher on the Los Angeles Rams' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc west catch up on the los angeles rams offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 23 rookies and veterans location loyola marymount university los angeles california fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs dallas cowboys 7 p m et on saturday aug 9 week 2 vs los angeles chargers 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 week 3 at cleveland browns 1 p m et on saturday aug 23 2025 schedule note los angeles plays the 2024 season s worst team the titans who had the no 1 pick in the 2025 draft in week 2 and the 2024 s season s best team the super bowl champion eagles in week 3 with both on the road nfl research what you need to know 1 on the heels of an nfc west championship season in which they took the eventual super bowl champion philadelphia eagles to the limit in the divisional round the rams are heading into 2025 with high hopes the addition of davante adams has only stoked expectations for a matthew stafford led offense a closer look offers a reminder that the rams offense was just 26th in total yards and middle of the road in points scored 17th just how quickly adams assimilates into sean mcvay s offense and develops chemistry with stafford and rams wr1 puka nacua will be a key to camp and l a returning its offense to a high octane force on a consistent basis 2 les snead and the rams have stacked up some stellar drafts they have piled up standout starters such as running back kyren williams 2022 fifth round defensive lineman kobie turner 2023 second wide receiver puka nacua 2023 fifth defensive lineman jared verse 2024 first dl braden fiske 2024 second and far too many more to list here in 2025 there s a lack of ballyhoo accompanying the latest class but with the rams recent track record it s enticing to see how these rookies come along considering l a s recent success drafting at certain positions it s arduous not to be fascinated by the potential of third round defensive end josaiah stewart fourth round rb jarquez hunter and seventh round wr konata mumpfield however the most intriguing could well be the highest picked tight end terrance ferguson the second round oregon product might be looked on to make an instant impact with tyler higbee yet to show he s fully back from a devastating knee injury and veteran colby parkinson regarded more for his blocking 3 every bit a bell cow back kyren williams had his second straight 1 000 yard campaign last season with his 1 299 yards equating to an nfl leading 73 6 of his team s rushing output those yards came on a career high 316 carries more than his rookie and second seasons combined 263 as williams and the rams work to a contract extension there s also reason to wonder if williams will see his role curbed a bit as l a has picked backs in back to back drafts blake corum 2024 jarquez hunter 2025 how williams contract situation plays out along with how the reps are divvied up in the l a backfield will be interesting plotlines to follow in southern california this summer

news_mentions.headline: Eagles-Bears on 'Monday Night Football': What We Learned from Chicago's 27-7 win over Philadelphia
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Bobby Kownack unpacks Case Keenum and the Bears' upset victory on Monday night against Jalen Hurts and the Eagles.
news_mentions.body_text: keenum shines during first start in three years monday night marked case keenum s first start since christmas eve 2023 yet he didn t look one bit rusty he settled in right from the start going 5 of 6 for 45 yards on the opening drive finishing it off with an underhanded touchdown toss to luther burden that the wideout somehow scored after getting stuffed at the 5 yard line fighting through contact and getting pushed by a sleuth of bears across the end line it was fascinating to see keenum run johnson s offense more in the style of jared goff the way it was when johnson put himself on the map as offensive coordinator of the lions caleb williams makes magic but he also led qualified passers last year with a time to throw of 3 20 seconds and after two games in 2026 again topped the category at 3 42 per nfl pro goff averaged 2 75 seconds to throw in three years under johnson keenum kept a similar schedule and excelled going 14 for 20 for 145 yards and two touchdowns on throws under 2 5 seconds he finished with 247 yards and the two tds on 24 of 34 passing overall and the old man also rushed one in at 38 years and 223 days old keenum became the oldest player in bears history to score a rushing touchdown it was as good of a return to a starting lineup as keenum could ve hoped for the bears could still potentially turn to tyson bagent moving forward for however long williams hamstring injury keeps him out but keenum made that decision a little bit more difficult more importantly he made it clear chicago will be in good hands no matter what for the duration of williams recovery eagles fail to find offensive rhythm philadelphia dealt with one setback after another to begin the night offensively an intentional grounding by jalen hurts doomed a promising first drive tank bigsby then fumbled away the eagles second possession at his own 15 yard line and a terrible andy dalton interception at the goal line while hurts was being evaluated and shortly after cleared for a concussion led to an early deficit the eagles did mount a great two minute drill highlighted by a buzzer beater qb sneak for six by hurts to make it 10 7 but nothing worked on the other side of the half after dashing though massive lanes for 73 yards on 11 carries in the first half saquon barkley was completely stymied in the next two frames he managed only 9 more rushing yards hurts gave an easy interception to linebacker t j edwards by telegraphing a fourth down pass to devonta smith and should ve thrown another one to his former teammate earlier in the game when edwards dropped into the passing lane the eagles second half included three punts the aforementioned int a turnover on downs and 52 net yards of offense it was a concerning night against a defense thought to be exploitable bears defense continues rebound chicago came into the tilt with a poor reputation on the defensive side after allowing 37 points to the panthers in week 1 holding the vikings to nine points during a loss in terrible weather didn t do much to change the prevailing opinion that the eagles should have their way that looked to be the case early with saquon barkley seemingly on the verge of breaking a big one on nearly every first half carry but chicago emerged to disavow such a notion barkley who looked so explosive over the first two quarters was shut down the rest of the way jalen hurts couldn t get anything going either managing just 153 passing yards and an interception with his rushing score at the end of the second frame standing as philly s only points the bears also showed shades of the unit that led the league with 33 takeaways last year winning the turnover battle 3 0 austin booker delivered his best peanut punch impression to free the ball from tank bigsby s grasp and set chicago up in the red zone in the first quarter on the next drive rookie dillon thieneman who led the team with six tackles collected his first career interception in the end zone on a third and goal pass from the 2 t j edwards fourth down pick at the end of the third quarter greased the hinges before chicago s subsequent 13 play 52 yard td drive slammed the door on an eagles comeback it s not yet clear if the game said more about philadelphia s offense than chicago s d but it was promising nonetheless philadelphia finally gets bitten by uneven play the eagles made it to 2 0 by the skin of their teeth stopping a commanders two point conversion in week 1 to avoid overtime and requiring a game winning two minute drill to dispatch the now 0 3 titans in week 2 the margin for error should presumably have been manageable against the bears third string quarterback unfortunately for the philly faithful the eagles went on to make a parade of errors even while turning the bears one dimensional early on by allowing only 27 rushing yards in the first half a great accomplishment considering chicago ran all over them for 281 yards last season the eagles could not stop case keenum and co consistently through the air penalties were a big problem as well philadelphia doubled chicago s five penalties getting tagged for 10 infractions and 61 penalty yards the secondary committed three penalties that resulted in first downs two of which came on third down plays with the game still technically in reach defensive tackle moro ojomo committed a neutral zone infraction on a fourth and 2 when the bears seemed content to let keenum break off the rust on his hard count until the play clock expired too many mistakes let the bears blow things open and the eagles offense was too stuck in the mud to do anything about it johnson puts on masterclass it wasn t only case keenum s first start in three years it was also the first time ben johnson has ever called plays for a backup quarterback the result not too shabby johnson s script on the opening drive was flawless as five different players touched the ball and keenum was able to settle in with mostly short conservative throws on the way to a touchdown even with the rushing attack failing to find much traction until late johnson kept keenum firing scheming his full arsenal of players open for the veteran signal caller kalif raymond caught six of seven targets for 90 yards his most exciting play of the night a 41 yard score on which he had the entire left side of the field available to run after the catch coming wide open across the middle and then beating the one high safety andrew mukuba to the end zone luther burden also had seven receptions for 61 yards and a td rome odunze should have caught his first score of the season all alone in the end zone but dropped it and johnson eventually got the running game going with chicago amassing 101 rushing yards in the second half to help close out the game there were a few blips namely the play calling becoming too timid at times early on in the red zone with a third string qb which delayed chicago pulling away that s about the only thing you can ding johnson for on the night it was a stellar showcase of play calling might next gen stats insight for eagles bears via nfl pro the bears aligned under center on 58 0 of offensive plays their highest rate since week 14 of the 2025 season nfl research case keenum is the second player aged 38 or older with two plus passing touchdowns and a rushing touchdown in a prime time game joining tom brady week 5 2018

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Case Keenum expected to start for Bears vs. Eagles
news_mentions.description: Tyson Bagent cleared concussion protocol late last week, but the Chicago Bears will roll with veteran Case Keenum on Monday night versus the Philadelphia Eagles.
news_mentions.body_text: the chicago bears will roll with qb3 versus the philadelphia eagles chicago is expected to start case keenum on monday night football nfl network insider ian rapoport reported monday morning the news had been trending that way after backup tyson bagent spent most of the week in concussion protocol starter caleb williams was already ruled out due to a hamstring injury bagent was cleared from concussion protocol on sunday but took part in only one practice with his backup missing the game plan install for a good eagles defense bears coach ben johnson will roll with keenum to start week 3 the 38 year old keenum hasn t thrown a regular season pass since two starts with the houston texans in december 2023 in his 14th nfl season keenum has made 66 career starts with a 62 3 completion rate 79 touchdowns and 51 interceptions at this stage having hung around the past couple of years more for his mentorship function keenum is an unknown clearly johnson trusts him to run his complex offense ensure they re in the right play and make the proper read however we don t know how lively keenum s arm is or whether his pocket mobility is any good after two seasons out of live action

news_mentions.headline: NFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Buccaneers, Falcons, Panthers, Saints
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Nick Shook breaks down the top NFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Atlanta Falcons, Carolina Panthers, New Orleans Saints and Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams nick shook has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints and tampa bay buccaneers catch up on each nfc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints tampa bay buccaneers three key storylines 1 stefanski era begins despite a strong finish to the 2025 season the falcons dismissed raheem morris in january and replaced him with another recently fired head man in kevin stefanski shifting the organizational focus from a defensive minded coach to one with extensive experience on the other side of the ball amid the coaching change stefanski wisely chose to retain defensive coordinator jeff ulbrich attempting to maintain a sense of continuity for a unit that was the team s strength last year now the responsibility of pushing the falcons out of the 500 range falls on the shoulders of stefanski a coach with a point to prove after being unceremoniously dumped by the browns he s had success two playoff appearances a postseason win and two coach of the year awards but nothing would be sweeter to stefanski than immediately leading atlanta to the playoffs in his first season at the helm he ll need to produce results fairly quickly too given the falcons expectation of competing after consecutive 8 9 finishes 2 all eyes on the quarterbacks much of stefanski s first year success will depend on the quarterback situation tua tagovailoa hopped on board after he was cut by the dolphins bringing experience to a room that could use it while also providing the falcons with a second left handed quarterback tagovailoa might need to handle the starting duties early in the season too depending on how quickly michael penix can return from the season ending knee injury suffered in 2025 that dynamic could create its own intrigue or perhaps controversy if tagovailoa excels the fit makes sense too stefanski s wide zone rushing attack has traditionally paired with a timing based passing game the scheme that best matches tagovailoa s strengths with two options under center an optimist will say the falcons are in an advantageous position others will note two options usually means no answer at quarterback that is unless penix returns and gets back on track atlanta s former top 10 pick still needs to prove he s worth that draft status and year 3 is typically the pivotal season his progress or lack thereof will heavily influence the trajectory of this team in 2026 3 ulbrich s new look defense atlanta s defense has its work cut out the 2025 falcons improved to 15th in yards allowed per game and 19th in scoring d while finishing second in sacks numbers that suggest there s reason to feel encouraged entering 2026 plenty of departures have followed though leading tackler kaden elliss left for new orleans veteran arnold ebiketie departed for philadelphia david onyemata signed with the jets and dee alford joined the bills leading sack artist and 2025 first round pick james pearce returns but his status remains uncertain after he was arrested and subsequently entered a pretrial intervention program to resolve three felony charges during the offseason the nfl has yet to determine pearce s fate in 2026 but if he misses significant time the combined absences could be enough to sink the unit atlanta responded by adding linebacker christian harris and defensive tackle maason smith as projected starters and also signed da 39 shawn hand and samson ebukam as key rotational players preventing ulbrich from returning to an empty cupboard still the challenge exists fortunately atlanta s very strong in the secondary with the safety duo of jessie bates and xavier watts flanked by stout cover man a j terrell and in april the franchise spent a second round pick on a j s brother avieon terrell giving the defensive backfield another versatile piece if nickelback billy bowman can bounce back from an achilles tear that abruptly ended his promising rookie campaign last november the falcons are quite well equipped to handle opposing aerial attacks still following an offseason with notable roster churn the defense will need to jell quickly in order for atlanta to start off on the right foot back to top three key storylines 1 crunch time for young three seasons into his nfl career bryce young hasn t quite produced enough hard evidence to prove he s a franchise quarterback carolina s leadership will suggest otherwise publicly in late april general manager dan morgan said we really feel like the arrow is up with bryce but that sentiment will change quickly if young regresses in year 4 in 2025 he showed signs of blossoming but wasn t consistent in 2026 he needs to become more reliable on a weekly basis an outcome that should be more likely after another offseason spent under coach dave canales if this is young s breakout season the panthers will happily start discussing a long term extension with the former no 1 overall pick but even if they don t say it publicly they still need to be convinced young is headed in such a direction otherwise the fifth year of his deal could spell the beginning of a transition 2 upgrades in key defensive spots the panthers defense received some much needed offseason love it s only right that a former linebacker morgan spent much of his team s resources upgrading that side of the ball after fielding a middling unit in 2025 carolina should be better in the front seven thanks to the additions of edge rusher jaelan phillips signed for a four year 120 million deal linebacker devin lloyd three years 45 million and defensive tackle lee hunter a second round pick who has the potential to become an ideal run stuffing complement to derrick brown it s not a full scale overhaul because carolina didn t need one rather it was a measured reinforcement of a unit that will aim to improve especially in the pass rushing department if young can take a step or two forward and the panthers can evolve into a stronger more balanced team they ll be well positioned to defend their nfc south crown 3 backfield depth backfield questions linger in charlotte where the panthers benefited from a one year deal with rico dowdle in 2025 then watched him walk to pittsburgh in free agency their current running back situation is once again headlined by chuba hubbard who has eclipsed 1 000 yards once in five nfl seasons while averaging 4 1 yards per carry much of this position group depends on whether 2024 second rounder jonathon brooks who has played three games in his first two seasons due to two acl tears can prove he s healthy enough to contribute carolina attempted to build in some insurance by signing veteran aj dillon but his own injury history and minimal usage in philadelphia in 2025 make for an uncertain outlook trevor etienne also returns for his second season after spending most of his rookie snaps on special teams in total the picture appears unsure if not incomplete that can change if brooks contributes but that s a big question mark for a team expecting to contend for a division title back to top three key storylines 1 can shough build on promising finish tyler shough s late season rise inspired an offseason of optimism in the big easy where the saints larger vision became at least partially visible by the end of the 2025 campaign as new orleans closed the year with four wins in its final five games shough emerged as a promising quarterback with the potential to become a franchise signal caller under coach kellen moore perhaps quicker than most anyone expected now with a full offseason as qb1 under his belt shough enters year 2 with heightened expectations at 26 he s already older than the average sophomore starter and is paired with a former quarterback in moore who has demonstrated his ability to guide offenses toward fruitful futures both in dallas and philadelphia now moore is equipped with a quarterback he can mold a passer who appears wiser and more capable than the average second year starter thanks in part to his extensive collegiate experience there s legitimate reason to think the saints have already answered the most challenging question that comes with a rebuild now it s about proving those optimists right by continuing to build on the progress shough made as a rookie 2 new offensive weapons moore has some new toys in his offense upon the start of free agency new orleans quickly scooped up running back travis etienne giving the saints a much needed successor to alvin kamara with a similar three down skill set kamara is still on the roster too providing new orleans with some depth in a room that also includes kendre miller and devin neal the receiver position welcomed a prestigious addition too when the saints followed their hearts and selected arizona state star jordyn tyson at no 8 overall adding to an intriguing receiver room that includes chris olave and devaughn vele as has long been the case in new orleans health will be paramount for this club tyson and olave have a history of missing time due to injury and kamara played in a career low 11 games last season beyond olave tyson and vele the saints lack reliable depth at wr two more rookies bryce lance and barion brown are slated to compete for spots among a group that also includes trey palmer kevin austin and ja 39 lynn polk if they can keep their best healthy the saints could surprise some folks but as we ve learned in recent years that s far from guaranteed 3 jordan s last dance cam jordan is back for one final season after an offseason mostly spent unsigned the saints legend ultimately re upped on a one year deal in june signing up for one last run with the team he s helped define since entering the league as a first round pick back in 2011 with that comes a message to the rest of this ascending squad there s no time to waste jordan and chase young comprised a potent edge rushing duo in 2025 with each hitting double digit sacks with playmakers at all three levels the saints defense is ready to match its ninth place finish from 2025 it ll have a little extra to play for in 2026 too back to top three key storylines 1 mayfield entering pivotal season baker mayfield has enjoyed a career renaissance in florida over the last three seasons earning a three year 100 million deal with the team after a strong 2023 campaign and largely living up to the standards that come with such a contract when viewed from a league wide perspective baker deserves his spot and shouldn t worry about his future in tampa but those who have followed this team closely also understand that mayfield is a streaky player he s electrifying when at his best and can propel the buccaneers toward great success but he also struggles to get out of his own way at times in 2025 mayfield started white hot leading tampa bay to a 6 2 start and pushing the team into the national conversation as a possible super bowl contender then injuries struck sending mayfield into a stretch of struggles that coincided with roster losses elsewhere and resulted in a pile of defeats and a postseason spent at home for the first time since 2022 he finished with fewer than 4 000 passing yards instead of watching his offensive coordinator land a head coaching job elsewhere thanks in part to his successes as dave canales and liam coen had done before his play caller was fired now mayfield enters a contract year with a hard negotiating deadline the start of training camp without his favorite target mike evans who left for san francisco and with fresh questions to answer should things go well mayfield will remain the bucs franchise quarterback for the foreseeable future but if he encounters more struggles it could cost him millions and inspire changes beyond his control that drastically change the landscape in tampa 2 bowles seat is warm near the end of a frustrating somewhat inexplicable collapse in 2025 plenty of folks expected the buccaneers to move on from todd bowles and start fresh with a new coach that didn t happen of course and bowles is back to justify the organization s support in 2026 if the bucs struggle like they did last season with bowles defense finishing 20th in points allowed he ll likely be out of a job and tampa bay will be facing a potentially significant shift in identity for the first time since tom brady arrived in 2020 some thought it s precisely what the buccaneers needed after 2025 and pointed toward evans departure as proof that things weren t right at one buc place the team will have to embark on the new campaign without two franchise legends in evans and linebacker lavonte david who retired after 14 seasons another concerning sign about tampa s trajectory it will be up to bowles to prove the concerns are overblown 3 does tampa have enough on defense to win despite being led by a defensive minded head coach bowles buccaneers became an offense first team over the last few seasons as mayfield powered an explosive attack bowles units proved average at best finishing 23rd 18th and 19th in total yards allowed over the last three seasons the bucs haven t landed inside the top 10 since 2022 bowles first season as head coach entering 2026 the bucs seem to have an assortment of pieces that could form an improved defense the team wisely spent its first round pick on miami edge rusher rueben bain supplying bowles with a legitimate threat at the edge position opposite yaya diaby for the first time since the final few years of shaq barrett s career which ended with a one game campaign in 2024 tampa bay s secondary should benefit from another year of development for benjamin morrison jacob parrish and tykee smith but as of now it remains a unit carried by antoine winfield linebacker includes some questions too after david s retirement free agent addition alex anzalone arrives to great expectations and veteran christian rozeboom also entered the fray furthermore tampa spent its second round pick on lb josiah trotter with bowles in charge this defense could very well exceed expectations it could also determine the team s fate and the security of its coach s employment back to top

news_mentions.description: Who unseats Josh Allen at the top of Nick Shook's QB rankings? How high does Kirk Cousins rise? Check out the updated pecking order, 1-32, heading into Week 4 of the 2026 NFL season.
news_mentions.body_text: notes up down arrows illustrate movement from the week 3 qb index stream live local and prime time games on mobile with nfl tier 1 brock purdy is building a strong early case for mvp through three weeks lighting up defenses with ease and looking completely comfortable directing kyle shanahan s offense i m fascinated to see if he can keep it up against denver s defense this weekend patrick mahomes took care of business against a scrappy dolphins defense in week 3 he shook off a big hit that drew a roughing the passer penalty and left him clutching his lower back to help the chiefs leave miami with a two score victory dak prescott continues to power a cowboys offense that can throw it against anyone and will be required to do so as long as their defense continues to lag behind it was especially nice to see him connect with both ceedee lamb and george pickens against the ravens josh allen was a bit of a mess against the chargers turning the ball over three times his second half fumble should have cost the bills much more than it did he s good for one of these games per year so i m not too concerned about what it means going forward after crumbling against the broncos trevor lawrence got back on the horse and torched the patriots he produced a wildly entertaining sequence in which he threw two absurd touchdown passes to parker washington the first was nullified by penalty but i still wish he wouldn t have taken a knee when he was six inches from a rushing score and there were still nine minutes left in the game if you re not watching him throw the football you need to catch up before week 4 it s among the prettiest displays in the nfl next gen stats insight via nfl pro purdy threw for 297 yards and four touchdowns in the 49ers week 3 win over the cardinals purdy was most efficient in the quick passing game finishing 8 of 10 for 180 yards and two touchdowns his 18 yards per attempt on quick passes is the highest mark in a game in the ngs era among qbs with at least 10 quick attempts purdy targeted george kittle on five of his 10 quick throws with kittle catching four of those passes for 50 yards and a td tier 2 jared goff has been excellent in 2026 powering a passing attack that isn t afraid to rely heavily on jahmyr gibbs to open up opportunities elsewhere it s similar to what we ve seen from goff in recent years although they re weathering offensive line challenges better than they did last season lamar jackson wasn t quite stellar against the cowboys in rio but he delivered in key spots and benefitted greatly from the return of zay flowers joe burrow is making big plays and leaning heavily on ja marr chase when he s in need of a completion but the steelers strip sack of burrow cost the bengals a chance to secure a thrilling win matthew stafford s second half struggles against the broncos pressure dampened the fun i ve had watching him connect with davante adams it s pretty clear stafford misses puka nacua kirk cousins is off to a fantastic start throwing three touchdown passes in each of his first three contests that ties his longest career streak of games with at least three td passes and gives him the nfl s longest active such streak that s a sentence i know you didn t expect to read in 2026 next gen stats insight via nfl pro the broncos generated pressure on 59 3 of dropbacks in the second half against the rams after doing so on only 23 5 of dropbacks in the first half against pressure stafford completed just 6 of 20 passes for 81 yards taking four sacks and throwing a pick six from a clean pocket stafford finished 24 of 35 for 309 yards two touchdowns and an interception tier 3 this is admittedly a strange week for the qb index two backups case keenum and marcus mariota excelled in different ways in their first starts of 2026 both led their teams to thrilling home wins and aaron rodgers played perhaps his best game since he was a packer anyone who thinks the jets have lost two in a row due to quarterback play is very much mistaken geno smith has been very sharp and heroically threw new york back into a game at detroit that came down to the wire before he fumbled to end the jets chances we probably won t have another week like this for quite some time so fans of graybeards should soak it up while we re here sam darnold s return from injury was fraught with turnovers but between the back breaking mistakes he made some fantastic throws primarily to jaxon smith njigba and piled up 379 passing yards next gen stats insight via nfl pro rodgers completed 6 of 11 pass attempts under pressure for 121 yards and a touchdown in the steelers week 3 win rodgers tied for his most passing yards under pressure in a game since week 10 of 2020 he entered week 3 with a 43 5 completion percentage and 92 passing yards under pressure this season rodgers threw two deep 20 air yards td passes in the first quarter after he had failed to complete a single deep pass on nine attempts through the first two weeks tier 4 jacoby brissett let it fire 52 times out of necessity against the 49ers and is finding consistent success by leaning on trey mcbride unfortunately it doesn t look like he can carry the cardinals to victory against nfc west competition by most standards brissett is embodying the dalton line which is what the cardinals likely hoped to get from him in 2026 tyler shough slips in the rankings after a disastrous fourth quarter against the raiders he accounted for three turnovers in the final 13 minutes reversing course on a reputation that was being built on clutch performances bo nix rises after taking what the rams defense gave him in the second half he did just enough to help the broncos mount a wild comeback although he s still not reliable enough for me to move him any higher c j stroud is largely playing it safe until he absolutely must find a route to the end zone the texans are going to need more from him to dig out of their 0 3 hole justin herbert is making a habit of following up remarkable passes with brain melting mistakes or as tom brady called it during the chargers bills broadcast serving up a meatball sub to the defense bryce young s hot start came to a screeching halt against a feisty browns defense and jalen coker s injury related departure didn t help matters daniel jones accounted for three turnovers and nearly gave the game against the texans away with a fumble before helping the colts move into range for the game winning field goal michael penix started slowly but found a nice rhythm in his first start of 2026 he can thank the football gods for putting him on the same team as bijan robinson deshaun watson hasn t been close to consistent over four quarters but he has made the plays the browns needed late in the last two games he continues to build a promising rapport with rookie receiver denzel boston giving browns fans hope heading into week 4 next gen stats insight via nfl pro herbert finished 20 of 34 for 226 yards one touchdown and one interception in week 3 against the bills on deep throws 20 air yards herbert was 1 of 7 for 29 yards and an interception herbert has now thrown more interceptions on deep balls this season 3 than he did in each of the previous two seasons 2 in 2024 2 in 2025 tier 5 this tier pains me to assemble because i know two of these three quarterbacks hurts and love are much better than their current rankings indicate that might be why they ve dropped so precipitously as their struggles have been especially frustrating to watch jalen hurts began the season by pushing the eagles to two wins with largely positive play while sprinkling in a few errors but his showing in chicago on monday night was downright abysmal it wasn t just the interception hurts reverted to the indecisive quarterback who was unwilling to play aggressively enough to lift the eagles out of the hole they d dug for themselves his coach s crunch time decisions didn t help much either jordan love is in a similarly tough spot his offense lacks a running game his offensive line is banged up and the entire operation is stuck in first gear love will rip a few beautiful throws every week but all it does is tease us because the rest of the experience is filled with nothing but disappointment malik willis is operating in an offense that lost de 39 von achane torn acl and is leaning on a collection of pass catchers that is undoubtedly the worst in the nfl he and the dolphins offense can move the ball but they still have a hard time finishing drives i appreciate the effort he s made but the results remain underwhelming next gen stats insight via nfl pro hurts completed 16 of 25 pass attempts but averaged just 6 1 yards per attempt monday night throwing only six passes 24 10 air yards downfield on those throws he completed two 33 3 for 49 yards all season lows the eagles went three and out on three straight drives to start the third quarter with hurts completing three of five attempts for six yards none of those attempts traveled more than 10 air yards tier 6 i m calling this the searching for answers tier because it s filled with quarterbacks who don t seem to have many right now kyler murray looked unsettled at best in his first game back and justin jefferson s departure due to injury didn t help matters baker mayfield spent another sunday appearing uncomfortable in zac robinson s offense while trying his best to play hero before suffering a thumb injury that will cost him multiple weeks cam ward was the latest to fall victim to a downpour at metlife stadium although he also had a collection of pass catchers drop on target passes before he threw away the titans last chance to win by tossing an interception in the end zone drake maye is the most lost of all accounting for three giveaways an unforced fumble and two ghastly interceptions that tanked the patriots chances of competing in jacksonville seriously throwing their season into uncertain waters of all of these quarterbacks i m most concerned about maye who looks nothing like the nfl mvp finalist he was in 2025 and seems completely adrift and sapped of his confidence jameis winston meanwhile is who he is a cart ride down a mine shaft with no guarantee it leads to daylight but will include a few exciting twists and turns next gen stats insight via nfl pro against pressure maye went 6 of 11 for 81 yards and an interception in week 3 without pressure he went 8 of 14 for 118 yards and an interception maye averaged a 3 42 second time to throw the second longest of his career with 25 of his attempts coming outside the pocket the fourth highest rate of his career outside the pocket maye went 3 of 7 for 57 yards and an interception totaling eight scramble dropbacks

news_mentions.body_text: as always start em sit em is geared toward helping fantasy managers make difficult roster decisions you won t see start jahmyr gibbs here instead i m exploring the players closer to the perceived fringe and aiming to optimize your lineup for a win each week importantly the new start of the week and sit of the week are the calls i have deemed the most notable in each category not necessarily the most essential players to start or sit also you ll see quite a few references in this year s column to nfl pro spotlighting insights provided through next gen stats data dashboards matchup evaluations all 22 film and the uniquely trained fantasy ai assistant you can get access to all of those tools yourself with an nfl premium subscription p s feel free to follow me on x mattokada or instagram mattokadanfl and hit me with your questions congratulations or complaints throughout the year start em start of the week notable starts sit em sit of the week notable sits

news_mentions.headline: Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield out at least 3 weeks with thumb injury; rookie Jalon Daniels to start
news_mentions.description: Jalon Daniels will start at quarterback for the Buccaneers with Baker Mayfield sidelined by his thumb injury.
news_mentions.body_text: for the first time in four years the buccaneers will be starting someone other than baker mayfield at quarterback in week 4 bucs head coach todd bowles told reporters on monday that mayfield will miss a minimum of three weeks after dislocating his right thumb in the team s 23 16 loss to the vikings on sunday tampa bay will start undrafted rookie jalon daniels in mayfield s place when it hosts the 1 2 packers on oct 4 daniels went 0 for 3 passing with a game ending interception after coming on in relief of mayfield against minnesota daniels also gained 9 yards on one rushing attempt the last qb other than mayfield to start for tampa was tom brady back in the 2022 season nfl network insider ian rapoport reported earlier on monday that an mri revealed no ligament or tendon damage to mayfield s thumb the injury occurred on a fourth and 1 play in the fourth quarter on sunday when the qb was hit by linebacker blake cashman as he threw a pass that was intercepted based on what bowles said on monday it appears the earliest return date for mayfield is week 7 when the bucs will visit the division rival panthers it s been a dreadful start to the season for the bucs who are still searching for their first win the 31 year old mayfield signed a three year 165 million contract extension five days before the start of the 2026 season through three games he has the lowest epa per dropback 0 30 of any quarterback with at least 50 pass attempts this season per next gen stats before signing with the bucs after going undrafted in april daniels 23 spent six seasons at kansas where he became the first four time team captain in school history he beat out jake browning for the backup job with a strong showing in camp and now gets an opportunity to spark the offense against a green bay team that just gave up 35 points to the previously lifeless falcons the bucs do not have any other qbs on the 53 man roster but they do have 31 year old easton stick on the practice squad stick is in his seventh nfl season and started four games for the chargers in 2023
