news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Kevin Patra provides a refresher on the Minnesota Vikings' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams kevin patra has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc north catch up on the minnesota vikings offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 20 rookies july 22 veterans location tco performance center eagan minnesota fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 vs houston texans saturday aug 9 at 4 p m et nfl network week 2 vs new england patriots saturday aug 16 at 1 p m et week 3 at tennessee titans friday aug 22 at 8 p m et cbs 2025 schedule note the vikings will be the first team in nfl history to play a game in multiple international countries in the same season week 4 in ireland and week 5 in england nfl research what you need to know 1 it s all about j j mccarthy in minnesota the second year quarterback will be under the microscope as he takes over an offense that rejuvenated sam darnold s career last season the vikings decided not to buffer mccarthy with a veteran backup after daniel jones opted to sign with indianapolis apologies to the sam howell stans but he s not a threat to mccarthy the former first round pick inherited the porsche of offenses which has made almost every driver look good kevin o connell is a proven qb whisperer so the assumption is that mccarthy should have little trouble keeping things afloat with justin jefferson jordan addison t j hockenson and a remade offensive line the vikes offer weapons to aid the young signal caller minnesota is a 14 win club that on paper improved entering 2025 the loudest question is mccarthy and whether he can keep the engine humming after missing all of 2024 it s not hyperbole to suggest that mccarthy is the pendulum that could swing the course of the entire nfc north 2 the top camp battle in minnesota comes in the secondary heretofore the vikings have yet to add a veteran to the mix who could push for a starting gig next to byron murphy it feels as though the club could be waiting to see how mekhi blackmon bounces back after missing the entire 2024 season due to an acl tear isaiah rodgers blackmon and jeff okudah are in line to battle for the cb2 role elsewhere in the vikings secondary the club didn t replace no 3 safety camryn bynum who left for indianapolis this offseason defensive coordinator brian flores used three safeties liberally last season if he does so again would he trust the likes of theo jackson in that role could a veteran be added closer to the season 3 will the interior offensive line upgrades pay off the internal pressure proved to be sam darnold s undoing last year general manager kwesi adofo mensah set out to fix the issue signing veterans ryan kelly and will fries from indy then he drafted guard donovan jackson in the first round in theory the moves should solidify a leaky interior however kelly and fries are both coming off injury plagued seasons those concerns are coupled with star left tackle christian darrisaw coming off a season ending knee injury the offseason overhaul is excellent from a starter s perspective but there are questions among the second string crew should injuries strike again

news_mentions.headline: AFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Bills, Dolphins, Jets, Patriots
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Jeremy Bergman breaks down the top AFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Buffalo Bills, Miami Dolphins, New England Patriots and New York Jets.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots and new york jets catch up on each afc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below buffalo bills miami dolphins new england patriots new york jets three key storylines 1 new era in buffalo for a bills roster that is returning most of its 2025 starters the biggest change this summer will be at the top the start of the joe brady era in buffalo gets underway in earnest when training camp kicks off in late july in taking over for sean mcdermott a sturdy leader who oversaw buffalo s longest period of sustained success since the great marv levy was at the helm brady has a lot to live up to the 36 year old first time head coach was elevated to improve on mcdermott s performance and lift buffalo over the hump and into the super bowl a january title game can t be won in august but the foundation of such an achievement can be built in the summer as it is for all champions brady s job starts and ends with accentuating what josh allen does best freeing up the qb to take further control of the offense the defense mcdermott s specialty has been handed off to ex nfl safety jim leonhard who coached the broncos star dbs over the past couple seasons no team with a new head coach is better positioned to win in 2026 than the bills who made it to the divisional round in 25 brady s first camp must set that tone 2 chubb chasing big season as one of buffalo s only notable offseason additions bradley chubb meets the bills at a critical time for both the team and the player chubb is coming off a solid comeback season from his torn acl logging 8 5 sacks for the dolphins in 2025 and playing a full slate of games for the first time since his rookie campaign the bills are in dire need of a pass rusher after gregory rousseau led the team with just seven sacks last year and joey bosa appears closer to retirement than returning entering the fray alongside second round pick t j parker chubb will be tasked with captaining a front seven that struggled to frustrate trevor lawrence and bo nix in the 2025 postseason chubb 30 has expressed that he s never been hungrier buffalo is starving for a true game wrecker off the edge 3 moore enough or more required the bills have missed stefon diggs draftees khalil shakir and keon coleman and free agent additions josh palmer and brandin cooks haven t quite filled his vacancy over the past couple years buffalo s trade for dj moore is meant to do just that reuniting with brady his ex panthers oc moore has an opportunity to be wr1 for josh allen in buffalo in a way he simply wasn t for caleb williams in chicago in 2025 the seeds of their hopefully fruitful partnership will be sowed in july and august moore admitted to growing pains in the spring but expects perfection this fall after the offseason long onboarding process in addition to providing a sure handed outlet for allen moore will be looked at to bring along the embattled coleman who got called out by owner terry pegula in january and has been under a microscope since if moore can bring coleman along and elevate a middling bills wr room then brady s first year returns could be big back to top three key storylines 1 first look at miami s offensive overhaul tua tagovailoa tyreek hill and jaylen waddle are out malik willis is in while de 39 von achane re upped for the long haul who else will fill out the dolphins offensive roster malik washington returns as a solid pass catching option joined by tutu atwell jalen tolbert terrace marshall and jalen reagor all looking to break out after sidekick roles in nfc receiving rooms imported from the collegiate ranks are chris bell kevin coleman and caleb douglas it s a who s who of who s that in miami s wr corps but somebody s gotta catch passes from willis ahead of what is expected to be a rebuilding year in south florida all eyes at least in the fantasy world will be on the fins wideouts in camp to see who swims and who flounders 2 leaders from the pack how will green bay south look in the heat of a miami summer we re about to find out jeff hafley and jon eric sullivan s first training camp with the dolphins after years with the packers provides the first time nfl head coach and general manager an opportunity to put their imprint on the team green bay camps are typically jovial affairs with oversized players riding undersized bikes alongside community members miami camps held outside one of america s biggest cities have a different feel last year s dolphins camp for one portended the subpar season miami was about to embark on as mike mcdaniel s roster was overwhelmed in joint practices and hampered by the injury bug if hafley and sullivan can avoid that sluggish start they will have already re calibrated the doomish vibes that preceded the 2025 season 3 we re talking about willis from entering the league as a third round pick to signing a three year 67 5 million deal with his third nfl team in four years malik willis is rewriting his nfl story on the fly the quarterback embarks on his first full season as a starter this summer in south beach after shining in a pair of breakout performances in place of jordan love both losses last year in green bay the three year contract implies that he is the qb of the present and immediate future in miami but nothing is assured in this league willis is being thrown into a less than advantageous position quarterbacking a rebuilding roster under a rookie head coach quinn ewers a second year backup with collegiate pedigree and three nfl starts to his name waits in the wings if things go south in south florida and the dolphins slump into top five draft positioning how secure will willis place in miami s future be a standout 2027 qb draft class could be staring sullivan in the face all that is to say willis isn t a made man yet and his first summer as a starter will be a critical one toward establishing himself as a long term answer in miami or elsewhere back to top three key storylines 1 patriots upgraded weaponry after months of rumors and rumblings new england finally completed its trade for disgruntled eagles wideout a j brown in june as the move had been predetermined for months so open a secret that it was never a secret brown wasted no time establishing chemistry with mvp runner up drake maye at minicamp brown has found himself in heaven in new england but how will the other patriots wideouts feel before brown was acquired to provide maye a true wr1 romeo doubs was the big ticket offensive acquisition of the offseason now slotted in as the no 2 doubs should find himself in a role similar to the one he played in green bay thriving on occasion down the roster new england still has mack hollins demario douglas and kayshon boutte for now but it will be interesting to see if kyle williams can break out in his second year since his third round selection the wazzu product caught just 10 passes in his rookie season but found the end zone thrice if williams can step up in training camp ahead of year 2 maye and the reigning afc champs could be in prime position to repeat 2 questions with two defenders ahead of training camp there remain two unsettled availability situations that need monitoring in foxborough the first is that of star cornerback christian gonzalez who s due for a major contract extension after his first pro bowl season gonzalez said during spring work that he wishes to be in new england for the long haul but for a cb of his caliber that means a top of the market deal worth 30 million plus per season something new england may be loath to offer before it has to gonzalez skipped voluntary sessions but showed up for mandatory minicamp what will his strategy be if he doesn t have a deal done by late july gabe jacas meanwhile hasn t practiced with the team since being drafted in the second round the no 55 overall pick remains unsigned and has been away from the club after undergoing an offseason medical procedure about which the pats have provided few details jacas for whom new england traded up in april s draft is behind heading into summer camp which isn t a good sign for the pats pass rusher depth we ll see if the rookie comes into camp signed and ready to break into the starting 11 3 will super bowl loss off field distractions linger the off field story of the offseason has mostly faded out of circulation but questions remain about how new england will bounce back from some messy months to start 2026 the april publication of photos showing patriots coach mike vrabel and former athletic reporter dianna russini at an arizona resort ignited a months long maelstrom of unwanted press in foxborough vrabel took off day 3 of the nfl draft to begin counseling but he was present throughout spring workouts the coach s players have defended him and the team s offseason program seemingly has gone off without a hitch that doesn t mean that when things ramp up in the summer with more coverage and eyeballs further scrutiny of vrabel won t creep in in addition to dealing with the fallout from the photos the pats are looking to recover from a humiliating super bowl defeat and avoid the fate of many a title game loser missing the ensuing postseason ahead of the kickoff game against their super bowl lx foes in seattle vrabel and the pats will be put through the media wringer again how will they respond back to top three key storylines 1 is defense better vetted i m not sure if you heard but the jets defense had zero interceptions last year zilch nada nil over 17 whole games the historic feat and a 31st ranked scoring d inspired general manager darren mougey to totally remake the defense during the offseason new york has since stockpiled veterans familiar jet draftee demario davis jersey native minkah fitzpatrick and fresh t 39 vondre sweat david onyemata joseph ossai nahshon wright add on two top rookies no 2 pick david bailey national champ d angelo ponds and the jets are projected to have upwards of eight new defensive starters in 26 the leadership of davis fitzpatrick and returning dl harrison phillips should provide a foundation that was sorely lacking from aaron glenn s first unit but camp will bear out whether the new look group with a first time dc in brian duker has a chance to keep new york in games this season or at the very least take the ball away 2 the return of the geno gang green s latest qb makeover reunites geno smith with the team that drafted him in the 2013 second round a few so so years and a broken jaw ended his initial jets run but the signal caller now 35 is back in florham park with more years under his belt ready to rewrite his narrative surrounding him is the most talented crop of playmakers new york has had in years garrett wilson and breece hall anchor the returning skill players while adonai mitchell and rookies kenyon sadiq and omar cooper get their first full seasons with the jets a steady o line is returning four of five starters dylan parham is set to replace left guard john simpson frank reich is in for the ousted tanner engstrand as offensive coordinator bringing a veteran presence with a track record of coaching a super bowl winning offense in philadelphia how quickly can the jets jell into a more potent attack their summer sessions will provide the first glimpse one thing to monitor smith is reportedly under investigation for battery in florida the qb has yet to comment on the matter 3 jets in five in the streets of manhattan millions of fans rejoiced after the knicks half century long title drought was broken in thrilling fashion in the nba finals the throng of excitement unleashed a positive unifying energy not seen around new york sports in quite some time roughly 35 miles west in florham park new jersey the jets are going through their own drought of sorts fifteen years without postseason football twenty three seasons with no division title fifty seven campaigns sans a super bowl title breece hall who witnessed the game 5 title securing victory was among jets players this spring who expressed positive jealousy over the knicks fortune aaron glenn said he wishes to replicate mike brown s clutch players competitive stamina with his guys will the summer of love continue across the hudson is curse breaking contagious camp may offer clues back to top

news_mentions.headline: Jaguars end up retrieving football from Travis Hunter’s first NFL interception after altercation
news_mentions.description: The Jacksonville Jaguars have retrieved the football from Travis Hunter's first NFL interception after initially being refused by a ball boy after the play during Sunday's game against the New England Patriots.
news_mentions.body_text: jacksonville fla jacksonville jaguars cornerback travis hunter ended up with the football from his first nfl interception hunter spun the ball in celebration and then danced in the end zone after picking off a pass from new england patriots quarterback drake maye late in the second quarter sunday a patriots ball boy picked it up and refused to give it to jaguars veteran defensive end josh hines allen even screaming hey you can t touch me when hines allen tried to grab the ball the ball boy appeared to try to push hines allen away nfl players are allowed to keep game balls although they get charged a hefty price by the league hines allen tried to knock this one out of the ball boy s hands before jacksonville s equipment manager george pellicer stepped between them the ball boy again screamed hey he pushed me he can t do that as pellicer worked to retrieve the ball the jaguars confirmed monday that they did end up getting the football video of the interaction went viral after the game which the jaguars won 35 6 i was just talking about it coen said during a zoom call with reporters monday i haven t gotten a clean answer we ve been in communication with those guys over there i think they ve gotten it sorted out i can t say for certain if we got the actual ball or not i know there was something that went on there i think it s all squared away we ll get it taken care of hunter the 2025 heisman trophy winner and second overall draft pick from colorado made a leaping catch on the pass intended for patriots receiver efton chism the play prevented new england from cutting into a 14 3 lead just before the break the coach did a great job scheming it up for us hunter said after the game he called the perfect call for us we all talked and we communicated on my side of the ball and i just made it happen veteran jaguars cornerback jourdan lewis said teammates knew the significance of securing the ball even though it didn t seem all that important to hunter that was travis first interception so i know people were all over it lewis said monday i know josh took it in his own hands to get the ball back travis could have helped us out by not spinning the ball and forgetting about it but yeah that s something that you always want to get especially as special as that that s an everybody thing not just somebody s specific job everybody is trying to get that ball back to him copyright associated press 2026

out after sidekick roles in nfc receiving rooms imported from the collegiate ranks are chris bell kevin coleman and caleb douglas it s a who s who of who s that in miami s wr corps but somebody s gotta catch passes from willis ahead of what is expected to be a rebuilding year in south florida all eyes at least in the fantasy world will be on the fins wideouts in camp to see who swims and who flounders 2 leaders from the pack how will green bay south look in the heat of a miami summer we re about to find out jeff hafley and jon eric sullivan s first training camp with the dolphins after years with the packers provides the first time nfl head coach and general manager an opportunity to put their imprint on the team green bay camps are typically jovial affairs with oversized players riding undersized bikes alongside community members miami camps held outside one of america s biggest cities have a different feel last year s dolphins camp for one portended the subpar season miami was about to embark on as mike mcdaniel s roster was overwhelmed in joint practices and hampered by the injury bug if hafley and sullivan can avoid that sluggish start they will have already re calibrated the doomish vibes that preceded the 2025 season 3 we re talking about willis from entering the league as a third round pick to signing a three year 67 5 million deal with his third nfl team in four years malik willis is rewriting his nfl story on the fly the quarterback embarks on his first full season as a starter this summer in south beach after shining in a pair of breakout performances in place of jordan love both losses last year in green bay the three year contract implies that he is the qb of the present and immediate future in miami but nothing is assured in this league willis is being thrown into a less than advantageous position quarterbacking a rebuilding roster under a rookie head coach quinn ewers a second year backup with collegiate pedigree and three nfl starts to his name waits in the wings if things go south in south florida and the dolphins slump into top five draft positioning how secure will willis place in miami s future be a standout 2027 qb draft class could be staring sullivan in the face all that is to say willis isn t a made man yet and his first summer as a starter will be a critical one toward establishing himself as a long term answer in miami or elsewhere back to top three key storylines 1 patriots upgraded weaponry after months of rumors and rumblings new england finally completed its trade for disgruntled eagles wideout a j brown in june as the move had been predetermined for months so open a secret that it was never a secret brown wasted no time establishing chemistry with mvp runner up drake maye at minicamp brown has found himself in heaven in new england but how will the other patriots wideouts feel before brown was acquired to provide maye a true wr1 romeo doubs was the big ticket offensive acquisition of the offseason now slotted in as the no 2 doubs should find himself in a role similar to the one he played in green bay thriving on occasion down the roster new england still has mack hollins demario douglas and kayshon boutte for now but it will be interesting to see if kyle williams can break out in his second year since his third round selection the wazzu product caught just 10 passes in his rookie season but found the end zone thrice if williams can step up in training camp ahead of year 2 maye and the reigning afc champs could be in prime position to repeat 2 questions with two defenders ahead of training camp there remain two unsettled availability situations that need monitoring in foxborough the first is that of star cornerback christian gonzalez who s due for a major contract extension after his first pro bowl season gonzalez said during spring work that he wishes to be in new england for the long haul but for a cb of his caliber that means a top of the market deal worth 30 million plus per season something new england may be loath to offer before it has to gonzalez skipped voluntary sessions but showed up for mandatory minicamp what will his strategy be if he doesn t have a deal done by late july gabe jacas meanwhile hasn t practiced with the team since being drafted in the second round the no 55 overall pick remains unsigned and has been away from the club after undergoing an offseason medical procedure about which the pats have provided few details jacas for whom new england traded up in april s draft is behind heading into summer camp which isn t a good sign for the pats pass rusher depth we ll see if the rookie comes into camp signed and ready to break into the starting 11 3 will super bowl loss off field distractions linger the off field story of the offseason has mostly faded out of circulation but questions remain about how new england will bounce back from some messy months to start 2026 the april publication of photos showing patriots coach mike vrabel and former athletic reporter dianna russini at an arizona resort ignited a months long maelstrom of unwanted press in foxborough vrabel took off day 3 of the nfl draft to begin counseling but he was present throughout spring workouts the coach s players have defended him and the team s offseason program seemingly has gone off without a hitch that doesn t mean that when things ramp up in the summer with more coverage and eyeballs further scrutiny of vrabel won t creep in in addition to dealing with the fallout from the photos the pats are looking to recover from a humiliating super bowl defeat and avoid the fate of many a title game loser missing the ensuing postseason ahead of the kickoff game against their super bowl lx foes in seattle vrabel and the pats will be put through the media wringer again how will they respond back to top three key storylines 1 is defense better vetted i m not sure if you heard but the jets defense had zero interceptions last year zilch nada nil over 17 whole games the historic feat and a 31st ranked scoring d inspired general manager darren mougey to totally remake the defense during the offseason new york has since stockpiled veterans familiar jet draftee demario davis jersey native minkah fitzpatrick and fresh t 39 vondre sweat david onyemata joseph ossai nahshon wright add on two top rookies no 2 pick david bailey national champ d angelo ponds and the jets are projected to have upwards of eight new defensive starters in 26 the leadership of davis fitzpatrick and returning dl harrison phillips should provide a foundation that was sorely lacking from aaron glenn s first unit but camp will bear out whether the new look group with a first time dc in brian duker has a chance to keep new york in games this season or at the very least take the ball away 2 the return of the geno gang green s latest qb makeover reunites geno smith with the team that drafted him in the 2013 second round a few so so years and a broken jaw ended his initial jets run but the signal caller now 35 is back in florham park with more years under his belt ready to rewrite his narrative surrounding him is the most talented crop of playmakers new york has had in years garrett wilson and breece hall anchor the returning skill players while adonai mitchell and rookies kenyon sadiq and omar cooper get their first full seasons with the jets a steady o line is returning four of five starters dylan parham is set to replace left guard john simpson frank reich is in for the ousted tanner engstrand as offensive coordinator bringing a veteran presence with a track record of coaching a super bowl winning offense in philadelphia how quickly can the jets jell into a more potent attack their summer sessions will provide the first glimpse one thing to monitor smith is reportedly under investigation for battery in florida the qb has yet to comment on the matter 3 jets in five in the streets of manhattan millions of fans rejoiced after the knicks half century long title drought was broken in thrilling fashion in the nba finals the throng of excitement unleashed a positive unifying energy not seen around new york sports in quite some time roughly 35 miles west in florham park new jersey the jets are going through their own drought of sorts fifteen years without postseason football twenty three seasons with no division title fifty seven campaigns sans a super bowl title breece hall who witnessed the game 5 title securing victory was among jets players this spring who expressed positive jealousy over the knicks fortune aaron glenn said he wishes to replicate mike brown s clutch players competitive stamina with his guys will the summer of love continue across the hudson is curse breaking contagious camp may offer clues back to top

news_mentions.headline: Notable injuries, news from Sunday's Week 2 games: Packers WR Jayden Reed (neck) carted off vs. Jets
news_mentions.description: Here are the injuries and news we're monitoring around the league on this Week 2 Sunday.
news_mentions.body_text: here are the injuries and news we re monitoring around the league on this week 2 sunday arizona cardinals cornerback max melton toe was ruled out of sunday s game against the seahawks atlanta falcons cornerback a j terrell groin was ruled out of sunday s loss to the panthers defensive end samson ebukam hamstring also was ruled out baltimore ravens offensive tackle ronnie stanley toe did not return to sunday s loss to the saints carolina panthers safety nick scott abdomen was ruled out of sunday s win over the falcons chicago bears quarterback caleb williams was carted to the locker room after suffering a hamstring injury during the fourth quarter of sunday s loss to vikings dallas cowboys cornerback cobie durant hamstring and safety p j locke foot did not to return to sunday s game against the commanders green bay packers wide receiver jayden reed exited sunday s win over the jets on a stretcher after he was hit in the head area by a defender in the first quarter he was quickly ruled out with a neck injury coach matt lafleur said after the game that reed has movement in his extremities and will remain in the new jersey area overnight offensive tackle zach bako bewele knee was carted off the field with an air cast placed on his injured leg bako bewele also was ruled out guard aaron banks toe was ruled out in the fourth quarter and defensive tackle anthony campbell ankle did not return indianapolis colts wide receiver alec pierce was carted to the locker room during the first half versus the chiefs and ruled out with a heel injury x rays were negative but pierce who was in a boot and using crutches after the game will undergo further testing on monday per espn cb charvarius ward left sunday night s loss with a groin injury los angeles chargers tight end david njoku knee was ruled out of sunday s loss to the raiders miami dolphins running back jaylen wright stinger and defensive end robert beal hamstring did not return to sunday s loss to san francisco minnesota vikings defensive lineman tyrion ingram dawkins hip did not return to sunday s win over the bears new england patriots offensive lineman mike onwenu ankle was ruled out in the first half of sunday s win over the steelers espn com reported after the game that initial x rays showed onwenu broke his right ankle tight end eli raridon thigh also was ruled out linebacker dre 39 mont jones shoulder and safety dell pettus ankle did not return new york jets defensive lineman david onyemata groin was ruled out of sunday s loss to the packers linebackers marcelino mccrary ball ankle and kiko mauigoa quad also did not return philadelphia eagles tight end dallas goedert knee did not return to sunday s win over the titans running back saquon barkley missed most of the first half after suffering a stinger barkley returned to the field after halftime barkley said after the game that he will undergo an mri pittsburgh steelers running back rico dowdle toe missed part of the first half of sunday s loss to the patriots before returning after halftime san francisco 49ers receiver demarcus robinson ankle was ruled out of sunday s game against the dolphins head coach kyle shanahan told reporters after the game robinson and dt james thompson have high ankle sprains wide receiver mike evans hip did not return to the game but the injury doesn t look serious per shanahan seattle seahawks running back jadarian price chest did not return to sunday s game against the cardinals hc mike macdonald said after the game that x rays came back negative on price s injury washington commanders quarterback jayden daniels dislocated his left elbow in sunday s loss to the cowboys head coach dan quinn said quinn told reporters that an x ray on daniels elbow didn t show a fracture but the qb will undergo more testing daniels was ruled out after getting injured at the end of the first half versus dallas he was seen leaving the stadium with his arm in a sling per local reporters sunday s game between the cleveland browns and tampa bay buccaneers was suspended in the fourth quarter due to lightning in the area the delay lasted over two hours before play resumed at 6 10 p m et

news_mentions.headline: NFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Buccaneers, Falcons, Panthers, Saints
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Nick Shook breaks down the top NFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Atlanta Falcons, Carolina Panthers, New Orleans Saints and Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams nick shook has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints and tampa bay buccaneers catch up on each nfc south team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below atlanta falcons carolina panthers new orleans saints tampa bay buccaneers three key storylines 1 stefanski era begins despite a strong finish to the 2025 season the falcons dismissed raheem morris in january and replaced him with another recently fired head man in kevin stefanski shifting the organizational focus from a defensive minded coach to one with extensive experience on the other side of the ball amid the coaching change stefanski wisely chose to retain defensive coordinator jeff ulbrich attempting to maintain a sense of continuity for a unit that was the team s strength last year now the responsibility of pushing the falcons out of the 500 range falls on the shoulders of stefanski a coach with a point to prove after being unceremoniously dumped by the browns he s had success two playoff appearances a postseason win and two coach of the year awards but nothing would be sweeter to stefanski than immediately leading atlanta to the playoffs in his first season at the helm he ll need to produce results fairly quickly too given the falcons expectation of competing after consecutive 8 9 finishes 2 all eyes on the quarterbacks much of stefanski s first year success will depend on the quarterback situation tua tagovailoa hopped on board after he was cut by the dolphins bringing experience to a room that could use it while also providing the falcons with a second left handed quarterback tagovailoa might need to handle the starting duties early in the season too depending on how quickly michael penix can return from the season ending knee injury suffered in 2025 that dynamic could create its own intrigue or perhaps controversy if tagovailoa excels the fit makes sense too stefanski s wide zone rushing attack has traditionally paired with a timing based passing game the scheme that best matches tagovailoa s strengths with two options under center an optimist will say the falcons are in an advantageous position others will note two options usually means no answer at quarterback that is unless penix returns and gets back on track atlanta s former top 10 pick still needs to prove he s worth that draft status and year 3 is typically the pivotal season his progress or lack thereof will heavily influence the trajectory of this team in 2026 3 ulbrich s new look defense atlanta s defense has its work cut out the 2025 falcons improved to 15th in yards allowed per game and 19th in scoring d while finishing second in sacks numbers that suggest there s reason to feel encouraged entering 2026 plenty of departures have followed though leading tackler kaden elliss left for new orleans veteran arnold ebiketie departed for philadelphia david onyemata signed with the jets and dee alford joined the bills leading sack artist and 2025 first round pick james pearce returns but his status remains uncertain after he was arrested and subsequently entered a pretrial intervention program to resolve three felony charges during the offseason the nfl has yet to determine pearce s fate in 2026 but if he misses significant time the combined absences could be enough to sink the unit atlanta responded by adding linebacker christian harris and defensive tackle maason smith as projected starters and also signed da 39 shawn hand and samson ebukam as key rotational players preventing ulbrich from returning to an empty cupboard still the challenge exists fortunately atlanta s very strong in the secondary with the safety duo of jessie bates and xavier watts flanked by stout cover man a j terrell and in april the franchise spent a second round pick on a j s brother avieon terrell giving the defensive backfield another versatile piece if nickelback billy bowman can bounce back from an achilles tear that abruptly ended his promising rookie campaign last november the falcons are quite well equipped to handle opposing aerial attacks still following an offseason with notable roster churn the defense will need to jell quickly in order for atlanta to start off on the right foot back to top three key storylines 1 crunch time for young three seasons into his nfl career bryce young hasn t quite produced enough hard evidence to prove he s a franchise quarterback carolina s leadership will suggest otherwise publicly in late april general manager dan morgan said we really feel like the arrow is up with bryce but that sentiment will change quickly if young regresses in year 4 in 2025 he showed signs of blossoming but wasn t consistent in 2026 he needs to become more reliable on a weekly basis an outcome that should be more likely after another offseason spent under coach dave canales if this is young s breakout season the panthers will happily start discussing a long term extension with the former no 1 overall pick but even if they don t say it publicly they still need to be convinced young is headed in such a direction otherwise the fifth year of his deal could spell the beginning of a transition 2 upgrades in key defensive spots the panthers defense received some much needed offseason love it s only right that a former linebacker morgan spent much of his team s resources upgrading that side of the ball after fielding a middling unit in 2025 carolina should be better in the front seven thanks to the additions of edge rusher jaelan phillips signed for a four year 120 million deal linebacker devin lloyd three years 45 million and defensive tackle lee hunter a second round pick who has the potential to become an ideal run stuffing complement to derrick brown it s not a full scale overhaul because carolina didn t need one rather it was a measured reinforcement of a unit that will aim to improve especially in the pass rushing department if young can take a step or two forward and the panthers can evolve into a stronger more balanced team they ll be well positioned to defend their nfc south crown 3 backfield depth backfield questions linger in charlotte where the panthers benefited from a one year deal with rico dowdle in 2025 then watched him walk to pittsburgh in free agency their current running back situation is once again headlined by chuba hubbard who has eclipsed 1 000 yards once in five nfl seasons while averaging 4 1 yards per carry much of this position group depends on whether 2024 second rounder jonathon brooks who has played three games in his first two seasons due to two acl tears can prove he s healthy enough to contribute carolina attempted to build in some insurance by signing veteran aj dillon but his own injury history and minimal usage in philadelphia in 2025 make for an uncertain outlook trevor etienne also returns for his second season after spending most of his rookie snaps on special teams in total the picture appears unsure if not incomplete that can change if brooks contributes but that s a big question mark for a team expecting to contend for a division title back to top three key storylines 1 can shough build on promising finish tyler shough s late season rise inspired an offseason of optimism in the big easy where the saints larger vision became at least partially visible by the end of the 2025 campaign as new orleans closed the year with four wins in its final five games shough emerged as a promising quarterback with the potential to become a franchise signal caller under coach kellen moore perhaps quicker than most anyone expected now with a full offseason as qb1 under his belt shough enters year 2 with heightened expectations at 26 he s already older than the average sophomore starter and is paired with a former quarterback in moore who has demonstrated his ability to guide offenses toward fruitful futures both in dallas and philadelphia now moore is equipped with a quarterback he can mold a passer who appears wiser and more capable than the average second year starter thanks in part to his extensive collegiate experience there s legitimate reason to think the saints have already answered the most challenging question that comes with a rebuild now it s about proving those optimists right by continuing to build on the progress shough made as a rookie 2 new offensive weapons moore has some new toys in his offense upon the start of free agency new orleans quickly scooped up running back travis etienne giving the saints a much needed successor to alvin kamara with a similar three down skill set kamara is still on the roster too providing new orleans with some depth in a room that also includes kendre miller and devin neal the receiver position welcomed a prestigious addition too when the saints followed their hearts and selected arizona state star jordyn tyson at no 8 overall adding to an intriguing receiver room that includes chris olave and devaughn vele as has long been the case in new orleans health will be paramount for this club tyson and olave have a history of missing time due to injury and kamara played in a career low 11 games last season beyond olave tyson and vele the saints lack reliable depth at wr two more rookies bryce lance and barion brown are slated to compete for spots among a group that also includes trey palmer kevin austin and ja 39 lynn polk if they can keep their best healthy the saints could surprise some folks but as we ve learned in recent years that s far from guaranteed 3 jordan s last dance cam jordan is back for one final season after an offseason mostly spent unsigned the saints legend ultimately re upped on a one year deal in june signing up for one last run with the team he s helped define since entering the league as a first round pick back in 2011 with that comes a message to the rest of this ascending squad there s no time to waste jordan and chase young comprised a potent edge rushing duo in 2025 with each hitting double digit sacks with playmakers at all three levels the saints defense is ready to match its ninth place finish from 2025 it ll have a little extra to play for in 2026 too back to top three key storylines 1 mayfield entering pivotal season baker mayfield has enjoyed a career renaissance in florida over the last three seasons earning a three year 100 million deal with the team after a strong 2023 campaign and largely living up to the standards that come with such a contract when viewed from a league wide perspective baker deserves his spot and shouldn t worry about his future in tampa but those who have followed this team closely also understand that mayfield is a streaky player he s electrifying when at his best and can propel the buccaneers toward great success but he also struggles to get out of his own way at times in 2025 mayfield started white hot leading tampa bay to a 6 2 start and pushing the team into the national conversation as a possible super bowl contender then injuries struck sending mayfield into a stretch of struggles that coincided with roster losses elsewhere and resulted in a pile of defeats and a postseason spent at home for the first time since 2022 he finished with fewer than 4 000 passing yards instead of watching his offensive coordinator land a head coaching job elsewhere thanks in part to his successes as dave canales and liam coen had done before his play caller was fired now mayfield enters a contract year with a hard negotiating deadline the start of training camp without his favorite target mike evans who left for san francisco and with fresh questions to answer should things go well mayfield will remain the bucs franchise quarterback for the foreseeable future but if he encounters more struggles it could cost him millions and inspire changes beyond his control that drastically change the landscape in tampa 2 bowles seat is warm near the end of a frustrating somewhat inexplicable collapse in 2025 plenty of folks expected the buccaneers to move on from todd bowles and start fresh with a new coach that didn t happen of course and bowles is back to justify the organization s support in 2026 if the bucs struggle like they did last season with bowles defense finishing 20th in points allowed he ll likely be out of a job and tampa bay will be facing a potentially significant shift in identity for the first time since tom brady arrived in 2020 some thought it s precisely what the buccaneers needed after 2025 and pointed toward evans departure as proof that things weren t right at one buc place the team will have to embark on the new campaign without two franchise legends in evans and linebacker lavonte david who retired after 14 seasons another concerning sign about tampa s trajectory it will be up to bowles to prove the concerns are overblown 3 does tampa have enough on defense to win despite being led by a defensive minded head coach bowles buccaneers became an offense first team over the last few seasons as mayfield powered an explosive attack bowles units proved average at best finishing 23rd 18th and 19th in total yards allowed over the last three seasons the bucs haven t landed inside the top 10 since 2022 bowles first season as head coach entering 2026 the bucs seem to have an assortment of pieces that could form an improved defense the team wisely spent its first round pick on miami edge rusher rueben bain supplying bowles with a legitimate threat at the edge position opposite yaya diaby for the first time since the final few years of shaq barrett s career which ended with a one game campaign in 2024 tampa bay s secondary should benefit from another year of development for benjamin morrison jacob parrish and tykee smith but as of now it remains a unit carried by antoine winfield linebacker includes some questions too after david s retirement free agent addition alex anzalone arrives to great expectations and veteran christian rozeboom also entered the fray furthermore tampa spent its second round pick on lb josiah trotter with bowles in charge this defense could very well exceed expectations it could also determine the team s fate and the security of its coach s employment back to top

news_mentions.headline: NFC South training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Buccaneers, Falcons, Panthers, Saints
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Nick Shook breaks down the top NFC South training camp storylines to monitor for the Atlanta Falcons, Carolina Panthers, New Orleans Saints and Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams nick shook has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to panthers new orleans saints tampa bay buccaneers three key storylines 1 stefanski era begins despite a strong finish to the 2025 season the falcons dismissed raheem morris in january and replaced him with another recently fired head man in kevin stefanski shifting the organizational focus from a defensive minded coach to one with extensive experience on the other side of the ball amid the coaching change stefanski wisely chose to retain defensive coordinator jeff ulbrich attempting to maintain a sense of continuity for a unit that was the team s strength last year now the responsibility of pushing the falcons out of the 500 range falls on the shoulders of stefanski a coach with a point to prove after being unceremoniously dumped by the browns he s had success two playoff appearances a postseason win and two coach of the year awards but nothing would be sweeter to stefanski than immediately leading atlanta to the playoffs in his first season at the helm he ll need to produce results fairly quickly too given the falcons expectation of competing after consecutive 8 9 finishes 2 all eyes on the quarterbacks much of stefanski s first year success will depend on the quarterback tagovailoa might need to handle the starting duties early in the season too depending on how quickly michael penix can return from the season ending knee injury suffered in 2025 that dynamic could create its own intrigue or perhaps controversy if tagovailoa excels the fit makes sense too stefanski s wide zone rushing attack has traditionally paired with a timing based passing game the scheme or lack thereof will heavily influence the trajectory of this team in 2026 3 ulbrich s new look defense atlanta s defense has its work cut out the 2025 falcons improved to 15th in yards allowed per game and 19th in scoring d while finishing second in sacks numbers that suggest there s reason to feel encouraged entering 2026 plenty of departures have followed though leading tackler kaden elliss left for new orleans veteran arnold ebiketie departed for philadelphia david onyemata signed with the jets and dee alford joined the bills leading sack artist and 2025 first round pick james pearce returns but his status remains uncertain after he was arrested and subsequently entered a pretrial intervention program to resolve three felony charges during the offseason the nfl has yet to determine pearce s fate in 2026 but if he misses significant time the combined absences could be enough to sink the unit atlanta responded by adding linebacker christian harris and defensive tackle maason smith as projected starters and also signed da 39 shawn hand and samson ebukam as key rotational players preventing ulbrich from returning to an empty cupboard still the challenge exists fortunately atlanta s very strong in the secondary with the safety duo of jessie bates and xavier watts flanked by stout cover man a j terrell and in april the franchise spent a second round pick on a j s brother avieon terrell giving the defensive backfield another versatile piece if nickelback billy bowman can bounce back from an achilles tear that abruptly ended his promising rookie campaign last november the falcons are quite well equipped to handle opposing aerial attacks still following an offseason with notable roster churn the defense will need to jell quickly in order for atlanta to start off on the right foot back to top three key storylines 1 crunch time for young three seasons into his nfl career bryce young hasn t quite produced enough hard evidence to prove he s a franchise quarterback carolina s leadership will suggest otherwise publicly in late april general manager dan morgan said we really feel like the arrow is up with bryce but that sentiment will change quickly if young regresses in year 4 in 2025 he showed signs of blossoming but wasn t consistent in 2026 he needs to become more reliable on a weekly basis an outcome that should be more likely after another offseason spent under coach dave canales if this is young s breakout season the panthers will happily start discussing a long term extension with the former no 1 overall pick but even if they don t say it publicly they still need to be convinced young is headed in such a direction otherwise the fifth year of his deal could spell the beginning of a transition 2 upgrades in key defensive spots the panthers defense received some much needed offseason love it s only right that a former linebacker morgan spent much of his team s resources upgrading that side of the ball after fielding a middling unit in 2025 carolina should be better in the front seven thanks to the additions of edge rusher jaelan phillips signed for a four year 120 million deal linebacker devin lloyd three years 45 million and defensive tackle lee hunter a second round pick who has the potential to become an ideal run stuffing complement to derrick brown it s not a full scale overhaul because carolina didn t need one rather it was a measured reinforcement of a unit that will aim to improve especially in the pass rushing department if young can take a step or two forward and the panthers can evolve into a stronger more balanced team they ll be well positioned to defend their nfc south crown 3 backfield depth backfield questions linger in charlotte where the panthers benefited from a one year deal with rico dowdle in 2025 then watched him walk to pittsburgh in free agency their current running back situation is once again headlined by chuba hubbard who has eclipsed 1 000 yards once in five nfl seasons prove he s healthy enough to contribute carolina attempted to build in some insurance by signing veteran aj dillon but his own injury history and minimal usage in philadelphia in 2025 make for an uncertain outlook trevor etienne also returns for his second season after spending most of his rookie snaps on special teams in total the picture appears unsure if not incomplete that can change if brooks contributes but that s a big question mark for a team expecting to contend for a division title back to top three key storylines 1 can shough build on promising finish tyler shough s late wins in its final five games shough emerged as a promising quarterback with the potential to become a franchise signal caller under coach kellen moore perhaps quicker than most anyone expected now news_mentions.headline: Browns coach Todd Monken sees room for Deshaun Watson to improve after back-to-back wins
news_mentions.description: Browns coach Todd Monken says he sees room for QB Deshaun Watson to improve after leading the team to back-to-back wins.
news_mentions.body_text: browns quarterback deshaun watson didn t have to worry about boos from the cleveland faithful following sunday s fourth quarter rally that pushed the team to 2 1 the first time the club has held a winning record since 2023 watson was far from perfect in the 21 18 victory over the panthers but he made the plays that mattered late to secure the win twice answering carolina s fourth quarter scores first year head coach todd monken likes what he s seen from the veteran qb but knows he still has strides to make i m just really happy for him monken told reporters on monday again the work he s put in certainly he knows he can play better we can certainly coach better around him and all we re trying to do is this week clean up what we can clean up in a short week and be ready to go and be as fresh as we can be for thursday night to better put our best foot forward watson missed a host of passes many badly the scattershot nature of his throws especially some attempts toward rookie wide receiver kc concepcion that were uncatchable is an issue watson must clean up he completed 16 of 30 passes for 144 yards and two tds he also was somewhat lucky not to throw an interception a few times he didn t look skittish in the pocket though unlike previous years watson has improved his pocket movement and used his legs with aplomb on sunday scampering 11 times for 45 yards one of the biggest issues with watson since his arrival in cleveland has been panicked throws under duress those were mostly absent on sunday that s a positive sign for monken watson and the offense have areas to clean up starting with his rhythm we ll see if he can harness accuracy particularly downfield where he s struggled and rarely attempted to go 23 2 deep attempts through three weeks per next gen stats no one who watches watson sees the same player he was early in his career with the texans however he s finally showing an ability to move the offense and conjure enough magic in the big moments given where he s been the past few years even that baby step is significant for the browns

news_mentions.headline: Chargers' Jim Harbaugh challenges Justin Herbert to 'be better' after team's 0-3 start
news_mentions.description: Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh said he wants to see Justin Herbert "be better" with the team still searching for its first win of the season.
news_mentions.body_text: even justin herbert s most staunch defender wants to see more from the quarterback los angeles chargers head coach jim harbaugh told reporters on monday that he wants to see improved decision making from the quarterback be better be better harbaugh said and that drives justin that drives me that drives his position coach that drives mike mcdaniel the coordinator i mean drives us all given harbaugh s insistence on defending the quarterback at seemingly every turn since he was hired before the 2024 season it s a notable critique herbert finished 20 of 34 for 226 yards one touchdown and one interception in the team s 24 16 loss to the bills on sunday which dropped los angeles to 0 3 this season he struggled particularly on deep throws 20 air yards going 1 of 7 for 29 yards and an int herbert has now thrown more deep pass interceptions this season 3 than in either of the previous two seasons 2 in 2024 2 in 2025 the qb has thrown an interception while failing to throw for multiple touchdowns in four consecutive starts dating back to week 17 of last season it ties cooper rush and daniel jones for the longest active streak in the nfl and the longest of herbert s career the chargers failed to capitalize on five forced turnovers on sunday as the offense struggled to punch in scores going 1 of 4 in the red zone as the defense gave l a repeated chances to thwart josh allen s bills herbert and co never found a groove after three weeks it s been a rusty operation and herbert doesn t appear comfortable in the scheme yet the interior of the offensive line getting repeatedly blasted doesn t help also the pass catching corps hasn t aided the qb suffering from drops on sunday the whole operation is a mess and it starts with the qb we want to be better we got to be better we got to look at our scheme harbaugh said we got to look at how we re performing how we re doing things and who s doing it

news_mentions.headline: Eagles-Bears on 'Monday Night Football': What We Learned from Chicago's 27-7 win over Philadelphia
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Bobby Kownack unpacks Case Keenum and the Bears' upset victory on Monday night against Jalen Hurts and the Eagles.
news_mentions.body_text: keenum shines during first start in three years monday night marked case keenum s first start since christmas eve 2023 yet he didn t look one bit rusty he settled in right from the start going 5 of 6 for 45 yards on the opening drive finishing it off with an underhanded touchdown toss to luther burden that the wideout somehow scored after getting stuffed at the 5 yard line fighting through contact and getting pushed by a sleuth of bears across the end line it was fascinating to see keenum run johnson s offense more in the style of jared goff the way it was when johnson put himself on the map as offensive coordinator of the lions caleb williams makes magic but he also led qualified passers last year with a time to throw of 3 20 seconds and after two games in 2026 again topped the category at 3 42 per nfl pro goff averaged 2 75 seconds to throw in three years under johnson keenum kept a similar schedule and excelled going 14 for 20 for 145 yards and two touchdowns on throws under 2 5 seconds he finished with 247 yards and the two tds on 24 of 34 passing overall and the old man also rushed one in at 38 years and 223 days old keenum became the oldest player in bears history to score a rushing touchdown it was as good of a return to a starting lineup as keenum could ve hoped for the bears could still potentially turn to tyson bagent moving forward for however long williams hamstring injury keeps him out but keenum made that decision a little bit more difficult more importantly he made it clear chicago will be in good hands no matter what for the duration of williams recovery eagles fail to find offensive rhythm philadelphia dealt with one setback after another to begin the night offensively an intentional grounding by jalen hurts doomed a promising first drive tank bigsby then fumbled away the eagles second possession at his own 15 yard line and a terrible andy dalton interception at the goal line while hurts was being evaluated and shortly after cleared for a concussion led to an early deficit the eagles did mount a great two minute drill highlighted by a buzzer beater qb sneak for six by hurts to make it 10 7 but nothing worked on the other side of the half after dashing though massive lanes for 73 yards on 11 carries in the first half saquon barkley was completely stymied in the next two frames he managed only 9 more rushing yards hurts gave an easy interception to linebacker t j edwards by telegraphing a fourth down pass to devonta smith and should ve thrown another one to his former teammate earlier in the game when edwards dropped into the passing lane the eagles second half included three punts the aforementioned int a turnover on downs and 52 net yards of offense it was a concerning night against a defense thought to be exploitable bears defense continues rebound chicago came into the tilt with a poor reputation on the defensive side after allowing 37 points to the panthers in week 1 holding the vikings to nine points during a loss in terrible weather didn t do much to change the prevailing opinion that the eagles should have their way that looked to be the case early with saquon barkley seemingly on the verge of breaking a big one on nearly every first half carry but chicago emerged to disavow such a notion barkley who looked so explosive over the first two quarters was shut down the rest of the way jalen hurts couldn t get anything going either managing just 153 passing yards and an interception with his rushing score at the end of the second frame standing as philly s only points the bears also showed shades of the unit that led the league with 33 takeaways last year winning the turnover battle 3 0 austin booker delivered his best peanut punch impression to free the ball from tank bigsby s grasp and set chicago up in the red zone in the first quarter on the next drive rookie dillon thieneman who led the team with six tackles collected his first career interception in the end zone on a third and goal pass from the 2 t j edwards fourth down pick at the end of the third quarter greased the hinges before chicago s subsequent 13 play 52 yard td drive slammed the door on an eagles comeback it s not yet clear if the game said more about philadelphia s offense than chicago s d but it was promising nonetheless philadelphia finally gets bitten by uneven play the eagles made it to 2 0 by the skin of their teeth stopping a commanders two point conversion in week 1 to avoid overtime and requiring a game winning two minute drill to dispatch the now 0 3 titans in week 2 the margin for error should presumably have been manageable against the bears third string quarterback unfortunately for the philly faithful the eagles went on to make a parade of errors even while turning the bears one dimensional early on by allowing only 27 rushing yards in the first half a great accomplishment considering chicago ran all over them for 281 yards last season the eagles could not stop case keenum and co consistently through the air penalties were a big problem as well philadelphia doubled chicago s five penalties getting tagged for 10 infractions and 61 penalty yards the secondary committed three penalties that resulted in first downs two of which came on third down plays with the game still technically in reach defensive tackle moro ojomo committed a neutral zone infraction on a fourth and 2 when the bears seemed content to let keenum break off the rust on his hard count until the play clock expired too many mistakes let the bears blow things open and the eagles offense was too stuck in the mud to do anything about it johnson puts on masterclass it wasn t only case keenum s first start in three years it was also the first time ben johnson has ever called plays for a backup quarterback the result not too shabby johnson s script on the opening drive was flawless as five different players touched the ball and keenum was able to settle in with mostly short conservative throws on the way to a touchdown even with the rushing attack failing to find much traction until late johnson kept keenum firing scheming his full arsenal of players open for the veteran signal caller kalif raymond caught six of seven targets for 90 yards his most exciting play of the night a 41 yard score on which he had the entire left side of the field available to run after the catch coming wide open across the middle and then beating the one high safety andrew mukuba to the end zone luther burden also had seven receptions for 61 yards and a td rome odunze should have caught his first score of the season all alone in the end zone but dropped it and johnson eventually got the running game going with chicago amassing 101 rushing yards in the second half to help close out the game there were a few blips namely the play calling becoming too timid at times early on in the red zone with a third string qb which delayed chicago pulling away that s about the only thing you can ding johnson for on the night it was a stellar showcase of play calling might next gen stats insight for eagles bears via nfl pro the bears aligned under center on 58 0 of offensive plays their highest rate since week 14 of the 2025 season nfl research case keenum is the second player aged 38 or older with two plus passing touchdowns and a rushing touchdown in a prime time game joining tom brady week 5 2018

news_mentions.headline: Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield out at least 3 weeks with thumb injury; rookie Jalon Daniels to start
news_mentions.description: Jalon Daniels will start at quarterback for the Buccaneers with Baker Mayfield sidelined by his thumb injury.
news_mentions.body_text: for the first time in four years the buccaneers will be starting someone other than baker mayfield at quarterback in week 4 bucs head coach todd bowles told reporters on monday that mayfield will miss a minimum of three weeks after dislocating his right thumb in the team s 23 16 loss to the vikings on sunday tampa bay will start undrafted rookie jalon daniels in mayfield s place when it hosts the 1 2 packers on oct 4 daniels went 0 for 3 passing with a game ending interception after coming on in relief of mayfield against minnesota daniels also gained 9 yards on one rushing attempt the last qb other than mayfield to start for tampa was tom brady back in the 2022 season nfl network insider ian rapoport reported earlier on monday that an mri revealed no ligament or tendon damage to mayfield s thumb the injury occurred on a fourth and 1 play in the fourth quarter on sunday when the qb was hit by linebacker blake cashman as he threw a pass that was intercepted based on what bowles said on monday it appears the earliest return date for mayfield is week 7 when the bucs will visit the division rival panthers it s been a dreadful start to the season for the bucs who are still searching for their first win the 31 year old mayfield signed a three year 165 million contract extension five days before the start of the 2026 season through three games he has the lowest epa per dropback 0 30 of any quarterback with at least 50 pass attempts this season per next gen stats before signing with the bucs after going undrafted in april daniels 23 spent six seasons at kansas where he became the first four time team captain in school history he beat out jake browning for the backup job with a strong showing in camp and now gets an opportunity to spark the offense against a green bay team that just gave up 35 points to the previously lifeless falcons the bucs do not have any other qbs on the 53 man roster but they do have 31 year old easton stick on the practice squad stick is in his seventh nfl season and started four games for the chargers in 2023

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Case Keenum expected to start for Bears vs. Eagles
news_mentions.description: Tyson Bagent cleared concussion protocol late last week, but the Chicago Bears will roll with veteran Case Keenum on Monday night versus the Philadelphia Eagles.
news_mentions.body_text: the chicago bears will roll with qb3 versus the philadelphia eagles chicago is expected to start case keenum on monday night football nfl network insider ian rapoport reported monday morning the news had been trending that way after backup tyson bagent spent most of the week in concussion protocol starter caleb williams was already ruled out due to a hamstring injury bagent was cleared from concussion protocol on sunday but took part in only one practice with his backup missing the game plan install for a good eagles defense bears coach ben johnson will roll with keenum to start week 3 the 38 year old keenum hasn t thrown a regular season pass since two starts with the houston texans in december 2023 in his 14th nfl season keenum has made 66 career starts with a 62 3 completion rate 79 touchdowns and 51 interceptions at this stage having hung around the past couple of years more for his mentorship function keenum is an unknown clearly johnson trusts him to run his complex offense ensure they re in the right play and make the proper read however we don t know how lively keenum s arm is or whether his pocket mobility is any good after two seasons out of live action

news_mentions.headline: Next Woman Up: Jill Costanza, Lions Assistant Strength & Conditioning/Director of Sports Science
news_mentions.description: In this installment of the Next Woman Up series, Jill Costanza details her role as the Detroit Lions' assistant strength & conditioning coach/director of sports science, her non-linear path to the NFL and the most rewarding part of her job.
news_mentions.body_text: women are rising up the ranks throughout professional football earning positions of power in a space that for too long was ruled almost exclusively by men we re seeing more and more women breaking barriers in the sport but what are the stories beyond the headlines who are the women shaping and influencing the nfl today answering those questions is the aim of the next woman up series while the conversational q as are edited and condensed for clarity this is a forum for impactful women to share experiences in their own words without further ado we introduce jill costanza detroit lions position assistant strength conditioning director of sports science let s start from the beginning how did you get your start in a career in football my dad spent years trying to talk me into coaching he told me i d be a fantastic basketball coach because that was my sport but i wanted no part of it i wanted the glitz and glam of professional sports in a sports marketing sense i thought that was my passion i didn t find a job in marketing but i did find a passion for working with athletes and coaching and that s where i was introduced to strength and conditioning the girls on the team kept getting acl injuries so i turned to todd wright who was the head strength coach at the university of texas at the time and whom i saw speak at a high school basketball conference i saw what he was doing with the players and how he wasn t using a traditional weight room model it was like this light bulb moment of this is what i want to do i went back to school to get my master s degree in strength and conditioning from the university of miami because it had a program specific to sport performance instead of general exercise physiology i went back to the university of texas to do an internship and as life takes you on different paths i ended up in the military aspect the military was really making a push toward human performance hiring contractors to set up models similar to what you see in college athletics and professional sports i took that opportunity and spent three years with army and two years with air force special forces which is where i met mike clark who was dan campbell s head strength coach at texas a m many years ago during campbell s college playing days that s how i got into football when coach campbell got the head coaching job in detroit he made a call to coach clark to be the human performance director and i was the first person he asked to come with him so what does your role entail sports science was a fairly new profession in the u s when i was at texas but if you really wanted to write your ticket you learned that side of things to pair with strength and conditioning it s about understanding what you re tracking with different technology why you re tracking it and better yet how to communicate those findings with coaches which i learned from my mentor sandy abney that aspect allows you to assess the effectiveness of your training program any interventions that are needed and return to play plans so i jumped in and learned as much as i could thankfully what i did with the air force special forces was more on the sports science side less strength and conditioning so i was able to enhance my skills coach clark liked that i could be in a dual role but i would say my role is more strength and conditioning i m on the floor coaching more often than i am working on the sports science side because players need to warm up then we re on the practice field in the weight room helping with recovery all of that that makes sense what does a week look like for you during the regular season on monday we immediately start looking at game data and the gps metrics to understand the demands of the game and which players took a high load the players do a recovery lift that day as well players are off tuesdays so that s our time to catch up on injury reports with the head of strength and conditioning josh schuler and start thinking about return to play protocols for players coming back from injury wednesdays and thursdays are heavy hitters we have a lift in the morning then the players practice we also have a lift session after practice for whoever didn t lift in the morning i ll spend the rest of the afternoon looking at practice data to get a report ready for coach campbell telling him where certain players are at and what would you say is the most challenging part of your job we try to individualize training as much as possible so it s a lot of piecing together the puzzle players have previous injuries which sometimes make them more susceptible to additional injuries it s a lot of figuring out where the weak link is with certain players and constantly thinking outside of the box to help them i would also say the mental energy that s required day after day to get the players what they need is also a challenge oh that s interesting why do you think you ve had so much success in your career my authenticity i have never chased an opportunity they have always been presented to me i really try to wear blinders focus on me and my growth not getting so caught up in what everyone else is doing i have a strong sense of self and trust that the right people will present the right opportunities that s a great answer when was the last time you had a pinch me moment the nfc championship game in san francisco that was pretty amazing the history of this team and making it there it was like wow the game didn t go as planned but reaching that game was a highlight what goals do you have moving forward i do have an innate sense of leadership and that is where i foresee my career going i would love to step into a director s role i don t want to just check a box because i and so many other women deserve to be here we re making a huge impact and that s just what i foresee myself continuing to do now let s turn to mentorship do you have any mentors and what advice have you received from them two main mentors come to mind sandy abney whom i mentioned earlier and shaun mcpherson former strength and conditioning coach at the university of texas i learned so much from him and i m probably most grateful that he threw me into the fire there would be days when he d turn to me and say jill you re running the team warmup today or you re running their workout today you never want to look like you don t know what you re doing so he really challenged me in that sense he taught me so much about coaching building relationships trusting yourself and being ready for when an opportunity presents itself then coach clark who brought me here and josh schuler he has been such a proponent for me and given me a support system i m so very grateful for those four thank you for sharing that now flipping it forward what advice do you have for other women looking to get into a career in a similar space it has not been a linear path and patience is definitely needed getting the job you want may not happen immediately but that doesn t mean it s not going to happen there are so many phenomenal experiences that you can have outside of football that help you grow as a person not just knowledge but people skills emotional intelligence empathy being able to relate to different cultures different people and different experiences it just really helps you gain wisdom which cannot be taught except through experience so if it doesn t happen right away just be grateful for any experience that you have because it helps you maintain that strong connection to self trust your path it doesn t matter at what age you achieve your goal this didn t happen for me until i was 41 i m hopeful i am an example for women of all ages there s a divine spark within all of us and life sometimes makes that flame go down a little bit but you just pour some kerosene on it and light it back up it s never too late that s great advice finally what are you most proud of in your career when an athlete comes back and thanks me for helping them or tells me this is the best they have ever felt my training methodologies sometimes are a little outside of traditional strength and conditioning practices but when i hear that from the guys i think ok you re doing something right to be able to help athletes that i work with not just play their sport better but to feel better and give them some hope is everything
