news_mentions.headline: NFC East training camp 2026 preview: Top storylines for Commanders, Cowboys, Eagles, Giants
news_mentions.description: As we hurtle toward the 2026 NFL season, Grant Gordon breaks down the top NFC East training camp storylines to monitor for the Dallas Cowboys, New York Giants, Philadelphia Eagles and Washington Commanders.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2026 training camps just around the corner it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams grant gordon has the lowdown on the key position battles and top storylines to monitor for the dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles and washington commanders catch up on each nfc east team s offseason developments and 2026 outlook below dallas cowboys new york giants philadelphia eagles washington commanders three key storylines 1 summer bliss with pickens and no drama in oxnard aside from some contract squabbles with george pickens and brandon aubrey that were tame by cowboys standards this has been a drama free offseason for dallas will that change during training camp in oxnard california it s been a breath of fresh air that s even drawn applause from one of the greatest cowboys ever nfl all time leading rusher emmitt smith with dallas locked in on snapping a two year playoff drought the on field focus bodes well avoiding major storylines might well be the biggest development of the summer for the boys july 28 looms large for the team as it s when players are set to report to camp and owner jerry jones traditionally addresses the media in a lengthy news conference the cowboys have been transparent about not negotiating an extension with pickens who has signed his franchise tag and stated he doesn t intend to hold out we ll see just how copacetic everything remains when camp kicks off 2 downs arrives with plenty of hype ohio state safety caleb downs was viewed as a top line talent in this year s draft the cowboys getting him at no 11 overall was a major boon since joining the team downs has garnered rave reviews the highest defensive selection for the franchise since morris claiborne at no 6 in 2012 downs fills a massive db need for dallas and could prove to be a steal how he looks when the pads are on will be must see viewing for the fans at camp and a pivotal point in the cowboys defensive reconstruction downs isn t the cowboys only 2026 first round selection though picked 23rd overall malachi lawrence is a pass rusher who some felt went earlier than he should ve he has plenty of upside though and the cowboys have plenty of pass rushing needs to fill after mustering just 35 sacks in 2025 tied for 22nd in the league 3 a whole new world on defense dallas defense was a sieve in 2025 finishing dead last in points allowed and 30th in total d perhaps it wasn t too surprising considering the cowboys traded away micah parsons just before the season arrived nonetheless the disastrous results led to matt eberflus ousting young whippersnapper christian parker has taken over as defensive coordinator and garnered plenty of positive buzz he ll helm a defense that has undergone a colossal facelift in the offseason in addition to a pair of first rounders added to the mix dallas has signed safeties jalen thompson and p j locke along with cornerback cobie durant whilst trading for pass rusher rashan gary and linebacker dee winters dallas also has a full season ahead with pro bowler quinnen williams after he too was acquired via trade last season 2025 third round corner shavon revel played just seven games as a rookie rallying from an acl tear in college with downs likely to start from the get go lawrence and a host of other defensive draft picks have replenished the depth the turnover on this side of the ball is staggering but a fresh coat was needed after such a trying 2025 how the finished product ultimately looks will begin to take shape at camp for as ballyhooed as the dak prescott led offense has been the cowboys 2021 23 run of playoff appearances came with an offense and a defense ranked in the top seven in scoring back to top three key storylines 1 can giants get healthy stay healthy in camp harbaugh john harbaugh after 18 years with the ravens has arrived in gotham with plenty of fanfare but his team has already dealt with an alarming amount of injury exits rookie cornerback thaddeus dixon wide receiver special teamer gunner olszewski and defensive lineman roy robertson harris each stunningly suffered a torn achilles during organized team activities robertson harris injury is especially problematic considering the team traded away standout defensive tackle dexter lawrence abdul carter sprained his ankle in june while top receivers malik nabers knee and darius slayton core muscle surgery and second year running back cam skattebo ankle are on the mend as well monitoring the availability of nabers and skattebo for week 1 will carry on through the summer even though the latter has deemed himself a sure bet for the opener with harbaugh reputed to run tough practices the giants healing up and emerging unscathed is paramount 2 this is dart s team now at the start of last season jaxson dart waited his turn behind russell wilson after eventually getting handed the starting reins the first round pick weathered a debut campaign that saw him deal with injuries scrutiny for his devil may care scrambling and the firing of head coach brian daboll daboll and interim head coach mike kafka took turns navigating dart s first season now it s up to matt nagy to shepherd dart s growth the floor for dart is staying healthy the ceiling is what the big blue faithful are most excited about dart s development as a franchise signal caller is arguably the most important factor for the 2026 giants hype and hope have early expiration dates in the nfl so dart s second season is already a pivotal one after the qb showed plenty of potential 24 total touchdowns in his career opening campaign 3 big blue youth movement taking shape over the past two drafts the giants have stockpiled four first round picks carter dart lb arvell reese and ol francis mauigoa rookie wr malachi fields and first year cb colton hood a pair of day 2 picks in april figure to be big contributors though there is sterling veteran talent such as lt andrew thomas and olb brian burns the giants are a young squad looking to lay a winning foundation in the first year under harbaugh high draft spots and hype can provide anticipation but seeing the youngsters round into form this summer will be crucial for 2026 and beyond back to top three key storylines 1 hurts newest offensive scheme sean mannion is the latest offensive coordinator for the eagles and jalen hurts who truly found offensive bliss in 2022 his second and final season with shane steichen since then hurts has had a different offensive coordinator in each season even with kellen moore during a super bowl winning 2024 campaign philadelphia s passing game ebbed and flowed while running back saquon barkley largely fueled the offense drama was more prevalent last season than offensive chemistry as the passing game ranked 23rd in yards and the sputtering running attack diminished from the previous season s dominance hurts had a career best 25 touchdown passes but snapped a four season streak of double digit rushing scores finishing with eight last year s offense was far too predictable and stagnated on a seemingly weekly basis held to 20 points or less in 10 games including a dismal 23 19 playoff loss to the 49ers with o line guru jeff stoutland no longer coaching a group that was really the heartbeat of both of the eagles super bowl squads under nick sirianni the offense is undergoing more change than the annual alterations everyone s accustomed to a j brown is gone traded to the patriots in an offseason storyline that lingered for months all eyes are on hurts whose past accomplishments don t seem to hold too much weight with a feisty fanbase that believes its strong roster should be vying for lombardi trophies every year 2 new look wide receivers after four seasons two super bowl appearances and one lombardi trophy a j brown has departed philadelphia while brown s disharmony commanded the headlines he topped 1 000 yards receiving in each of his four years with the team devonta smith is now the unquestioned top target but gm howie roseman restocked the wr room with a trade for dontayvion wicks the signing of veteran speedster marquise brown and in the most exciting move the first round selection of makai lemon don t sleep on second round tight end eli stowers either the john mackey award winner from vanderbilt could line up all over the field as a 6 foot 4 matchup nightmare dallas goedert is back likely for one final season and smith one of the more underrated wideouts around adds to the familiarity overall though there is a freshness to the group that will need to come together in the summer but could liven up an all too often static offense from a season ago 3 what becomes of carter jalen carter seems to be on the brink of becoming perhaps the league s elite defensive tackle hence he s seeking a seismic extension which has led to trade speculation how it all plays out is sure to be headline fodder and it wouldn t feel right to be without some melodrama in philly furthermore defensive coordinator vic fangio is back and losing carter would be a magnificent blow a potential boon will be the additions of cornerback tariq woolen and pass rusher jonathan greenard no matter the pedigree not all players fit into fangio s scheme see bryce huff jalen ramsey jevon holland etc woolen is a physically gifted cover man who made his share of questionable plays with the seahawks it will be interesting seeing how the newbies fit into fangio s scheme but the prevailing matter at hand for the defense is carter s future back to top three key storylines 1 plenty on daniels plate there s a lot to accomplish for jayden daniels this summer following a disastrous 2025 season the commanders sputtered and the 2024 ap offensive rookie of the year missed 10 games due to injuries going just 2 5 in the games he played how daniels looks and feels after sustaining a sprained knee strained hamstring and dislocated left elbow is tops on the agenda he also needs to get acclimated to david blough s offense which will see daniels taking snaps under center far more now that his former assistant qb coach is his offensive coordinator after two seasons with kliff kingsbury in that role daniels is also in the latest season of netflix s quarterback series all eyes and a heap of responsibility will be on daniels how he bounces back and how well he adapts to a new offense could be the story of the commanders season 2 how does overhauled defense look when you fall from being everyone s nfc championship game darling to a 5 12 struggle bus you can run out of fingers to point the commanders put a massive under construction sign in front of a defense that finished dead last in yards allowed they used the no 7 overall pick on ohio state linebacker sonny styles an athletic marvel who will draw plenty of hype as a preseason defensive rookie of the year candidate general manager adam peters opened the check book before turning in the card to get styles too washington broke the bank to sign pass rusher odafe oweh while adding plenty more veteran starters elsewhere nickel amik robertson safety nick cross pass rusher k 39 lavon chaisson linebacker leo chenal and defensive tackle tim settle the commanders added veteran depth as well binging on free agents isn t always a winning formula of course how quickly new defensive coordinator daronte jones and washington s cast of fresh faces get on the same page will be crucial in camp 3 all set at skill spots daniels injuries were a giant issue in 2025 but not surrounding the blossoming franchise qb with enough talent at the skill spots also loomed large looking at the offensive roster on paper it s difficult to feel the commanders have remedied those ills terry mclaurin who dealt with a contract kerfuffle last year as well as ankle quad and pelvic injuries will hopefully be back to his pro bowl self with a full camp and good health however the team s wr corps hasn t added much to get overjoyed about dyami brown and van jefferson were signed in free agency while treylon burks and luke mccaffrey are both back none of those four reached 30 receptions or 400 yards in 2025 rookie third rounder antonio williams figures to jump right into the mix and will likely need to be a big contributor quickly elsewhere jacory croskey merritt should be the lead back after an 805 yard rookie campaign but he was hardly a consistent producer in year 1 the most notable additions are former titans tight end chigoziem okonkwo who should be a breakout candidate after three straight 50 catch seasons with tennessee and ex buccaneers running back rachaad white with blough s promotion to oc familiarity remains but this offensive roster is certainly a candidate for a veteran add or two in the weeks before the regular season commences back to top

how copacetic everything remains when camp kicks off 2 downs arrives with plenty of hype ohio state safety caleb downs was viewed as a top line talent in this year s draft the cowboys getting him at no 11 overall was a major boon since joining the team downs has garnered rave reviews the highest defensive selection for the franchise since morris claiborne at no 6 in 2012 downs fills a massive db need for dallas and could prove to be a steal how he looks when the pads are on will be must see viewing for the fans at camp and a pivotal point in the cowboys defensive reconstruction downs isn t the cowboys only 2026 first round selection though picked 23rd overall malachi lawrence is a pass rusher who some felt went earlier than he should ve he has plenty of upside though and the cowboys have plenty of pass rushing needs to fill after mustering just 35 sacks in 2025 tied for 22nd in the league 3 a whole new world on defense dallas defense was a sieve in 2025 finishing dead last in points allowed and 30th in total d perhaps it wasn t too surprising considering the cowboys traded away micah parsons just before the season arrived nonetheless the disastrous results led to matt eberflus ousting young whippersnapper christian parker has taken over as defensive coordinator and garnered plenty of positive buzz he ll helm a defense that has undergone a colossal facelift in the offseason in addition to a pair of first rounders added to the mix dallas has signed safeties jalen thompson and p j locke along with cornerback cobie durant whilst trading for pass rusher rashan gary and linebacker dee winters dallas also has a full season ahead with pro bowler quinnen williams after he too was acquired via trade last season 2025 third round corner shavon revel played just seven games as a rookie rallying from an acl tear in college with downs likely to start from the get go lawrence and a host of other defensive draft picks have replenished the depth the turnover on this side of the ball is staggering but a fresh coat was needed after such a trying 2025 how the finished product ultimately looks will begin to take shape at camp for as ballyhooed as the dak prescott led offense has been the cowboys 2021 23 run of playoff appearances came with an offense and a defense ranked in the top seven in scoring back to top three key storylines 1 can giants get healthy stay healthy in camp harbaugh john harbaugh after 18 years with the ravens has arrived in gotham with plenty of fanfare but his team has already dealt with an alarming amount of injury exits rookie cornerback thaddeus dixon wide receiver special teamer gunner olszewski and defensive lineman roy robertson harris each stunningly suffered a torn achilles during organized team activities robertson harris injury is especially problematic considering the team traded away standout defensive tackle dexter lawrence abdul carter sprained his ankle in june while top receivers malik nabers knee and darius slayton core muscle surgery and second year running back cam skattebo ankle are on the mend as well monitoring the availability of nabers and skattebo for week 1 will carry on through the summer even though the latter has deemed himself a sure bet for the opener with harbaugh reputed to run tough practices the giants healing up and emerging unscathed is paramount 2 this is dart s team now at the start of last season jaxson dart waited his turn behind russell wilson after eventually getting handed the starting reins the first round pick weathered a debut campaign that saw him deal with injuries scrutiny for his devil may care scrambling and the firing of head coach brian daboll daboll and interim head coach mike kafka took turns navigating dart s first season now it s up to matt nagy to shepherd dart s growth the floor for dart is staying healthy the ceiling is what the big blue faithful are most excited about dart s development as a franchise signal caller is arguably the most important factor for the 2026 giants hype and hope have early expiration dates in the nfl so dart s second season is already a pivotal one after the qb showed plenty of potential 24 total touchdowns in his career opening campaign 3 big blue youth movement taking shape over the past two drafts the giants have stockpiled four first round picks carter dart lb arvell reese and ol francis mauigoa rookie wr malachi fields and first year cb colton hood a pair of day 2 picks in april figure to be big contributors though there is sterling veteran talent such as lt andrew thomas and olb brian burns the giants are a young squad looking to lay a winning foundation in the first year under harbaugh high draft spots and hype can provide anticipation but seeing the youngsters round into form this summer will be crucial for 2026 and beyond back to top three key storylines 1 hurts newest offensive scheme sean mannion is the latest offensive coordinator for the eagles and jalen hurts who truly found offensive bliss in 2022 his second and final season with shane steichen since then hurts has had a different offensive coordinator in each season even with kellen moore during a super bowl winning 2024 campaign philadelphia s passing game ebbed and flowed while running back saquon barkley largely fueled the offense drama was more prevalent last season than offensive chemistry as the passing game ranked 23rd in yards and the sputtering running attack diminished from the previous season s dominance hurts had a career best 25 touchdown passes but snapped a four season streak of double digit rushing scores finishing with eight last year s offense was far too predictable and stagnated on a seemingly weekly basis held to 20 points or less in 10 games including a dismal 23 19 playoff loss to the 49ers with o line guru jeff stoutland no longer coaching a group that was really the heartbeat of both of the eagles super bowl squads under nick sirianni the offense is undergoing more change than the annual alterations everyone s accustomed to a j brown is gone traded to the patriots in an offseason storyline that lingered for months all eyes are on hurts whose past accomplishments don t seem to hold too much weight with a feisty fanbase that believes its strong roster should be vying for lombardi trophies every year 2 new look wide receivers after four seasons two super bowl appearances and one lombardi trophy a j brown has departed philadelphia while brown s disharmony commanded the headlines he topped 1 000 yards receiving in each of his four years with the team devonta smith is now the unquestioned top target but gm howie roseman restocked the wr room with a trade for dontayvion wicks the signing of veteran speedster marquise brown and in the most exciting move the first round selection of makai lemon don t sleep on second round tight end eli stowers either the john mackey award winner from vanderbilt could line up all over the field as a 6 foot 4 matchup nightmare dallas goedert is back likely for one final season and smith one of the more underrated wideouts around adds to the familiarity overall though there is a freshness to the group that will need to come together in the summer but could liven up an all too often static offense from a season ago 3 what becomes of carter jalen carter seems to be on the brink of becoming perhaps the league s elite defensive tackle hence he s seeking a seismic extension which has led to trade speculation how it all plays out is sure to be headline fodder and it wouldn t feel right to be without some melodrama in philly furthermore defensive coordinator vic fangio is back and losing carter would be a magnificent blow a potential boon will be the additions of cornerback tariq woolen and pass rusher jonathan greenard no matter the pedigree not all players fit into fangio s scheme see bryce huff jalen ramsey jevon holland etc woolen is a physically gifted cover man who made his share of questionable plays with the seahawks it will be interesting seeing how the newbies fit into fangio s scheme but the prevailing matter at hand for the defense is carter s future back to top three key storylines 1 plenty on daniels plate there s a lot to accomplish for jayden daniels this summer following a disastrous 2025 season the commanders sputtered and the 2024 ap offensive rookie of the year missed 10 games due to injuries going just 2 5 in the games he played how daniels looks and feels after sustaining a sprained knee strained hamstring and dislocated left elbow is tops on the agenda he also needs to get acclimated to david blough s offense which will see daniels taking snaps under center far more now that his former assistant qb coach is his offensive coordinator after two seasons with kliff kingsbury in that role daniels is also in the latest season of netflix s quarterback series all eyes and a heap of responsibility will be on daniels how he bounces back and how well he adapts to a new offense could be the story of the commanders season 2 how does overhauled defense look when you fall from being everyone s nfc championship game darling to a 5 12 struggle bus you can run out of fingers to point the commanders put a massive under construction sign in front of a defense that finished dead last in yards allowed they used the no 7 overall pick on ohio state linebacker sonny styles an athletic marvel who will draw plenty of hype as a preseason defensive rookie of the year candidate general manager adam peters opened the check book before turning in the card to get styles too washington broke the bank to sign pass rusher odafe oweh while adding plenty more veteran starters elsewhere nickel amik robertson safety nick cross pass rusher k 39 lavon chaisson linebacker leo chenal and defensive tackle tim settle the commanders added veteran depth as well binging on free agents isn t always a winning formula of course how quickly new defensive coordinator daronte jones and washington s cast of fresh faces get on the same page will be crucial in camp 3 all set at skill spots daniels injuries were a giant issue in 2025 but not surrounding the blossoming franchise qb with enough talent at the skill spots also loomed large looking at the offensive roster on paper it s difficult to feel the commanders have remedied those ills terry mclaurin who dealt with a contract kerfuffle last year as well as ankle quad and pelvic injuries will hopefully be back to his pro bowl self with a full camp and good health however the team s wr corps hasn t added much to get overjoyed about dyami brown and van jefferson were signed in free agency while treylon burks and luke mccaffrey are both back none of those four reached 30 receptions or 400 yards in 2025 rookie third rounder antonio williams figures to jump right into the mix and will likely need to be a big contributor quickly elsewhere jacory croskey merritt should be the lead back after an 805 yard rookie campaign but he was hardly a consistent producer in year 1 the most notable additions are former titans tight end chigoziem okonkwo who should be a breakout candidate after three straight 50 catch seasons with tennessee and ex buccaneers running back rachaad white with blough s promotion to oc familiarity remains but this offensive roster is certainly a candidate for a veteran add or two in the weeks before the regular season commences back to top

material_news_signals.headline: John Harbaugh on why Giants cut Odell Beckham Jr.: 'We weren't getting enough'
material_news_signals.body_text: the new york giants released wide receiver odell beckham on tuesday beckham drafted by new york in 2014 rejoined the giants this offseason in a much celebrated reunion however the 33 year old 39 s second act in new york did not go the way he or the team hoped beckham made little impact in the giants 39 first three games this season fielding just one target and failing to record a catch he played just 20 snaps this year according to pro football reference 34 we just weren 39 t getting enough 34 coach john harbaugh said wednesday 34 it just wasn 39 t working for us like i told him i wanted to be able to give more i wanted him to be able to do more i wanted to get him on the field more for whatever reason we weren 39 t able to do it put it on us we weren 39 t able to get it done 133 roster spot wise we need more out of that spot 133 it 39 s nothing about odell nothing that he could do 133 i was hoping we could make it work and we didn 39 t 34 34 i hope he lands somewhere he 39 s a great friend i love the guy 34 beckham 39 s lone target this season came this past sunday in the win over the tennessee titans at one point during that game a group of fans began chanting 34 obj obj 34 when the offense was on the field seemingly hoping to spur the team into getting the ball to their beloved star but like his second stint with the franchise it didn 39 t go the way they hoped 34 it 39 s what was best for the team and if you think it was anything else then you don 39 t know me 34 harbaugh said when pressed about why beckham was released 34 it 39 s nothing more than that it 39 s not doing enough for our offense it 39 s not doing enough for our team so we need to make a change 133 there 39 s no deep conversation there 39 s no conspiracy theory we 39 re trying to win games 34 while beckham 39 s release isn 39 t what the team or fans wanted it was always within the range of possibilities for beckham who at this stage of his career isn 39 t the same caliber of receiver who created so many highlight reel plays for the giants during his first few years in new york that was the player who harbaugh hoped he and giants fans would see three days after the beckham signing became official harbaugh talked about what he told beckham before the team signed him 34 we talked about this he would tell you this 39 you can 39 t be just ok you 39 re odell beckham you 39 ve got to come out here and you have to be performing at a high level in workouts you 39 ve got to be performing at a high level in practice you 39 ve got to be a guy capable that we can see would have a chance to make a difference in nfl games you have to be that kind of player 39 34 he understood that so get to work we 39 re going to find out over the course of the next week and training camp if that 39 s going to be something he 39 s going to be able to do for the team if he can great if he can 39 t then that 39 s ok too but he 39 ll have taken his shot 34 as harbaugh said beckham understood that he 39 d have to earn a spot on the roster and late into camp it looked like he might miss the cut he rarely impressed during camp and made mistakes including a dropped touchdown pass during the preseason that a player fighting for a roster spot couldn 39 t afford to make however when veteran receiver calvin austin tore his acl in late august it opened the door for beckham to make the roster and to his credit beckham responded to the opportunity by delivering his strongest week of camp beckham got emotional when he was told after the giants 39 final preseason game that he had made the cut 34 just my family being here seeing my son at the game 133 i had those tears when i got back to the hotel after figuring out i 39 m going to be here 34 beckham said at the time 34 and i have an opportunity to rewrite some of the last bit of the chapter 133 i just know i 39 m going to give my all but definitely had that moment where it was like you could let out some of the pain that i went through it was a very healing very emotional something i was very happy about 34 after releasing beckham the giants signed wide receiver kick returner braxton berrios to their active 53 man roster the team had exhausted his practice squad elevation eligibility the first three weeks berrios is one of four receivers on the 53 man roster joining malik nabers rookie malachi fields and darnell mooney the giants do not plan to bring beckham back to the practice squad this article originally appeared in the athletic

weekend patrick mahomes took care of business against a scrappy dolphins defense in week 3 he shook off a big hit that drew a roughing the passer penalty and left him clutching his lower back to help the chiefs leave miami with a two score victory dak prescott continues to power a cowboys offense that can throw it against anyone and will be required to do so as long as their defense continues to lag behind it was especially nice to see him connect with both ceedee lamb and george pickens against the ravens josh allen was a bit of a mess against the chargers turning the ball over three times his second half fumble should have cost the bills much more than it did he s good for one of these games per year so i m not too concerned about what it means going forward after crumbling against the broncos trevor lawrence got back on the horse and torched the patriots he produced a wildly entertaining sequence in which he threw two absurd touchdown passes to parker washington the first was nullified by penalty but i still wish he wouldn t have taken a knee when he was six inches from a rushing score and there were still nine minutes left in the game if you re not watching him throw the football you need to catch up before week 4 it s among the prettiest displays in the nfl next gen stats insight via nfl pro purdy threw for 297 yards and four touchdowns in the 49ers week 3 win over the cardinals purdy was most efficient in the quick passing game finishing 8 of 10 for 180 yards and two touchdowns his 18 yards per attempt on quick passes is the highest mark in a game in the ngs era among qbs with at least 10 quick attempts purdy targeted george kittle on five of his 10 quick throws with kittle catching four of those passes for 50 yards and a td tier 2 jared goff has been excellent in 2026 powering a passing attack that isn t afraid to rely heavily on jahmyr gibbs to open up opportunities elsewhere it s similar to what we ve seen from goff in recent years although they re weathering offensive line challenges better than they did last season lamar jackson wasn t quite stellar against the cowboys in rio but he delivered in key spots and benefitted greatly from the return of zay flowers joe burrow is making big plays and leaning heavily on ja marr chase when he s in need of a completion but the steelers strip sack of burrow cost the bengals a chance to secure a thrilling win matthew stafford s second half struggles against the broncos pressure dampened the fun i ve had watching him connect with davante adams it s pretty clear stafford misses puka nacua kirk cousins is off to a fantastic start throwing three touchdown passes in each of his first three contests that ties his longest career streak of games with at least three td passes and gives him the nfl s longest active such streak that s a sentence i know you didn t expect to read in 2026 next gen stats insight via nfl pro the broncos generated pressure on 59 3 of dropbacks in the second half against the rams after doing so on only 23 5 of dropbacks in the first half against pressure stafford completed just 6 of 20 passes for 81 yards taking four sacks and throwing a pick six from a clean pocket stafford finished 24 of 35 for 309 yards two touchdowns and an interception tier 3 this is admittedly a strange week for the qb index two backups case keenum and marcus mariota excelled in different ways in their first starts of 2026 both led their teams to thrilling home wins and aaron rodgers played perhaps his best game since he was a packer anyone who thinks the jets have lost two in a row due to quarterback play is very much mistaken geno smith has been very sharp and heroically threw new york back into a game at detroit that came down to the wire before he fumbled to end the jets chances we probably won t have another week like this for quite some time so fans of graybeards should soak it up while we re here sam darnold s return from injury was fraught with turnovers but between the back breaking mistakes he made some fantastic throws primarily to jaxon smith njigba and piled up 379 passing yards next gen stats insight via nfl pro rodgers completed 6 of 11 pass attempts under pressure for 121 yards and a touchdown in the steelers week 3 win rodgers tied for his most passing yards under pressure in a game since week 10 of 2020 he entered week 3 with a 43 5 completion percentage and 92 passing yards under pressure this season rodgers threw two deep 20 air yards td passes in the first quarter after he had failed to complete a single deep pass on nine attempts through the first two weeks tier 4 jacoby brissett let it fire 52 times out of necessity against the 49ers and is finding consistent success by leaning on trey mcbride unfortunately it doesn t look like he can carry the cardinals to victory against nfc west competition by most standards brissett is embodying the dalton line which is what the cardinals likely hoped to get from him in 2026 tyler shough slips in the rankings after a disastrous fourth quarter against the raiders he accounted for three turnovers in the final 13 minutes reversing course on a reputation that was being built on clutch performances bo nix rises after taking what the rams defense gave him in the second half he did just enough to help the broncos mount a wild comeback although he s still not reliable enough for me to move him any higher c j stroud is largely playing it safe until he absolutely must find a route to the end zone the texans are going to need more from him to dig out of their 0 3 hole justin herbert is making a habit of following up remarkable passes with brain melting mistakes or as tom brady called it during the chargers bills broadcast serving up a meatball sub to the defense bryce young s hot start came to a screeching halt against a feisty browns defense and jalen coker s injury related departure didn t help matters daniel jones accounted for three turnovers and nearly gave the game against the texans away with a fumble before helping the colts move into range for the game winning field goal michael penix started slowly but found a nice rhythm in his first start of 2026 he can thank the football gods for putting him on the same team as bijan robinson deshaun watson hasn t been close to consistent over four quarters but he has made the plays the browns needed late in the last two games he continues to build a promising rapport with rookie receiver denzel boston giving browns fans hope heading into week 4 next gen stats insight via nfl pro herbert finished 20 of 34 for 226 yards one touchdown and one interception in week 3 against the bills on deep throws 20 air yards herbert was 1 of 7 for 29 yards and an interception herbert has now thrown more interceptions on deep balls this season 3 than he did in each of the previous two seasons 2 in 2024 2 in 2025 tier 5 this tier pains me to assemble because i know two of these three quarterbacks hurts and love are much better than their current rankings indicate that might be why they ve dropped so precipitously as their struggles have been especially frustrating to watch jalen hurts began the season by pushing the eagles to two wins with largely positive play while sprinkling in a few errors but his showing in chicago on monday night was downright abysmal it wasn t just the interception hurts reverted to the indecisive quarterback who was unwilling to play aggressively enough to lift the eagles out of the hole they d dug for themselves his coach s crunch time decisions didn t help much either jordan love is in a similarly tough spot his offense lacks a running game his offensive line is banged up and the entire operation is stuck in first gear love will rip a few beautiful throws every week but all it does is tease us because the rest of the experience is filled with nothing but disappointment malik willis is operating in an offense that lost de 39 von achane torn acl and is leaning on a collection of pass catchers that is undoubtedly the worst in the nfl he and the dolphins offense can move the ball but they still have a hard time finishing drives i appreciate the effort he s made but the results remain underwhelming next gen stats insight via nfl pro hurts completed 16 of 25 pass attempts but averaged just 6 1 yards per attempt monday night throwing only six passes 24 10 air yards downfield on those throws he completed two 33 3 for 49 yards all season lows the eagles went three and out on three straight drives to start the third quarter with hurts completing three of five attempts for six yards none of those attempts traveled more than 10 air yards tier 6 i m calling this the searching for answers tier because it s filled with quarterbacks who don t seem to have many right now kyler murray looked unsettled at best in his first game back and justin jefferson s departure due to injury didn t help matters baker mayfield spent another sunday appearing uncomfortable in zac robinson s offense while trying his best to play hero before suffering a thumb injury that will cost him multiple weeks cam ward was the latest to fall victim to a downpour at metlife stadium although he also had a collection of pass catchers drop on target passes before he threw away the titans last chance to win by tossing an interception in the end zone drake maye is the most lost of all accounting for three giveaways an unforced fumble and two ghastly interceptions that tanked the patriots chances of competing in jacksonville seriously throwing their season into uncertain waters of all of these quarterbacks i m most concerned about maye who looks nothing like the nfl mvp finalist he was in 2025 and seems completely adrift and sapped of his confidence jameis winston meanwhile is who he is a cart ride down a mine shaft with no guarantee it leads to daylight but will include a few exciting twists and turns next gen stats insight via nfl pro against pressure maye went 6 of 11 for 81 yards and an interception in week 3 without pressure he went 8 of 14 for 118 yards and an interception maye averaged a 3 42 second time to throw the second longest of his career with 25 of his attempts coming outside the pocket the fourth highest rate of his career outside the pocket maye went 3 of 7 for 57 yards and an interception totaling eight scramble dropbacks

news_mentions.headline: Giants trade for Vikings QB J.J. McCarthy following Jaxson Dart injury
news_mentions.description: The Giants have acquired quarterback J.J. McCarthy from the Vikings in a trade, Minnesota announced Monday.
news_mentions.body_text: the minnesota vikings have officially moved on from j j mccarthy the vikings traded the 2024 no 10 overall pick to the new york giants in exchange for a 2027 fifth rounder the team announced on monday minnesota cashed out on mccarthy after just 10 starts in which he struggled mightily with accuracy the vikings move on from the 23 year old was telegraphed during the offseason when the club sought free agent kyler murray and re signed veteran carson wentz minnesota gave mccarthy a cursory shot to win a job during training camp but he ultimately was squeezed out mccarthy missed his entire rookie season after suffering a preseason knee injury the vikings then watched sam darnold and daniel jones walk out of the building during the 2025 offseason handing the reins to their first round pick mccarthy however struggled to stay healthy and when on the field was scattershot showing only brief glimpses of consistently moving the offense in his 10 starts last year his only appearances in a vikings jersey mccarthy completed 57 6 of his passes for 1 632 yards with 11 touchdowns and 12 interceptions during training camp and preseason the struggles continued and it became clear the vikings couldn t trust mccarthy even as the primary backup with the former first rounder relegated to an inactive emergency third qb to start the season it was only a matter of time before minnesota shipped him out of town the move clears roughly 4 5 million from the vikings books not nothing but a pittance for the qb position kevin o connell once famously said i believe that organizations fail young quarterbacks before young quarterbacks fail organizations in relation to mccarthy the giants are hoping the vikings gave up on the youngster too quickly with jaxson dart out for the regular season after suffering a week 2 knee injury the giants planned to bring in more quarterback help mccarthy s arrival gives john harbaugh s team a young passer to build on as they work through the season mccarthy s best days came at michigan under jim harbaugh perhaps his brother can coax positive play where koc failed jameis winston is currently qb1 in new york but his play has been more in line with a spot starter than a passer who can succeed over a 15 game stretch john harbaugh told reporters on monday that winston will start new york s week 4 game against the cardinals all the other conversation isn t going to help us beat the cardinals so it s irrelevant harbaugh said jameis will be the starter for as long as i can see into the future big blue now has another option if winston s play further deteriorates or he gets injured the giants previously signed jake haener one career start with new orleans from the practice squad to the active roster for sunday s win over the titans how quickly mccarthy gets up to speed in the new offense could determine when he might see the field for new york

news_mentions.headline: Giants' Brian Burns suffered torn ACL in win over Titans, will miss remainder of season
news_mentions.description: The Giants have suffered another major injury early in the 2026 season. Star pass rusher Brian Burns is believed to have suffered a torn ACL in Sunday’s win over Tennessee.
news_mentions.body_text: the new york giants have suffered another major injury early in the 2026 season star pass rusher brian burns suffered a torn acl in sunday s win over tennessee coach john harbaugh said monday the injury requires surgery and will knock the three time pro bowler out for the season burns who was playing through an ankle injury went down early in the fourth quarter and did not return to sunday s 12 7 victory over the titans in three games burns generated five qb pressures per next gen stats including four on sunday the loss of burns is a big blow to the 2 1 giants who were already trying to stay on track in harbaugh s first season without starting quarterback jaxson dart who was lost in week 2 to a knee injury with burns out the giants will lean on abdul carter and kayvon thibodeaux it will be interesting to see if big blue tweaks rookie linebacker arvell reese s role as well to help fill the void in two weeks the giants have lost two massive stars as they attempt to flip the script in the nfc east new york has a winnable slate ahead with the 1 2 cardinals 1 2 commanders and 1 2 saints over the next three weeks harbaugh s job of turning around a team that s lived in the cellar the past two seasons is becoming harder by the week

news_mentions.headline: 2025 NFL position battles: Picks to win 10 notable training camp competitions across the league
news_mentions.description: With training camps opening across the NFL, which position battles demand your attention? Kevin Patra spotlights 10 intriguing competitions, including four quarterback derbies.
news_mentions.body_text: summer is over for pigskin professionals the nfl is back with training camps opening across the league it s time for the competitions for jobs to commence competition is the name of the game for every squad it s what breeds improvement and ultimately leads to winning certain positions with limited rep sharing lend themselves to more notable battles you won t see many defensive competitions highlighted mainly because the hefty rotations and matchup centric usage tend to make camp fights less impactful as the season approaches below are the top 10 camp battles i ll be monitoring throughout training camp and into the preseason

news_mentions.headline: New York Giants training camp 2025 preview: Key dates, notable additions, biggest storylines
news_mentions.description: With NFL training camp season upon us, Jeremy Bergman provides a refresher on the New York Giants' roster changes, position battles and notable subplots.
news_mentions.body_text: with 2025 nfl training camps set to open it s time to get up to speed on all 32 nfl teams jeremy bergman has the lowdown on position battles key players and notable subplots across the nfc east catch up on the new york giants offseason developments and 2025 outlook below training camp dates information players report july 15 rookies july 22 veterans location quest diagnostics training facility east rutherford new jersey fan information notable roster changes preseason schedule week 1 at buffalo bills 1 p m et on saturday aug 9 nfl network week 2 vs new york jets 7 p m et on saturday aug 16 nfl network week 3 vs new england patriots 8 p m et on thursday aug 21 prime video 2025 schedule note despite finishing the 2024 season tied for the worst overall record the giants enter the 2025 campaign with the hardest strength of schedule in the league for context the two other three win teams from last season the browns and titans rank 13th and 29th in sos respectively nfl research what you need to know 1 not quite the four headed monster in cleveland the giants quarterback quartet will still be an oddity to watch this summer tommy devito is the lone returning signal caller from 2024 but is slated to be qb4 if that by season s beginning new york imported two charismatic leaders in russell wilson and jameis winston with the former expected to take starting reps throughout the summer the giants also added rookie jaxson dart trading back into the first round to get brian daboll s guy there are too many cooks in the kitchen in east rutherford new jersey but the recipe for success is there wilson and winston show dart how it s done displaying different ways to lead and play in the nfl devito downloads his knowledge of daboll s system to the new trio dart makes incremental progress and eventually takes over for wilson midway through a grueling regular season will someone or something unexpected a trade spice up the narrative this summer 2 dart s shock selection diverted the excitement around the giants first first rounder no 3 overall pick abdul carter but the penn state product will take center stage this summer as part of a fearsome foursome up front pairing with fellow pass rushers brian burns and kayvon thibodeaux and star interior lineman dexter lawrence carter s addition gives the giants their best pressure pack since the nascar units drove new york to two super bowl titles in the eli manning era against an offensive line looking to re establish itself the pass rush should get a lot of opportunities this summer to show off and cause havoc in the giants qb quarrel during joint practices and maybe even in some preseason games 3 the culture change on new york s offense will trickle down from the revamped qb room but what to make of the rest of the giants attack aside from star 24 rookies malik nabers and tyrone tracy the cupboard is pretty bare at the skill positions wan 39 dale robinson darius slayton and zach pascal help fill out the wr corps with a number of jobs up for grabs cam skattebo is an exciting or at least name brand addition at rb but how big a factor will the rookie play this summer and fall the tight end corps is anonymous the offensive line returns its starting five from last year but could be in flux with former starting tackle evan neal moving inside to guard and andrew thomas returning from a season ending injury with daboll and general manager joe schoen s job on the line again this season n y needs this offense to be running at full speed out of the gate a summer addition at wr could be in the offing regardless expect a lot of moving and shaking before week 1

material_news_signals.headline: Giants trade for Vikings QB J.J. McCarthy following Jaxson Dart injury
material_news_signals.description: The Giants have acquired quarterback J.J. McCarthy from the Vikings in a trade, Minnesota announced Monday.
material_news_signals.body_text: the minnesota vikings have officially moved on from j j mccarthy the vikings traded the 2024 no 10 overall pick to the new york giants in exchange for a 2027 fifth rounder the team announced on monday minnesota cashed out on mccarthy after just 10 starts in which he struggled mightily with accuracy the vikings move on from the 23 year old was telegraphed during the offseason when the club sought free agent kyler murray and re signed veteran carson wentz minnesota gave mccarthy a cursory shot to win a job during training camp but he ultimately was squeezed out mccarthy missed his entire rookie season after suffering a preseason knee injury the vikings then watched sam darnold and daniel jones walk out of the building during the 2025 offseason handing the reins to their first round pick mccarthy however struggled to stay healthy and when on the field was scattershot showing only brief glimpses of consistently moving the offense in his 10 starts last year his only appearances in a vikings jersey mccarthy completed 57 6 of his passes for 1 632 yards with 11 touchdowns and 12 interceptions during training camp and preseason the struggles continued and it became clear the vikings couldn t trust mccarthy even as the primary backup with the former first rounder relegated to an inactive emergency third qb to start the season it was only a matter of time before minnesota shipped him out of town the move clears roughly 4 5 million from the vikings books not nothing but a pittance for the qb position kevin o connell once famously said i believe that organizations fail young quarterbacks before young quarterbacks fail organizations in relation to mccarthy the giants are hoping the vikings gave up on the youngster too quickly with jaxson dart out for the regular season after suffering a week 2 knee injury the giants planned to bring in more quarterback help mccarthy s arrival gives john harbaugh s team a young passer to build on as they work through the season mccarthy s best days came at michigan under jim harbaugh perhaps his brother can coax positive play where koc failed jameis winston is currently qb1 in new york but his play has been more in line with a spot starter than a passer who can succeed over a 15 game stretch john harbaugh told reporters on monday that winston will start new york s week 4 game against the cardinals all the other conversation isn t going to help us beat the cardinals so it s irrelevant harbaugh said jameis will be the starter for as long as i can see into the future big blue now has another option if winston s play further deteriorates or he gets injured the giants previously signed jake haener one career start with new orleans from the practice squad to the active roster for sunday s win over the titans how quickly mccarthy gets up to speed in the new offense could determine when he might see the field for new york

news_mentions.headline: Browns coach Todd Monken sees room for Deshaun Watson to improve after back-to-back wins
news_mentions.description: Browns coach Todd Monken says he sees room for QB Deshaun Watson to improve after leading the team to back-to-back wins.
news_mentions.body_text: browns quarterback deshaun watson didn t have to worry about boos from the cleveland faithful following sunday s fourth quarter rally that pushed the team to 2 1 the first time the club has held a winning record since 2023 watson was far from perfect in the 21 18 victory over the panthers but he made the plays that mattered late to secure the win twice answering carolina s fourth quarter scores first year head coach todd monken likes what he s seen from the veteran qb but knows he still has strides to make i m just really happy for him monken told reporters on monday again the work he s put in certainly he knows he can play better we can certainly coach better around him and all we re trying to do is this week clean up what we can clean up in a short week and be ready to go and be as fresh as we can be for thursday night to better put our best foot forward watson missed a host of passes many badly the scattershot nature of his throws especially some attempts toward rookie wide receiver kc concepcion that were uncatchable is an issue watson must clean up he completed 16 of 30 passes for 144 yards and two tds he also was somewhat lucky not to throw an interception a few times he didn t look skittish in the pocket though unlike previous years watson has improved his pocket movement and used his legs with aplomb on sunday scampering 11 times for 45 yards one of the biggest issues with watson since his arrival in cleveland has been panicked throws under duress those were mostly absent on sunday that s a positive sign for monken watson and the offense have areas to clean up starting with his rhythm we ll see if he can harness accuracy particularly downfield where he s struggled and rarely attempted to go 23 2 deep attempts through three weeks per next gen stats no one who watches watson sees the same player he was early in his career with the texans however he s finally showing an ability to move the offense and conjure enough magic in the big moments given where he s been the past few years even that baby step is significant for the browns

news_mentions.headline: Chargers' Jim Harbaugh challenges Justin Herbert to 'be better' after team's 0-3 start
news_mentions.description: Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh said he wants to see Justin Herbert "be better" with the team still searching for its first win of the season.
news_mentions.body_text: even justin herbert s most staunch defender wants to see more from the quarterback los angeles chargers head coach jim harbaugh told reporters on monday that he wants to see improved decision making from the quarterback be better be better harbaugh said and that drives justin that drives me that drives his position coach that drives mike mcdaniel the coordinator i mean drives us all given harbaugh s insistence on defending the quarterback at seemingly every turn since he was hired before the 2024 season it s a notable critique herbert finished 20 of 34 for 226 yards one touchdown and one interception in the team s 24 16 loss to the bills on sunday which dropped los angeles to 0 3 this season he struggled particularly on deep throws 20 air yards going 1 of 7 for 29 yards and an int herbert has now thrown more deep pass interceptions this season 3 than in either of the previous two seasons 2 in 2024 2 in 2025 the qb has thrown an interception while failing to throw for multiple touchdowns in four consecutive starts dating back to week 17 of last season it ties cooper rush and daniel jones for the longest active streak in the nfl and the longest of herbert s career the chargers failed to capitalize on five forced turnovers on sunday as the offense struggled to punch in scores going 1 of 4 in the red zone as the defense gave l a repeated chances to thwart josh allen s bills herbert and co never found a groove after three weeks it s been a rusty operation and herbert doesn t appear comfortable in the scheme yet the interior of the offensive line getting repeatedly blasted doesn t help also the pass catching corps hasn t aided the qb suffering from drops on sunday the whole operation is a mess and it starts with the qb we want to be better we got to be better we got to look at our scheme harbaugh said we got to look at how we re performing how we re doing things and who s doing it

news_mentions.headline: Eagles-Bears on 'Monday Night Football': What We Learned from Chicago's 27-7 win over Philadelphia
news_mentions.description: NFL.com's Bobby Kownack unpacks Case Keenum and the Bears' upset victory on Monday night against Jalen Hurts and the Eagles.
news_mentions.body_text: keenum shines during first start in three years monday night marked case keenum s first start since christmas eve 2023 yet he didn t look one bit rusty he settled in right from the start going 5 of 6 for 45 yards on the opening drive finishing it off with an underhanded touchdown toss to luther burden that the wideout somehow scored after getting stuffed at the 5 yard line fighting through contact and getting pushed by a sleuth of bears across the end line it was fascinating to see keenum run johnson s offense more in the style of jared goff the way it was when johnson put himself on the map as offensive coordinator of the lions caleb williams makes magic but he also led qualified passers last year with a time to throw of 3 20 seconds and after two games in 2026 again topped the category at 3 42 per nfl pro goff averaged 2 75 seconds to throw in three years under johnson keenum kept a similar schedule and excelled going 14 for 20 for 145 yards and two touchdowns on throws under 2 5 seconds he finished with 247 yards and the two tds on 24 of 34 passing overall and the old man also rushed one in at 38 years and 223 days old keenum became the oldest player in bears history to score a rushing touchdown it was as good of a return to a starting lineup as keenum could ve hoped for the bears could still potentially turn to tyson bagent moving forward for however long williams hamstring injury keeps him out but keenum made that decision a little bit more difficult more importantly he made it clear chicago will be in good hands no matter what for the duration of williams recovery eagles fail to find offensive rhythm philadelphia dealt with one setback after another to begin the night offensively an intentional grounding by jalen hurts doomed a promising first drive tank bigsby then fumbled away the eagles second possession at his own 15 yard line and a terrible andy dalton interception at the goal line while hurts was being evaluated and shortly after cleared for a concussion led to an early deficit the eagles did mount a great two minute drill highlighted by a buzzer beater qb sneak for six by hurts to make it 10 7 but nothing worked on the other side of the half after dashing though massive lanes for 73 yards on 11 carries in the first half saquon barkley was completely stymied in the next two frames he managed only 9 more rushing yards hurts gave an easy interception to linebacker t j edwards by telegraphing a fourth down pass to devonta smith and should ve thrown another one to his former teammate earlier in the game when edwards dropped into the passing lane the eagles second half included three punts the aforementioned int a turnover on downs and 52 net yards of offense it was a concerning night against a defense thought to be exploitable bears defense continues rebound chicago came into the tilt with a poor reputation on the defensive side after allowing 37 points to the panthers in week 1 holding the vikings to nine points during a loss in terrible weather didn t do much to change the prevailing opinion that the eagles should have their way that looked to be the case early with saquon barkley seemingly on the verge of breaking a big one on nearly every first half carry but chicago emerged to disavow such a notion barkley who looked so explosive over the first two quarters was shut down the rest of the way jalen hurts couldn t get anything going either managing just 153 passing yards and an interception with his rushing score at the end of the second frame standing as philly s only points the bears also showed shades of the unit that led the league with 33 takeaways last year winning the turnover battle 3 0 austin booker delivered his best peanut punch impression to free the ball from tank bigsby s grasp and set chicago up in the red zone in the first quarter on the next drive rookie dillon thieneman who led the team with six tackles collected his first career interception in the end zone on a third and goal pass from the 2 t j edwards fourth down pick at the end of the third quarter greased the hinges before chicago s subsequent 13 play 52 yard td drive slammed the door on an eagles comeback it s not yet clear if the game said more about philadelphia s offense than chicago s d but it was promising nonetheless philadelphia finally gets bitten by uneven play the eagles made it to 2 0 by the skin of their teeth stopping a commanders two point conversion in week 1 to avoid overtime and requiring a game winning two minute drill to dispatch the now 0 3 titans in week 2 the margin for error should presumably have been manageable against the bears third string quarterback unfortunately for the philly faithful the eagles went on to make a parade of errors even while turning the bears one dimensional early on by allowing only 27 rushing yards in the first half a great accomplishment considering chicago ran all over them for 281 yards last season the eagles could not stop case keenum and co consistently through the air penalties were a big problem as well philadelphia doubled chicago s five penalties getting tagged for 10 infractions and 61 penalty yards the secondary committed three penalties that resulted in first downs two of which came on third down plays with the game still technically in reach defensive tackle moro ojomo committed a neutral zone infraction on a fourth and 2 when the bears seemed content to let keenum break off the rust on his hard count until the play clock expired too many mistakes let the bears blow things open and the eagles offense was too stuck in the mud to do anything about it johnson puts on masterclass it wasn t only case keenum s first start in three years it was also the first time ben johnson has ever called plays for a backup quarterback the result not too shabby johnson s script on the opening drive was flawless as five different players touched the ball and keenum was able to settle in with mostly short conservative throws on the way to a touchdown even with the rushing attack failing to find much traction until late johnson kept keenum firing scheming his full arsenal of players open for the veteran signal caller kalif raymond caught six of seven targets for 90 yards his most exciting play of the night a 41 yard score on which he had the entire left side of the field available to run after the catch coming wide open across the middle and then beating the one high safety andrew mukuba to the end zone luther burden also had seven receptions for 61 yards and a td rome odunze should have caught his first score of the season all alone in the end zone but dropped it and johnson eventually got the running game going with chicago amassing 101 rushing yards in the second half to help close out the game there were a few blips namely the play calling becoming too timid at times early on in the red zone with a third string qb which delayed chicago pulling away that s about the only thing you can ding johnson for on the night it was a stellar showcase of play calling might next gen stats insight for eagles bears via nfl pro the bears aligned under center on 58 0 of offensive plays their highest rate since week 14 of the 2025 season nfl research case keenum is the second player aged 38 or older with two plus passing touchdowns and a rushing touchdown in a prime time game joining tom brady week 5 2018

news_mentions.headline: Buccaneers QB Baker Mayfield out at least 3 weeks with thumb injury; rookie Jalon Daniels to start
news_mentions.description: Jalon Daniels will start at quarterback for the Buccaneers with Baker Mayfield sidelined by his thumb injury.
news_mentions.body_text: for the first time in four years the buccaneers will be starting someone other than baker mayfield at quarterback in week 4 bucs head coach todd bowles told reporters on monday that mayfield will miss a minimum of three weeks after dislocating his right thumb in the team s 23 16 loss to the vikings on sunday tampa bay will start undrafted rookie jalon daniels in mayfield s place when it hosts the 1 2 packers on oct 4 daniels went 0 for 3 passing with a game ending interception after coming on in relief of mayfield against minnesota daniels also gained 9 yards on one rushing attempt the last qb other than mayfield to start for tampa was tom brady back in the 2022 season nfl network insider ian rapoport reported earlier on monday that an mri revealed no for the bucs who are still searching for their first win the 31 year old mayfield signed a three year 165 million contract extension five days before the start of the 2026 season through three games the practice squad stick is in his seventh nfl season and started four games for the chargers in 2023

news_mentions.headline: NFL Network: Case Keenum expected to start for Bears vs. Eagles
news_mentions.description: Tyson Bagent cleared concussion protocol late last week, but the Chicago Bears will roll with veteran Case Keenum on Monday night versus the Philadelphia Eagles.
news_mentions.body_text: the chicago bears will roll with qb3 versus the philadelphia eagles chicago is expected to start case keenum on monday night football nfl network insider ian rapoport reported monday morning the news had been trending that way after backup tyson bagent spent most of the week in concussion protocol starter caleb williams was already ruled out due to a hamstring injury bagent was cleared from concussion protocol on sunday but took part in only one practice with his backup missing the game plan install for a good eagles defense bears coach ben johnson will roll with keenum to start week 3 the 38 year old keenum hasn t thrown a regular season pass since two starts with the houston texans in december 2023 in his 14th nfl season keenum has made 66 career starts with a 62 3 completion rate 79 touchdowns and 51 interceptions at this stage having hung around the past couple of years more for his mentorship function keenum is an unknown clearly johnson trusts him to run his complex offense ensure they re in the right play and make the proper read however we don t know how lively keenum s arm is or whether his pocket mobility is any good after two seasons out of live action

news_mentions.headline: Next Woman Up: Jill Costanza, Lions Assistant Strength & Conditioning/Director of Sports Science
news_mentions.description: In this installment of the Next Woman Up series, Jill Costanza details her role as the Detroit Lions' assistant strength & conditioning coach/director of sports science, her non-linear path to the NFL and the most rewarding part of her job.
news_mentions.body_text: women are rising up the ranks throughout professional football earning positions of power in a space that for too long was ruled almost exclusively by men we re seeing more and more women breaking barriers in the sport but what are the stories beyond the headlines who are the women shaping and influencing the nfl today answering those questions is the aim of the next woman up series while the conversational q as are edited and condensed for clarity this is a forum for impactful women to share experiences in their own words without further ado we introduce jill costanza detroit lions position assistant strength conditioning director of sports science let s start from the beginning how did you get your start in a career in football my dad spent years trying to talk me into coaching he told me i d be a fantastic basketball coach because that was my sport but i wanted no part of it i wanted the glitz and glam of professional sports in a sports marketing sense i thought that was my passion i didn t find a job in marketing but i did find a passion for working with athletes and coaching and that s where i was introduced to strength and conditioning the girls on the team kept getting acl injuries so i turned to todd wright who was the head strength coach at the university of texas at the time and whom i saw speak at a high school basketball conference i saw what he was doing with the players and how he wasn t using a traditional weight room model it was like this light bulb moment of this is what i want to do i went back to school to get my master s degree in strength and conditioning from the university of miami because it had a program specific to sport performance instead of general exercise physiology i went back to the university of texas to do an internship and as life takes you on different paths i ended up in the military aspect the military was really making a push toward human performance hiring contractors to set up models similar to what you see in college athletics and professional sports i took that opportunity and spent three years with army and two years with air force special forces which is where i met mike clark who was dan campbell s head strength coach at texas a m many years ago during campbell s college playing days that s how i got into football when coach campbell got the head coaching job in detroit he made a call to coach clark to be the human performance director and i was the first person he asked to come with him so what does your role entail sports science was a fairly new profession in the u s when i was at texas but if you really wanted to write your ticket you learned that side of things to pair with strength and conditioning it s about understanding what you re tracking with different technology why you re tracking it and better yet how to communicate those findings with coaches which i learned from my mentor sandy abney that aspect allows you to assess the effectiveness of your training program any interventions that are needed and return to play plans so i jumped in and learned as much as i could thankfully what i did with the air force special forces was more on the sports science side less strength and conditioning so i was able to enhance my skills coach clark liked that i could be in a dual role but i would say my role is more strength and conditioning i m on the floor coaching more often than i am working on the sports science side because players need to warm up then we re on the practice field in the weight room helping with recovery all of that that makes sense what does a week look like for you during the regular season on monday we immediately start looking at game data and the gps metrics to understand the demands of the game and which players took a high load the players do a recovery lift that day as well players are off tuesdays so that s our time to catch up on injury reports with the head of strength and conditioning josh schuler and start thinking about return to play protocols for players coming back from injury wednesdays and thursdays are heavy hitters we have a lift in the morning then the players practice we also have a lift session after practice for whoever didn t lift in the morning i ll spend the rest of the afternoon looking at practice data to get a report ready for coach campbell telling him where certain players are at and what would you say is the most challenging part of your job we try to individualize training as much as possible so it s a lot of piecing together the puzzle players have previous injuries which sometimes make them more susceptible to additional injuries it s a lot of figuring out where the weak link is with certain players and constantly thinking outside of the box to help them i would also say the mental energy that s required day after day to get the players what they need is also a challenge oh that s interesting why do you think you ve had so much success in your career my authenticity i have never chased an opportunity they have always been presented to me i really try to wear blinders focus on me and my growth not getting so caught up in what everyone else is doing i have a strong sense of self and trust that the right people will present the right opportunities that s a great answer when was the last time you had a pinch me moment the nfc championship game in san francisco that was pretty amazing the history of this team and making it there it was like wow the game didn t go as planned but reaching that game was a highlight what goals do you have moving forward i do have an innate sense of leadership and that is where i foresee my career going i would love to step into a director s role i don t want to just check a box because i and so many other women deserve to be here we re making a huge impact and that s just what i foresee myself continuing to do now let s turn to mentorship do you have any mentors and what advice have you received from them two main mentors come to mind sandy abney whom i mentioned earlier and shaun mcpherson former strength and conditioning coach at the university of texas i learned so much from him and i m probably most grateful that he threw me into the fire there would be days when he d turn to me and say jill you re running the team warmup today or you re running their workout today you never want to look like you don t know what you re doing so he really challenged me in that sense he taught me so much about coaching building relationships trusting yourself and being ready for when an opportunity presents itself then coach clark who brought me here and josh schuler he has been such a proponent for me and given me a support system i m so very grateful for those four thank you for sharing that now flipping it forward what advice do you have for other women looking to get into a career in a similar space it has not been a linear path and patience is definitely needed getting the job you want may not happen immediately but that doesn t mean it s not going to happen there are so many phenomenal experiences that you can have outside of football that help you grow as a person not just knowledge but people skills emotional intelligence empathy being able to relate to different cultures different people and different experiences it just really helps you gain wisdom which cannot be taught except through experience so if it doesn t happen right away just be grateful for any experience that you have because it helps you maintain that strong connection to self trust your path it doesn t matter at what age you achieve your goal this didn t happen for me until i was 41 i m hopeful i am an example for women of all ages there s a divine spark within all of us and life sometimes makes that flame go down a little bit but you just pour some kerosene on it and light it back up it s never too late that s great advice finally what are you most proud of in your career when an athlete comes back and thanks me for helping them or tells me this is the best they have ever felt my training methodologies sometimes are a little outside of traditional strength and conditioning practices but when i hear that from the guys i think ok you re doing something right to be able to help athletes that i work with not just play their sport better but to feel better and give them some hope is everything
